data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Feleletsa setup sa ntlha mo Satisfactory's Server Manager mme o tswele pele go tsamaisa server ka -NewConsole.
Tobetsa fa tlase. Synix e romela taelo, e bala letshwao le lesha, e a le netefatsa, mme e bo e le boloka ka pabalesego. O se ka wa kwalolola kgotsa wa manamisa.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleUnavailable
data.value: Synix ga e kgone go fitlhelela sedirisiwa seno sa Unreal console. E simolole ka -NewConsole mme o dirise ditetla tse di tshwanang tsa Windows mo go Synix le seva.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleTokenMissing
data.value: Taelo e ne ya romelwa, mme Synix e ne e sa kgone go buisa tokene e ntšhwa e e feletseng go tswa mo tlhagisong ya seva eno. Tlhomamisa gore seva e a tsibogela le gore log ya yone e kgona go kwalwa. Kgokagano nngwe le nngwe e e bolokilweng e ne ya bolokiwa; taelo e ne ya seka ya lekwa gape.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleBusy
data.value: Khonsole ga e arabele kgotsa kgolagano e setse e tsweletse. Ema go le gonnye, o leke gape. Taelo ga e ke e lekelediwa gape ka tsela e e itirisang.

data.name: Satisfactory.TokenSafety
data.value: Se se naya Synix tetla ya motsamaisi. Letshwao leno le kwalwa ka khomputara mo akhaontong ya gago ya Windows mme ga le ise le ko le tsenngwe mo thulaganyong ya motshameko kgotsa mo go tseyeng kgato. Satisfactory e e bontsha mo console ya yone le log; di boloke e le tsa sephiri. Go tlosa kgokagano e e bolokilweng ga go tlose letshwao.

data.name: Settings.Transfer.NormalWarning
data.value:
Dilo tse di romelwang kwa dinageng di sele ka tlwaelo ga di a kwalwa ka khomputara. Mongwe le mongwe yo o bonang faele eno a ka kgona go bala dithulaganyo, tshedimosetso e e bolokilweng, le diphasewete dipe fela tse di kwadilweng mo teng ga difaele tsa thulaganyo ya motshameko.
Synix-tsamaisa diphasewete le Discord webhooks di nna di sireleditswe mo modirising yo wa Windows. Fa e le gore go romelwa gono go tsenngwa mo PC e nngwe, go ka nna ga tlhokega gore o tsenye gape dintlha tseo.
Sephuthelwana se sa ntse se tla tlhatlhobiwa go bona gore a ga se senyege ka phoso fa se tlisiwa mo nageng.
A o batla go dira thomelontle e e sa kwalwang?

data.name: Updater.AutomaticUpdateFailed.Body
data.value:
Synix ga e a kgona go feleletsa tlhabololo ya yona. Synix e ne ya leka go busetsa thulaganyo ya pele fa go kgonega.
Fa Synix e sa bule gape, tsamaisa porokeramo ya gago ya Synix e o nang le yone kgotsa itseele kgatiso ya bofelo go tswa mo GitHub. Tshedimosetso ya seva ya gago ya C:\Synix ga e a fetolwa.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
GO TLOGELA ka bonako 1. Kwala leina la motshameko le nomoro ya Steam AppID ya seva. 2. Tsenya tsela ya seva e e ka diragadiwang e e amanang le foldara e e tsentsweng ya seva. 3. Tsenya fela command text e e tlang morago ga executable. Dirisa matshwao a a tshegediwang fa tlase fa Synix e tshwanetseng go tsenya thulaganyo ya modirisi. 4. Tlhopha gore motshameko o bona jang faele ya one ya thulaganyo. Mokgwa o o laolwang o tlhoka faele ya thulaganyo e e feletseng, e e dirang - e seng sekai se se sa felelang. 5. Tlhopha Validate & Preview. Baakanya bothata bongwe le bongwe jo bo begilweng pele ga o boloka. 6. Boloka, aga Synix sesha, dira diteko tse di itirisang, go tswa foo o leke go tsenya/go simolola/go emisa/go lekola motshameko.
MAFELO A A TLHOKEGILENG • Leina la motshameko: leina le badirisi ba le bonang mo Synix. • ID ya tlhaloso: ID e e sa tshwaneng le epe ya ditlhaka tse dinnye; Synix e go direla leina la motshameko. • Steam AppID: dedicated-server AppID, ga se ka metlha e leng client game AppID. • SteamCMD app configuration: ka tlwaelo ga e na sepe. Metshameko ya GoldSrc AppID 90 e dirisa foromo e e netefaditsweng '90 mod folder', jaaka '90 mod cstrike'. Synix e amogela fela mofuta ono o o babalesegileng. • E e ka diragadiwang: sekai Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Ga e akaretse folda ya go tsenya. • Di-port: di-port tsa motshameko tse di tlhomamisitsweng le tsa dipotso. • Dimmapa le mefuta ya metshameko: tsenya boleng bo le bongwe jwa motshameko ka mola. Tseno di tlatsa ditlhopho tse di bontshiwang fa go dirwa kana go baakanngwa seva.
DITLHAGISO TSA GO Simolola O se ka wa tsenya executable ka boyone. Boloka difolaga tse di tlhomameng tsa motshameko jaaka mokwalo o o tlwaelegileng mme o tsenye ditshupo fela tsa boleng jo bo laolwang ke Synix. Sekao: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
DITLHAKISO TSE DI THUSANG TAGS [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Tsenya {rcon} mo thulaganyong ya go simolola fa taelo ya boikgethelo ya RCON e leng teng. Mo thulaganyong ya RCON, dirisa: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Sekai sa RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
BOPHELO JWA MOTHO • Ga e ise e netefadiwe: Synix ga e laole faele ya thulaganyo. • Motshameko o o bopa morago ga go simolola la ntlha: dirisa thulaganyo e e feletseng e e tserweng jaaka thempleite ya go baakanya le go baakanya. • Synix e e dira go tswa mo thempleteng: Synix e baya thulaganyo e e feletseng pele ga tshimologo ya ntlha. • Launch arguments only: motshameko ga o tlhoke config e e laolwang ya di-setting tse.
TEMPLATE TAGS CONFIGURATION Ditlhaka tsa go rulaganya {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} e kwala boleng jwa nnete jwa tlhaloso fa go na le phasewete ya seva mme boleng jwa yone jo bo fosagetseng fa phasewete e seyo. Dirisa Add configuration files fa seva e tlhoka go feta faele ele nngwe. Tlhopha faele nngwe le nngwe e e feletseng ya motswedi, o bo o fetola lefelo la yona le le tsentsweng mo tafoleng gore tsela e nne e e amanang le foldara ya seva. Synix e tlhomamisa, e tsenya, e kwala, e baakanya le go tlhabolola faele nngwe le nngwe e e kwadilweng mmogo.
DIFILE TSE DI KOPELwang tse di Tlamelwang ke Modirisi Tsenya tsela e le nngwe e e sireletsegileng mo moleng mongwe le mongwe, e e amanang le foldara ya seva e e tsentsweng. Difaele tse di tlhokegang di thibela go simololwa go fitlha jaanong; difaele tsa boikgethelo di a tsenngwa fa di bonwa mme ga di thibele go simololwa. Fa difaele tse di tlhokegang di tswa mo motshamekong o o tlwaelegileng, tlhalosa kgato nngwe le nngwe ya modirisi mo ditaelong tsa Setup. Synix ga e ke e itseela, e tlola mong wa yone, kgotsa e anamisa difaele tsa ba ba nang le laesense ya go tshameka. Foldara ya data ya kwa ntle ke leina la foldara le Synix e ka nnang ya le batla ka fa tlase ga difoldara tsa Documents tsa modirisi. E tlogele e se na sepe fa modirisi a tshwanetse go kopolola difaele ka seatla.
Tlhagiso ya go simolola pele le letshwao Dira gore tlhagiso e nne teng fa badirisi ba tshwanetse go wetsa thulaganyo pele ga e simololwa. Kwala dikgato tse di maleba mme o bo o supa sengwe le sengwe se modirisi a tshwanetseng go se bona mo motshamekong wa gagwe. Icon URL ke ya boikgethelo mme e tshwanetse go dirisa HTTPS. Synix e wela kwa morago kwa setsheng se se tsentsweng sa seva se se ka diragadiwang fa se sena sepe.
DITLHAKISO LE TSHIRELETSO Simolola ditlhaloso tse dintšhwa le dithempelete mo thulaganyong ya 1. Go oketsa tlhaloso ya phetogo nako le nako fa tlhaloso ya motshameko e fetoga. Oketsa tekolo ya themplate fela fa phetogo ya thulaganyo e e laolwang ya thulaganyo e fetoga. Synix e gana go kwalololwa kwa ntle ga phetogo ya maemo a a kwa godimo mme e boloka di-backup tsa tlhatloso.
Tlhopho ya Morago ga go Tlhomamisa Dira gore Steam e kgone go kwalololwa fela fa seva e netefaditswe gore e a e tlhoka. Maikaelelo e tshwanetse go nna fa foldara e leng teng mo teng ga lefelo leo la seva. Synix e kopitsa fela di-DLL tsa yone tse tharo tse di letleletsweng tsa Steam runtime.
DIKGATLHOGO TSA NAKO YA GO DIRWA Beela bonnye jwa tsamaiso RAM go 0 fa motshameko o sena bonnye jo bo netefaditsweng. Hardware le Windows runtime checks di tlhalosa ditlhokego tse di tlhaelang pele ga setup mme di thibele go simololwa go go sa babalesegang; ga di fetole maemo a Windows. Tlhopha .NET Framework kgotsa Visual C++ runtime fela fa ditlhokego tsa semmuso tsa motshameko di e supa. Synix e tlhatlhoba rejisetara ya Windows mme ga e ke e tsenya kgotsa go tsaya dilo tse di tlhokegang ka tidimalo. Hyper-V e tlhoka Windows Professional kgotsa e e kwa godimo, ka jalo go tlhopha Hyper-V gape go tlhopha tlhokego ya Windows.
BOITSHWARO JWA GO JA Dirisa mokgwa o o tlwaelegileng wa go latedisa tirego mo diservereng tse di kgethegileng. Tiriso ya kwa ntle ke fela mo mothong yo o simololang, mo motšhineng wa nnete, kgotsa tiriso e nngwe e e nang le botshelo jwa seva; e dira gore go se ka ga tlhola go latelwa dipotso. Go kgontsha Required visible manager mo metshamekong e molaodi wa yone wa semmuso a tshwanetseng go nna a butswe. Se se tla dira gore modirisi a se ka a tlhola a bona sedirisiwa sa gagwe sa go iphitlha fela mo tlhalosong eo. Elevated launch e tshegeditswe fela mo .exe, .bat, le .cmd launch files. Go kgontsha go romela faele kwa ntle fela fa modirisi a ka kgona go dira le go tsamaisa faele ya go romela e e sekasekilweng kwa ntle ga Synix. Molaetsa wa gore motshameko o setse o siametse go ka tshamekiwa o bontshiwa morago ga gore motshameko o atlege mo go tlhatlhobeng gore motshameko o setse o siametse go ka tshamekiwa. Mafelo ano a tlhopha boitshwaro jwa Synix jo bo ageletsweng mo teng, jo bo letleletsweng mme ga bo ka ke jwa tsamaisa dikwalo kgotsa di-plugins tse di itlhophileng.
LOG DISCOVERY Tsenya ditsela tse di babalesegileng tse di amanang le foldara ya seva e e tsentsweng. Dirisa * mo karolong ya tsela e le nngwe kgotsa leina la faele le ** mo difoldareng tse di kopantsweng. Ditshupo tse di tshegediwang ke {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, le {QueryPort}. Dikai: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix e batla ditsela tse fela fa modirisi a kopa go bula log ya motshameko e ntšhwa.

data.name: Text.E26C86E2069FAA56AA9A

data.name: Text.1263E823649071566AFC
data.value: Synix e dira taelo ya mmatota ka diseting tse di bolokilweng tsa seva eno, e fitlha khunololamoraba nngwe le nngwe, e e simolola ka tlwaelo, mme e letetse bosupi jwa gore seva e amogetse go bulwa.

data.name: Text.2F4A3B0705E0D01E2F8F
data.value: Synix Tlhomamiso ya Tiriso ya Thulaganyo

data.name: Text.0245B987FC14009D721D

data.name: Text.180299794A99A2CB63F1
data.value: SYNIX CONTROL PANEL • kgatiso

data.name: Text.030EBC77E93FA53151CE
data.value: Synix ga e bule boemakepe jwa taolo ya web. Mafaratlhatlha a a bolokilweng ke Synix a sireleditswe mo lefelong, mme boleng jo bo botlhokwa bo fitlhilwe go tswa mo dipegong tsa yone tsa tiro.

data.name: Text.50DDB266BAA23B0FE224
data.value: Synix Motlhami wa Tlhaloso ya Metshameko

data.name: Text.385E44CCA2BC7A3242CF

data.name: Text.43A57C9D7AFBA6F4D472
data.value: Synix Motlhala wa Netefatso ya Metshameko

data.name: Text.69B1390848A4F53A80A2
data.value: Synix e tsenya loader ya seva e e tlhophilweng le Java e e tsamaelanang le yone. Tsenya di-mods tsa gago fa o sena go di tsenya.

data.name: Text.93F24BC2C28FEF1DDC28
data.value: Synix e diretswe go dira gore motho a kgone go tlhaloganya se se dirwang mo serwereng sa metshameko kwantle ga go fitlha diphetogo tse di dirwang mo khomputareng ya gago.

data.name: Text.3D07CCD88E27236748F3

data.name: Text.3DA22A4586E8B5324964

data.name: Text.F70301C507AF16CA4237

data.name: Text.EDE7581CA906C86AD8C0
data.value: Synix update e teng

data.name: Text.DB74849CCDF411527A63
data.value: Synix e netefatsa gore di-backup di siame, e baya faele e e tlhophilweng ka pabalesego, mme e bo e boela kwa morago fa tsosoloso e sa atlege. Go tsenngwa ga seva ya Synix e e bolokilweng le dipaakanyo tsa yone ga di a fetolwa.

data.name: Text.F283ABEE58C3C5919882
data.value: Synix e tlhomamisa tiro nngwe le nngwe ka tsela e e itirisang fa e sena go atlega mo PC eno.

data.value: Thanolo ya Synix:

data.name: Text.EED8C29183FC10F6FEC2
data.value: Tsela ya go rarabolola mathata a System & Server

data.name: Text.7083BACCFEE1C7E3CC47
data.value: Re bolelele gore o ne wa tobetsa eng, gore Synix e bontshitse eng, le gore re ka dira jang gore go direge gape.

data.name: Text.B976ECB48B1B2D4AC318
data.value: Go tlhatlhoba ditlhaloso tse di agilweng tsa metshameko

data.name: Text.D25BF1DE94C6CFCB40D4
data.value: Go tlhatlhoba tlhaloso nngwe le nngwe e e mo teng le thempleite ka pabalesego...

data.name: Text.91657E9737A951B3ADA2
data.value: E tlhatlhoba motshameko mongwe le mongwe o o ageletsweng mo teng, e laola go bofa maemo, thempleite ya thulaganyo e e feletseng, phetogo, tsela, lefelo la log, le tiro e e letleletsweng morago ga go tsenya. Di-server tse di tsentsweng ga di ke di fetolwa.

data.value: Tlaleletso e ne e sa tsenngwa.

data.name: Text.3CDC839AB03D7080ED58

data.name: Text.AB89F96B667CE80E48CB

data.name: Text.44D8326D9590F71F8B1B

data.name: ModManager.Error.LinkedPath
data.value: Tiragatso eno ya tlaleletso e dirisa faele kgotsa folda e e golagantsweng. Tlhopha folda e e tlwaelegileng; Synix ga e kitla e latela kgokagano eo.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileMissing
data.value: Faele ya tlaleletso e e fetileng e e tlhokegang go tsosolosa ga e yo. Ga go na difaele dipe tse di neng tsa fetolwa. Busetsa faele e e tlhaelang ya tsosoloso kgotsa dirisa sesireletsi sa seva se se netefaditsweng pele o tlosa tlaleletso eno.

data.name: ModManager.Error.RecoveryRetained
data.value: Tiro ya go oketsa e ne ya retela mme diphetogo dingwe di ne tsa seka tsa busediwa morago. Difaele tsa go busediwa di ne di bolokilwe kwa {0}. Dira gore seva e emisiwe mme o busetse difaele tseo kgotsa khopi ya sesireletsi e e netefaditsweng pele o simolola.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchValue
data.value: Lefelo la go thuntshetsa {0} ga le kgone go feta ka pabalesego mo thuntshetsong eno ya setlhopha sa Windows. Ditshupiso tse pedi tse di tsentsweng, go kgaoganya mela, kgotsa dipolelo tse di fetofetogang ga di tshegediwe fano. Boleng jwa yone ga bo a fetoga.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchArguments
data.value: Taelo e e feleletseng ya batch e na le thutapuo e e sa babalesegang ya taelo kgotsa katoloso e e fetofetogang. Tlhatlhoba boleng jwa go simolola le mabaka a tlaleletso; go ne go sa simololwe sepe.

data.name: ServerStart.Arguments.CustomHidden
data.value: [Dipolelo tsa tlwaelo tse di neetsweng; diteng tse di tlogetsweng mo logong]

data.name: Configuration.Editor.Error.YamlUnsupported
data.value: YAML mola wa {0} ga o a siama kgotsa o dirisa karolo e e ka se fetolweng ka pabalesego ke mokwadi yono. E a tshegediwa: tokomane e le nngwe e e nang le dimmapa/mananeo a a tsentsweng dikhutlo le boleng jwa mola o le mongwe. Dikokoano tsa motsamao, boleng jwa multiline, matshwao, di-anchor, le maina a sele ga di tshegediwe. Ga go na sepe se se neng sa bolokiwa.

data.value: World Seed e a tlhokega mo go {0}: dirisa nomoro yotlhe go tswa go {1} go ya go {2}. E baakanye mo go Server Setup > World Generation.

data.value: Seemo

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Profile
data.value: Thulaganyo e ya sephuthelwana e tshegediwa fela mo difoldareng tsa Empyrion tse di nang le ditokomane.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.FolderName
data.value: Dirisa leina la foldara le le nang le ditlhaka tsa 1–80, kwa ntle ga dikhutlo, maina a a boloketsweng Windows, kgotsa diphatlha tse di kwa pele/kwa morago. Leina la tiragalo ga le ka ke la nna fela nomoro ya Lefelo la Tiro.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Layout
data.value: Tlhopha seemo se se feletseng se se tsentsweng kgotsa sephuthelwana se se kopantsweng sa mod sa seva, e seng thulaganyo ya go tsenya motshameko, kokoanô ya Workshop, polane, kgotsa bobolokelo jwa khoutu ya motswedi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioLayout
data.value: Seemo se tshwanetse go nna le gameoptions.yaml le Content, Playfields, Sectors, kgotsa Prefabs mmogo, e ka nna kwa moding wa ZIP kgotsa mo teng ga folda ya seemo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioCode
data.value: Sephuthelwana se se na le khoutu ya DLL, C#, kgotsa JAR. Tsenya khoutu ya seva ka thoko ka Empyrion server mods morago ga go sekaseka ditaelo tsa mokwadi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ModLayout
data.value: Tlhopha sephuthelwana se se feletseng sa mod: Difaele tsa DLL le difaele tsa tsone tsa tshegetso di tshwanetse go nna kwa moding wa sephuthelwana kgotsa mo teng ga difoldara tsa mod ka bongwe. Difaele tse di oketsegileng tsa sephuthelwana le diakhaefe tse di feletseng tsa seva ga di amogelege.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.MissingScenario
data.value: Kgang eno ga e ise e direge. Tsenya seemo se se feletseng pele, go tswa foo o bo o se tlhopha mo lenaaneng la tse di tsentsweng.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ConfigurationChanged
data.value: Seemo kana dipeakanyo tsa poloko di fetogile fa fensetere eno e butswe. E tswale mme o tlhophe seemo gape.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ExistingSave
data.value: Poloko eo e setse e le teng. Maemo a a farologaneng a tlhoka leina le lesha, le le sa dirisiwang la poloko. Synix ga e a emisetsa kana go phimola lefatshe le le leng teng.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Configuration
data.value: dedicated.yaml ga e yo, e kgolo thata, kgotsa ga e na GameConfig.CustomScenario le GameConfig.GameName. Simolola pele ka go rulaganya seva.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.SaveFailed
data.value: Synix e paletswe ke go boloka rekoto ya seva. Seemo se se fetileng se tsosolositswe; tshegetso e a bolokwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ProtectedScenario
data.value: Synix ga e kitla e tlosa maemo a a tlhophilweng kgotsa dithoto tsa maemo fa lefatshe le le bolokilweng le sa ntse le le teng. Lefatshe leo le ka tswa le sa ntse le ikaegile ka difaele tseo. Ga go na difaele dipe tse di neng tsa tlosiwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Tsamaisa seva ya Minecraft e o e tlhophileng fa. E emise pele o fetola difaele, mafatshe, diphuthelwana, kgotsa nako ya tiragatso. Simolola, emisa, mme o simolole gape ka go dirisa dikgato tsa pabalesego tse di tlwaelegileng tsa botshelo jwa Synix.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Dirisa dithulaganyo tsa go simolola dilo sesha le go di tlhokomela, go akaretsa go letela batshameki le go dira gore o dire kopi ya gago e e feletseng pele. Dinako di dirisa nako ya lefelo la PC eno. Synix e tshwanetse go bo e dira gore thulaganyo ya yone e kgone go dira.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Tsosolosa go bona maina a a mo Internet le lenaane la batho ba ba bolokilweng. Tlhopha kgotsa kwala leina la motshameki, go tswa foo o bo o sekaseka se a se dirileng. Ditaolo di tlhoka seva e e dirang le kgokagano ya console e e dirang. Bedrock ga e tshegetse ditaolo tsa thibelo ya Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Fetola server.properties le faele ya mod/plugin configuration. Boleng jo bo dirisitsweng ke Synix bo tsamaelana le fa server.properties e bolokilwe. Leina le le phasaladitsweng / MOTD le farologane le leina la lefelo leno. Refresh e busetsa diphetogo tsa kwa ntle tsa thulaganyo fa e emisitswe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Go boloka go dira dikhopi tse di busediwang. Diphetogo tsa di-port, lefatshe, peo, mokgwa wa motshameko, tekanyetso ya badiragatsi, le go tshegetsa Minecraft di dira gape gore Synix e tokafale. JSON, XML, le YAML di sekasekwa pele di bolokwa; Diforomo tse dingwe di tlhoka go baakanngwa ka kelotlhoko. Boloka tshedimosetso ya gago e le sephiri.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Tsenya ZIP ya lefatshe la Java kgotsa Bedrock mo foldareng e NTSHA, o bo o e tlhopha go e dirisa. Lefatshe le le leng teng ga le emisediwe ka le lengwe. Dikgatiso ga di fetolwe. Go fetola ga go tokafatse, go fokotsa kgotsa go netefatsa gore lefatshe le tsamaelana le motshameko/mod; o boele morago pele.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Tlhatlhoba metadata ya JAR le dilo tse di ikaegileng ka yone, laola ditlaleletso tse di farologaneng, kgotsa sekaseka pakete e e feletseng ya seva. Dirisa mofuta wa motshameko o o nepagetseng wa pakete le go aga mojaro. Ditlhatlhobo tsa tirisanommogo ke tsa kgakololo mme ga di supe gore khoutu e babalesegile kgotsa gore mod mongwe le mongwe o tla dira.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Di-backup tse di feletseng di akaretsa foldara ya seva, lefatshe, ditlaleletso, le thulaganyo. Simolola pele ka go emisa seva. Tlhomamisa gore e siame pele ga o e busetsa. Go tsosolosa go emisetsa difaele tsa seva; ditlankana tsa go amogela di tlhomamisa gore a rekoto e bolokilwe sentle, e seng gore a khopi e e bolokilweng e na le bothata bongwe jo bo neng bo setse bo le teng.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Phetogo nngwe le nngwe ya diteng e boloka difaele tse di fetileng le di-hash. Tlhopha phetogo e e dirisitsweng kgotsa e e kgaotsweng go e busetsa. Dira diphetogo tse disha pele. Difaele tse di fetotsweng go tswa kwa ntle le lefatshe le le tsentsweng mo tirisong di sireleditswe. Boloka polokelo e e tletseng ya go tlhabolola runtime/world.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Batla mathata a a tlwaelegileng mo pegong ya bosheng ya log ya seva le mo pegong ya bofelo ya go phutlhama. Se se fitlhelwang ke bosupi, ga se mabaka a a tlhomamisitsweng. Tsamaiso CPU/RAM ga se Minecraft TPS/MSPT; Dirisa thulaganyo e e tsamaisanang le yone ya go dira dipampiri mo teng ga seva fa o tlhatlhoba bokgoni jwa go dira dipampiri.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: A o ka emisa seva eno ka Synix gone jaanong?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: A o tshwanetse go busetsa seva eno ka Synix gone jaanong?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: A o tshwanetse go tsenya mofuta wa motshameko o o tlhophilweng, sedirisiwa sa go tsenya, le go aga go tswa mo metsweding ya bone ya semmuso? E ka nna ya jarolla Java mme ya tsamaisa setsha sa semmuso sa Forge/NeoForge. Difaele tsa seva di bewa pele; difaele tse di neng di emisitswe pele di a bolokwa gore di busediwe morago. Lefatshe le di-add-on di a bolokiwa. Dira kgatiso e e feletseng pele o fetola mefuta ya metshameko. Ga go na sedirisiwa sa motshameko se se simolotsweng.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Romela taelo ya motshameki yo o tlhophilweng? Go tsena ga motsamaisi go dira gore a kgone go laola motshameko ka botlalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: A o ka dirisa lefatshe le o le tlhophileng mo tshimologong e e latelang? Lefatshe la gone jaanong le nna mo disiking. Tlhopha lefatshe fela le le tsamaisanang le kgatiso, mofuta, le di-mods tsa seva eno.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Tsenya pakete eno e o e ikanyang ya seva? Sephuthelwana sa Modrinth se ka kgona go tsenya difaele tse di umakilweng go tswa mo metsweding e e amogetsweng ya HTTPS. Di-mods le dikwalelo tsa motshameko di tsamaisa khoutu mo teng ga seva ya motshameko. Thulaganyo, hash, go tsamaisana, le ditlhatlhobo tsa di-antivirus tse di leng teng ga di tlhomamise gore di sireletsegile. Sekaseka diphetogo tsotlhe pele o di dirisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Ditshekatsheko di bala metadata kwa ntle ga go laisa khoutu ya mod. Diphatlha tse di raraaneng tsa mefuta, go ikaega ka maemo, le metadata e mengwe e e kopantsweng/ya bogologolo e tlhoka tshekatsheko ya seatla. Ditlhatlhobo tseno ga di tlhomamise gore di a tsamaisana kgotsa gore ga go na di-malware.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Skipped
data.value: Ga e a tlisiwa: {0}

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Tlhatlhoba lefelo le o ka bolokelang mo go lone le gore a go na le marobalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Dira tshomarelo e e feletseng ya seva e e emisitsweng?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Busetsa faele e o e tlhophileng? Difaele tse di leng teng tsa seva di tla emisediwa. Tlhomamisa gore o na le rekoto e e bolokilweng mme o boloke difaele dipe fela tse o sa ntseng o di tlhoka pele ga o tswelela.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Busetsa faele e e fetileng ya phetogo eno. Difaele tse di tsentsweng ke phetogo eno di tlosiwa fela fa di sa fetolwa. Difaele tse di fetotsweng di kgoreletsa go busediwa. Go tlhokega gore go dirwe backup e e feletseng go busetsa morago phetogo epe ya lefatshe e e dirilweng morago ga go simolola mofuta o o farologaneng wa motshameko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Ga go na mokgwa ope o o lemogilweng mo direkotong tsa bosheng tse di leng teng. Eno ga se tlhatlhobo e e feletseng ya boitekanelo. Dirisa Readiness mme o lebe phoso ya ntlha gaufi le nako ya go palelwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Tlhatlhoba pele o dirisa: {0} e ntšha • {1} e emisitswe • {2} e tlositswe. Difaele tse di fetileng di a bolokiwa gore di busediwe. Ga go na seva e e simolotsweng.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Kago ya seva e e tsetsepetseng e e kopilweng kgotsa metadata ya yone ya go jarololwa ga e yo. Ntšhafatsa kgetho ya version/build mme o leke gape.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Diteng tse di feta faele e e tshegediwang, metadata, kgotsa tekanyetso ya bogolo jwa kakaretso.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Tshedimosetso ya go busediwa e a tlhaela kgotsa ga e dumalane. Boloka folda ya go busetsa mme o dirise khopi e e feletseng e e tlhomamisitsweng.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Tirego e e fetileng ya diteng e tlhoka go busediwa. Bula Change recovery mme o e rarabolole pele o dira phetogo e nngwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Faele e fetotswe fa e sale go sekasekwa kgotsa fa e sale tiro eno. Tsenya gape mme o boele gape. Ga go na diphetogo dipe tse di sa amaneng le se o se kwadileng tse di tla tsenngwang mo godimo ga se o se kwadileng.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Thulaganyo ya sephuthelwana kana tsela ga e babalesege, ga e utlwale sentle, kgotsa ga e tshegediwe. Tlhopha sephuthelwana sa seva se se tshegediwang kgotsa polokelo ya lefatshe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Leno ke lefatshe le go dirwang dilo tse dintsi mo go lone. Fetolela kwa lefatsheng le lengwe pele o busetsa dilo tse di tsentsweng mo go lone morago.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Foldara eo ya lefatshe e setse e le teng. Tlhopha leina le lesha la folda; dilo tse di setseng di le teng ga di ke di kwalololwa ka tsela e sele.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Tlhopha akhaefe e e nang le lefatshe le le lengwe ka level.dat. Diakhaefe tse di feletseng tsa seva le tsa mafatshe a mantsi di dirisa mokgwa wa go boloka/tsosolosa mo boemong jwa seo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Lefatshe leno ga le tsamaelane le kgatiso ya seva kgotsa ga le na difaele tsa lona tse di solofetsweng tsa kgaolo/database. Mafatshe a Java le Bedrock ga a fetolwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Dirisa leina la foldara ya lefatshe le le babalesegileng, kwa ntle ga ditsela kgotsa maina a Windows a a bolokilweng. Dirisa ditlhaka, dinomoro, diphatlha, dikhutlo kgotsa matshwao a a gatelelang fa o batla go tsenya dilo tse dingwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Tsamaiso e ya tiro ke ya Java server mods/plugins. Dirisa modikologo wa tiro ya tlaleletso e e tshegediwang ya Bedrock; Java JARs ga e kgone go dira mo Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Ga go na diteng tsa seva tse di tshegediwang tse di bonweng. Launcher scripts, client files, runtimes, worlds, le root server settings ga di a tsenngwa ke modpack workflow.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Mofuta wa diteng ga o tsamaelane le software e e tlhophilweng ya seva. Di-mods di tlhoka mod loader e e tsamaelanang; Bukkit/Paper plugins di tlhoka plugin runtime.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Eno ke lenane la modirisi wa CurseForge, e seng pakete e e feletseng ya seva. Tsenya ZIP ya modirisi wa mokwadi e e nang le di-mods tsa nnete le di-config; difaele tse di sa kgonweng go bonwa ga di tlolwe ka tidimalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Phetolelo ya pakete ya Minecraft le mojaro/tlhamo di tshwanetse go tsamaelana le seva e. Tlhopha mme o dirise nako eo ya go dira pele. Dilaodi tse di sa tshegediwang ga di a emisediwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Tshedimosetso e e tsentsweng kgotsa e e rometsweng ga se motswedi wa HTTPS o o letleletsweng ke puso. Dirisa ZIP e e tshegediwang ke mokwadi ya seva sa selegae mo boemong jwa seo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Faele e e tsentsweng ga e tsamaelane le bogolo jwa yone jo bo boletsweng kgotsa SHA-512 hash. Ga go na sepe se se neng se tlhomilwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Boleng jwa Minecraft jo bo dirisitsweng ke Synix ga bo a siama kgotsa ga bo dumalane. Tlhatlhoba di-port, tekanyetso ya motshameki, mokgwa wa motshameko, le thulaganyo ya taolo pele o boloka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: Synix ga e a kgona go boloka rekoto e e tlhabolotsweng ya seva. Tiro eno e ne ya se ka ya amogelwa; fa go tlhokega, go ne ga bolokiwa difaele tsa go busetsa dilo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Synix's Minecraft management connection e tshwanetse go nna mo localhost. O se ka wa dira gore sedirisiwa seno sa go laola se kgone go tsena mo Internet.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: Boemela-kepe jo bo rulagantsweng ke jwa motlamedi yo mongwe wa Synix. Tlhopha boemakepe jo bo farologaneng pele o boloka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Tlhopha tiro e e tshegediwang le leina la motshameki le le siameng. Dithibelo tsa Java ga se ditaolo tsa Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Serwer e ne ya se ka ya simolola. Tlhatlhoba gore a o setse o ipaakantse le go bala pego ya ditiro tsa gago pele ga o leka gape.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: Metadata e ne e sa kgone go balwa ka botlalo. Tlhatlhoba faele le ditlhokego tsa mokwadi wa yone tsa go tsamaisana.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Go feta JAR e le nngwe ya maemo a a kwa godimo e bolela ID eno. Sekaseka le go tlosa mokwalo o o tshwanang.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: JAR eno e itlhalosa e le ya modirisi fela. O se ka wa e tsenya mo serwereng se se kgethegileng.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: Metadata ya JAR eno ga e tsamaisane le loader/software e e tlhophilweng.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Go ikaega go go tlhokegang ga go a fitlhelwa mo metadata e e tlhatlhobilweng: {0}. Sekaseka ditlamelo tse di kopantsweng kgotsa tse di nang le maemo pele o tsenya sengwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyVersion
data.value: Go ikaega ka {0} go tlhoka {1}; mofuta o o tlhatlhobilweng ke {2}.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Tlhatlhoba go ikaega ka seatla {0}: go tlhokega {1}, e tlhatlhobilwe {2}. Mofuta ono ga o tlhaloganngwe sentle.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: Lokwalodikgang lo supa gore Java/class-version ga e tshwane. Dirisa mofuta wa Java o o tlhokwang ke seva e e tlhophilweng le mod loader.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Lokwalodikgang lo akantsha gore Java e ne ya palelwa ke go aba memori e e lekaneng. Sekaseka RAM e e leng teng, tekanyetso ya seva, le gore a di-server tse dingwe di a e dirisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Lokwalodikgang lo umaka dilo tse di tlhokegang gore o kgone go ikaega ka batho ba bangwe. Sekaseka phoso ya mojaro wa ntlha, o bo o tlhatlhoba mod e e nepagetseng, go ikaega, mofuta wa motshameko, le go aga mojaro.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Lokwalodikgang lo bontsha gore boemakepe bongwe bo setse bo dirisiwa. Sekaseka dithulaganyo tse dingwe le dikgoro tse di rulagantsweng tsa seva eno; o se ka wa bula dikgoro tse di sa amaneng tsa firewall.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: Log e kopa gore Minecraft EULA e amogele. E bale o bo o e amogele go ya ka thulaganyo e e tlwaelegileng ya go simolola tiro fa e le gore o a dumela.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Dipego tsa lokwalodikgang di bontsha gore go na le nako e e seng kana ka sepe kgotsa go na le nako ya go leta. Sekaseka CPU load, world generation, entities, le mods. Go dirisa RAM e le nosi go ka nna ga se ka ga rarabolola bothata jono.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Phoso ya mixine gantsi e akaretsa mod/loader e e sa tsamaelaneng. Sekaseka lebaka la ntlha mo pegong ya kotsi le mefuta e e tlhokegang ya pakete.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: Lokwalodikgang lo bega diphoso tsa go bala tshedimosetso ya lefatshe lotlhe. Tlogisa seva mme o boloke difaele tse di leng teng pele ga o leka go dira backup e e dumalanang e e netefaditsweng.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Thulaganyo eno ya bogologolo ga e na tshedimosetso e e kwadilweng ya nako e e dirwang ka yone. Dirisa poloko e e feletseng ya seva go e busetsa; Synix e ka se kgone go fopholetsa gore ke eng se se neng se e laisa le gore e ne e na le mofuta ofe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Nako ya go dira e e tsentsweng ga e tsamaisane le kgatiso e e tlhophilweng, mofuta, morwalo, kgotsa tlhokego ya Java. Bula Minecraft Control Center mme o dirise Apply Runtime pele o simolola.

data.value: Ga go na di-addon tse di bonweng mo foldareng e e dirang ya di-mods kgotsa di-plugins tsa thulaganyo eno ya seva.

data.value: Go ne ga se ka ga fitlhelwa mathata ape fa go tlhatlhobiwa metadata e e neng e le teng. Seno ga se netefatse gore mod mongwe le mongwe kgotsa porojeke nngwe le nngwe e tla dira mmogo.

data.value: Bala Mod Package

data.name: AsaPackages.Title
data.value: Go bala ASA mod package

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Tlhopha ZIP ya ASA Windows-server e e tsentsweng kgotsa folda e e tserweng. Synix e bona mod descriptors mo teng ga sephuthelwana se se sephaphathi, se se phuthetsweng kgotsa se se nang le di-multi-mod mme e baakanyetsa CurseForge ID ya bona gore e sekasekwe. Difaele tsa ZIP ga di kopiwe kana go tsenngwa. ASA e golola le go kwadisa serwe sa ga jaana sa motlamedi fa o simolola serwe; seno ga se tseye mofuta wa ZIP.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: Metadata ya sephuthelwana ga e tshepiwe. Go lemoga ga se go sekaseka di-malware, go tlhatlhoba gore a di a tsamaisana le tse dingwe kgotsa go supa gore ke mang yo o di gatisitseng.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Go tlhatlhoba sephuthelwana go ne ga emisiwa kana ga tsaya nako e telele thata. Tlhopha folda ya sephuthelwana e potlana mme o leke gape.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Tlhopha ZIP ya mod ARK server kgotsa foldara ya mod e e tserweng. Diforomo tse dingwe tsa diakhaefe ga di tshegediwe ke mmadi yono.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Sephuthelwana seno se feta selekanyo sa se se ka balwang ke metadata. Tlhopha folda e potlana kgotsa ZIP e e se nang go feta 100 mod descriptors.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Phuthelwana e na le ditsela tse di sa babalesegang, dikgolagano, ditsela tse di tshwanang, difaele tse di thulanang, kgotsa difoldara tse dintsi thata. Ga go na sepe se se neng sa fetoga.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Ga go na .uplugin mod descriptor e e bonweng. Tlhopha ZIP ya mod kgotsa folda ya yone e e tserweng; di-archives tse di tsentsweng mo go tsone di tshwanetse go ntshiwa pele.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: Tlhaloso ya mod ga e a siama, JSON. Ga go na sepe se se neng sa fetoga.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: Tlhaloso ga e supe porojeke ya ARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge. Synix e ka se kgone go fopholetsa motshameko kgotsa ID ya mod.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: Tlhaloso ga e na ID ya porojeke ya CurseForge e le nngwe e e maleba (cf_ugcID). Dirisa Manage Mod IDs ka ID go tswa mo tsebeng ya mokwadi ya CurseForge.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: Mod ga e na sephuthelwana sa WindowsServer se se lemogilweng kgotsa faele ya .ucas/.utoc e a tlhaela. Tlhopha tshupiso ya Windows-server, e seng go aga modirisi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Sephuthelwana se na le tlhaloso e e fetang e le nngwe ya mod ID e e tshwanang. Tlhopha mofuta o le mongwe wa mod mongwe le mongwe mme o tlhatlhobe gape.

data.name: AsePackages.Title
data.value: Bala phasele ya mod ASE

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Tlhopha ARK: Survival Evolved mod ZIP kgotsa folda e e nang le .mod descriptor le folda ya yona ya mod e e apeilweng. Synix e bala ID ya bodirelo go tswa mo tlhalosong, e seng leina la ZIP. Difaele ga di kopiwe kgotsa go tsenngwa: morago ga tshekatsheko, Synix e tlhabolola ActiveMods le ModIDS ya ARK's automatic download route. Dimmapa le diphetogo tse di feletseng di ka nna tsa tlhoka gore go tlhomiwe seva se se farologaneng. Diphuthelwana tsa ASA CurseForge ga di tsamaisane.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Eno ga se modikologo o o amogetsweng wa ASE o o feletseng. Tsenya .mod descriptor le go tshwantshanya foldara ya mod le mod.info le dithoto tse di apeilweng. ID e e tsentsweng e tshwanetse go tshwana le leina lepe la faele ya mokwadi wa dinomoro. Raw Workshop .z downloads without a prepared .mod file ga e tshegediwe ke mmadi yo; dirisa Manage Mod IDs go na le moo.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Sephuthelwana seno se na le tlhaloso ya kgatiso e nngwe ya ARK. Mods tsa ASE Steam Workshop le mods tsa ASA CurseForge ga di fetofetoge. Tlhopha sephuthelwana sa seva se se tlhophilweng.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Dirisa buka eno go itirela saete ya gago ya ntlha. Synix e tsamaisiwa mo PC eno, ka jalo tlogela PC e tshubilwe fa batho ba tshameka. Ga go tlhokege gore o kwale taelo ya go simolola mo thulaganyong e e tshegediwang ya tlwaelo.
1. Bula Synix mme o letle SteamCMD gore e fetse go tlhatlhoba go ikaega. 2. Tlhopha Add Server, go tswa foo o dire seva se sentšhwa. Fa e le gore difaele tsa seva di setse di le teng, tlhopha Import Existing Server go na le moo. 3. Mo General, tsenya leina le le kgethegileng la seva mme o tlhophe motshameko. Tlhopha kgatiso, mofuta wa motshameko kgotsa sedirisiwa sa go tsenya fa e le gore di teng. 4. Boloka ditekanyetso tse di akantshiwang fa e le gore ga o tlhoke sengwe se sele. Sekaseka ditsebe tsa thulaganyo tse di kgontshiwang mme o rarabolole molaetsa o o tlhokegang wa thulaganyo kwa tlase. 5. Tlhopha Save Server. Se se tlaleletsa mokwalo mo dashboard; ga go reye gore motshameko o feditse go tsenngwa. 6. Tlhopha selo seo o bo o tlhopha Start. Letla gore thulaganyo ya go tsenya le ya go simolola e fele, o latela ditaelo dipe fela tse Synix e di bontshang. 7. Tlatsa setup sengwe le sengwe se e leng sa motshameko, jaaka tumalano, go tsena mo akhaontong, kgotsa go dira seshene mo mookameding wa yone wa mo teng ga motshameko. 8. Ikgolaganye le rona o dirisa PC eno kgotsa sedirisiwa se sengwe sa mo legaeng la gago. Fa seo se setse se bereka, dira gore go nne le khopi e e bolokilweng pele o tsenya di-mod kgotsa o dira diphetogo tse dikgolo.
FA O KA KGOGOMELWA Bulela Ready for the selected server mme o bale Activity & Diagnostics. Latela phoso e e rileng go na le go tobetsa Start gangwe le gape. Mo go Minecraft kgotsa Satisfactory, karolo ya Game Guides e tlhalosa dikgato tse dingwe.
Go tshola batho ba ba kwa ntle ga netweke ya gago ke kgato e nngwe ya go ikgolaganya le ba bangwe. Sa ntlha netefatsa gore seva e dira mo lefelong la lona.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Kgatiso nngwe le nngwe ya dashboard e tlhoka leina la yone le foldara ya go tsenya. Synix e fetola leina la seva go nna Windows-tshireletsego ya boitshupo jwa difoldara tse di tshegediwang le dipeakanyo tsa tshimologo. Seno se dira gore di-instance tse di farologaneng di se ka tsa abelana difaele ka tsela e e sa tshwanelang; ga se motšhine o o itiretsweng kgotsa molelwane wa tshireletsego.
DIKAROLO TSE DI SA BOLELENG • C:\Synix - lefelo le legolo la tiro ya data ya Synix. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ke sedirisiwa sa go tsenya metshameko. • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> e e tlwaelegileng ya di-server. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ke modi o o tlwaelegileng o o bolokilweng. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ‡ direkoto tsa tiriso le dipegelo tsa dikotsi.
Difaele tsa tiriso ya MSI ka tlwaelo di ka fa tlase ga %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Ditlhopho dingwe le boleng jo bo sireleditsweng ke Windows le tsona di mo akhaontong ya gago ya Windows.
MAFELO A A Tlwaelegileng Dirisa Install & Launch fa o tlhopha foldara ya seva. Fa o batla go tsenya sedirisiwa se sesha, tlhopha folda e e sa tsenngweng sepe e o ka kgonang go kwala mo go yone e e nang le sebaka se se lekaneng sa go tshola motshameko le dintšhwafatso. O se ka wa supa difaele tse pedi mo bukeng e le nngwe.
Open Server Folder e bontsha lefelo la sebele la seva e e tlhophilweng. Open Backup Folder e bontsha lefelo la yone la bekapo; O se ka wa fopholetsa tsela epe fela go tswa mo leineng la yone.
BATHO BA BA BOLOKELEGILENG ba ka Tshela Gongwe le Gongwe Motshameko o ka nna wa boloka lefatshe mo AppData, Documents, koloi e nngwe, kgotsa tsamaiso ya yone ya go romela. Netefatsa lefelo la nnete la poloko ya motshameko pele ga o e boloka kgotsa o e fudusa.
Go fetola maina kgotsa go fudusa difoldara mo File Explorer ga go netefatse gore tsela nngwe le nngwe e e bolokilweng e tla tlhabololwa. Dirisa Synix's e e tshegediwang ya go tsenya/fetisa tsela ya tiro le go sekaseka ditsela pele ga tshimologo e e latelang. Maemo a a farologaneng le one a tlhoka gore go nne le dikgoro tsa netweke tse di sa thulaneng.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers e dirisa Dedicated Server Manager ya semmuso, e Synix e tshwanetseng go e baya mo pontsheng. Fa e bulega la ntlha, tlhopha Local/Console, tlhopha Continue to server configuration, tsenya server le world settings, mme o tlhophe Save & start. Dirisa molaodi wa maemo a a kwa godimo, mafatshe, di-mods, balaodi, le console ya yone. Synix e tshola sekai se mo foldareng ya seva ya Instance. Mokgwa wa Local/Console wa kwa pele ga o tlhoke ditshwanelo tsa motsamaisi; go dira tirelo ya Windows ga go dire jalo. Ditlhokego tsa semmuso ke .NET Framework 4.8 kgotsa e ntšhwa, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 le 2017, bonnye 6 GB ya tsamaiso RAM, le UDP port 27016 e letleletswe ka Windows Firewall mme e fetisetswa kwa go router go bapalami ba inthanete. Kaedi ya semmuso: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Mosireletsi o lebile dithulaganyo tse di lemogilweng tsa seva mme a ka simolola go busetsa morago morago ga go tswa go go sa solofelwang kgotsa bothata jo bo lemogilweng.
TIRO E E Tlwaelegileng Dirisa Synix's Stop and Restart controls go dira diphetogo ka boomo. Synix e rulaganya ditiro tseo le motlhokomedi gore fa go kopiwa gore e emisiwe go se ka ga tsewa e le kotsi.
Go tswala fensetere ya motshameko, go e bolaya mo Task Manager, kgotsa go e emisa ka motsamaisi yo mongwe go ka lebega go sa solofelwa mme ga dira gore o boele gape.
GO TLOGELA GANTSI Emisa seva ka Synix, go tswa foo o tlhatlhobe rekoto ya bofelo ya motshameko. Rarabolola bothata jwa runtime, configuration, port, memory, kgotsa mod pele o simolola gape. Go busediwa ga go ka ke ga baakanya mod e e sa tsamaelaneng kgotsa thulaganyo e e sa felelang ya motshameko.
Go palelwa ga thulaganyo le potso e e sa kgoneng go dirwa ke mathata a a farologaneng. Nako ya go fola e ikaegile ka motshameko le seemo sa gone jaanong, ka jalo o se ka wa tlhatlhoba tiego nngwe le nngwe ka go dirisa nako e le nngwe fela e go akanngwang gore ke ya go ikhutsa.
MEKGELO Synix e latedisa di-launcher tse di tshegediwang le dithulaganyo tsa bana tse di leng mo sevafong. Metšhini e e laolwang kwa ntle kgotsa ditirelo tsa go romela di ka nna tsa tshela lobaka lo loleele go feta motshameko mme di tlhoka ditaolo tse di leng mo motshamekong.
Tlhokomelo eno ga se sengwe se se ka emelang di-backup tse di netefaditsweng kgotsa go tlhokomela seva e e sa tswang go fetolwa fa e simololwa sentle.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Dirisa dikonopo tsa modikologo wa botshelo jwa Synix go dira tiro e e tlwaelegileng ya seva. Seno se dira gore motlhokomedi a kgone go bona pharologano fa gare ga go emisa koloi ka boomo le go e thula.
Simolola Tlhopha go tsena o bo o tlhopha Start once. Synix e tlhatlhoba ditlhokego tse di maleba, ditsela, dikgoro, le tlhokomelo e e tlhophilweng pele ga tshimologo, e baakanya difaele tse di tlhaelang tse di tshegediwang, mme e simolola seva. Letela matswela pele o leka gape.
Tlogela Tlhopha Stop mme o letle nako ya motshameko go boloka le go tswala. Synix e dirisa mokgwa wa go tima o o tshegediwang fa o le teng, go tswa foo o bo o dirisa mokgwa wa go emisa thulaganyo ka dikgato fa go tlhokega. Go kgaola ka dikgoka go ka dira gore kgatelopele e e sa bolokiwang e nyelele.
TSOGELETSA Tlhopha Restart go emisa setlhopha sa jaanong sa thulaganyo le go simolola sekai se sentšhwa. O se ka wa simolola khopi e nngwe ka seatla fa seno se ntse se direga.
FA KONOPANA E SE Kgonege Tirego e nngwe e ka nna ya bo e setse e na le seva, phitlhelelo e ka nna ya bo e le mo seemong sa phetogo, kgotsa motshameko oo o ka nna wa dirisa tiriso ya kwa ntle. Bala molaetsa wa tiro le bokgoni jwa porofaele.
Tila go bolaya seva mo Task Manager kgotsa go e emisa go tswa sedirisweng se se sa amaneng le sona sa tlamelo e e tlwaelegileng. Seo se ka dira gore go lebege e kete motho o tswile ka tsela e e sa lebelelwang mme seo se bo se dira gore a fole.
Metshameko e e laolwang ka metšhine ya thekenoloji kgotsa ka ditirelo tse di ntshiwang kwa ntle ga yone e tlhoka go tlhatlhobiwa ka tsela ya yone. Go tswalwa ga sedirisiwa sa go latlhela dibetsa ga go supe gore ditirelo tseo di emisitswe.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory e tlhoka setup sa ntlha mo motshamekong wa yone wa Server Manager. Synix e ka tsenya le go simolola seva e e neetsweng, mme ga e tseye sebaka sa go kopa seva kgotsa go tlhama seshene.
FETLHA Thulaganyo ya Motshameko 1. Tlhamo ya Satisfactory le go simolola mo Synix. 2. Leta gore seva e e neetsweng e fetse go laisa. 3. Bula Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager mme o tsenye kgotsa tlhopha seva. 4. E tshole, o beye khunololamoraba ya motsamaisi, mme o tsene jaaka motsamaisi. 5. Tlhopha kgotsa tshola thulaganyo e o batlang go e dirisa.
Synix e laola ditshwanelo tse di tshegediwang tsa go simolola/go rulaganya, go akaretsa boemakepe jwa go simolola le MaxPlayers. Difaele tse di maleba di mo go FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
CONNECT SYNIX 1. Tlhokomela gore seva e tsamaya ka -NewConsole. Check imported or older entries; fa o tsenya ntlha eno, simolola gape ka Synix. 2. Dirisa maemo a tetla a Windows a a tshwanang go Synix le seva, fa go kgonega ditetla tsa modirisi tse di tlwaelegileng. 3. Tlhopha seva eo mme o bule Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Tlhopha Connect automatically gangwe o bo o leta.
Synix e romela server.GenerateAPIToken, e bala dipholo tse di feletseng, e netefatsa API ya selegae, mme e boloka letshwao le le tsentsweng mo akhaontong ya gago ya Windows. Letshwao leno le naya motsamaisi tetla ya go tsena, e seng fela ya go lebela.
Dipegelo tsa katlego Token e netefaditswe le go bolokwa ka pabalesego mme e bula Overview. Ga go tlhokege gore o kopise mola wa khonsole kgotsa o tsenye letshwao ka seatla.
Fa go retelelwa, Synix e tshola kgokagano nngwe le nngwe e e bolokilweng mo nakong e e fetileng mme ga e leke taelo gape. Bala matswela a a rileng pele o leka gape.
Se se golaganya le seva e e tlhophilweng mo PC eno; ga e tlhoke molawana o montšhwa wa tsela ya Synix. Go simolola ka tlwaelo, go emisa, le go simolola gape go santse go dira ntle le letshwao la API.

data.value:
Tlhopha tsenyeletso ya dashboard mme o bule Diitlhophelwa tsa Server. Ke didirisiwa fela tse di tshegediwang ke profaele eo le boemo jwa yone jwa gone jaanong tse di tlamelwang.
DIFILE LE GO DI Boloka • Open Server Folder le Open Backup Folder di bula mafelo a a dirang. • Thulaganyo ya go rulaganya e bula difaele tsa thulaganyo ya motshameko tse di tshegediwang. • Update Server e tsaya kgatiso e e tshegediwang ya motshameko. • Netefatsa fa Game Files e tlhatlhoba kgotsa e baakanya difaele tse di laolwang ke motlhami. • Backup and Restore e boloka kgotsa e busetsa sedirisiwa se se tlhophilweng. • Create Batch File e romela script ya go simolola fa profile e e tshegetsa. • Go phimola go tlosa mokwalo mme go naya fela dikgetho tsa go phimola faele tse di bontshitsweng mo netefatsong ya one.
DIKOPANYO LE DITLHOGO TSA METLHO Tshedimosetso ya Kgolagano e bontsha diaterese, maemakepe le ditiro tsa go kopisa. Diteko tsa kgokaganyo, Mod & Plugin Manager, didiriswa tsa Minecraft, le Satisfactory Control Center di tlhagelela fa di tshegetswang.
TLHOKOMISA SERVER E E Dirang Tobetsa mo moleng wa yone gabedi go bona dintlha ka ga seva. Live Process Details e bontsha launchers tse di netefaditsweng, console hosts, le dithulaganyo tsa modiri tse di leng mo go seo. Motshameko wa dithulaganyo tse dintsi o ka nna le ID ya dithulaganyo tse di fetang e le nngwe.
Dirisa sesireletsi sa motswedi go tlhatlhoba CPU ya seva le hisetori ya segopotso. Dipalo tseno di farologane le tsa khomputara e e feletseng ya dashboard.
Go tswala dintlha kana fensetere ya motlhatlhobi wa didiriswa ga go emise motshameko. Dirisa letshwao la Stop fa e le gore o batla go dira jalo.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Tlhopha kgatiso ya Minecraft pele ga o tlhopha di-mods kgotsa dithulaganyo tsa kgolagano. Java le Bedrock ke mefuta ya di-server tse di farologaneng; Bedrock ga se mojaro wa Java.
TSAYA SERVER eno 1. Tlhopha Minecraft mme o tlhophe Java kgotsa Bedrock. 2. Go Java, tlhopha mofuta wa Minecraft, mojaro le mofuta o o tsamaelanang wa mojaro o o tlamelwang ke batlhophi. 3. Sekaseka lefatshe, mokgwa wa motshameko wa tlholego, tekanyetso ya motshameki, segopotso, maemakepe le masimo a tshireletsego a a tsentsweng tirisong. 4. Boloka le go simolola ka Synix. 5. Bala tumalano nngwe le nngwe pele ga o e amogela. 6. Letela lefatshe le feleletse go laisa, mme o ikgolaganye le kgatiso ya modirisi e e tsamaelanang le yona. 7. Boloka lefatshe la tiro pele o tsenya di-mods.
JAVA LE BEDROCK Ditlhopho tsa Java di akaretsa Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, le Purpur fa go na le dikago. Dirisa mofuta le go aga batlhophi; Paper le Purpur di dirisa di-plugins, fa Fabric, Forge le NeoForge di dirisa di-mods tsa tsone tse di tshwanang. Synix e tsaya nako e e tlhophilweng go tswa mo motlameding wa yone wa semmuso.
Bedrock e dirisa sephuthelwana sa semmuso sa Bedrock Dedicated Server mme ga e dirise Java.
TSAMAISANA LE MODIMO Tlhopha modulasetilo yo o tlhokwang ke di-mods tsa gago. Tshwana le mofuta wa Minecraft, mojaro, ditshegetso, le ditlhokego tsa letlhakore la modirisi.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, le diphuthelwana tsa plug-in-server ga di a fetofetoga. Go dira foldara ya di-mods kgotsa di-plugins ga go tsenye loader e e tlhokegang kgotsa thulaganyo ya seva. Browse Catalog ga se modpack e e itirisang kgotsa go tsenngwa ga dilo tse di ikaegileng ka yone.
TSHWANTSHO Configure e laola server.properties le thulaganyo e e rileng ya thulaganyo. Java gape e na le mokgwa wa Spectator. Boleng jwa setegeniki le ditaolo di nna mo sebopegong se Minecraft e se lebeletseng.
Go tswa go Server Options, bula Minecraft Control Center. Tsebe ya yone ya Settings e na le lenaane la difaele tsa thulaganyo tse di kgonang go baakanngwa tsa seva. Edit File e tlamela ka thulaganyo ya go fetola mokwalo; Structured Editor e tlamela ka thulaganyo e e leng teng ya go rulaganya. Bobedi bo boloka diphetogo fa seva e emisitswe. Ditlhwatlhwa tse di itsegeng tsa server.properties jaaka boemakepe, tekanyetso ya motshameki, lefatshe, peo, mokgwa, le thulaganyo ya go laola gape di tlhabolola tshupo e e bolokilweng ya Synix. Leina le le phasaladitsweng/MOTD le kgaogantswe le leina la go tsena la selegae. Dithulaganyo tsa mod tse di sa itsiweng di nna mo difaeleng tsa tsone.
Synix e buisa gape di-setting tse pele e baakanya go tsena kana go simolola, le fa Refresh e dirisiwa fa e emisitswe. Fa e le gore phetogo e e dirwang kwa ntle ga se ya nnete kgotsa e thulana le tse dingwe, baakanya bothata jo bo umakilweng go na le go simolola seva gangwe le gape. Morulaganyi o gana go kwala godimo ga faele e e fetotsweng fa e sale e bulwa; e bule gape go tsenya diteng tse disha.
GO FETOLA NAKO YA GO DIRWA GA SERVER Boloka khopi e e feletseng ya seva pele o fetola mefuta kgotsa di-loader. Tlhopha nako e ntšhwa ya go tsamaisa mo Setupong, boloka rekoto e e sekasekilweng, mme o tlhophe Apply Runtime in Minecraft Control Center. Synix e baakanya runtime ya semmuso ka go farologana, e boloka server.properties le difoldara tsa lefatshe, mme e rekota difaele tse di emisitsweng tsa runtime. Ga e dire gore server e simolole go dira ka boyone. Go simololwa go thibetswe fa nako e e gatisitsweng ya go dira le porofele e e tlhophilweng di sa dumalane.
Go busetsa morago faele ga go busetse morago diphetogo tsa lefatshe tse di dirilweng morago ga gore seva e simolole. O se ka wa akanya gore lefatshe le le bulwang ka Minecraft e ntšhwa kgotsa di-mods tse di farologaneng di ka tsenngwa ka pabalesego ke nako ya go dira e kgologolo; busetsa backup e e feletseng e e tsamaelanang le yone.
Emisa pele o fetola difaele tse di tlhokang go simololwa sesha. O se ka wa emisetsa lefatshe le le leng teng ka thempleite e ntšha jaaka tsela e khutshwane ya go baakanya.
FA BATLHAKANYI BA SA KGONA GO TSAYA DITLHOGO Tlhatlhoba kgatiso, mofuta wa motshameko/motshodi, di-mods tse di tlhokegang, le boemakepe/protocol ya kgatiso e e tlhophilweng. Fa o batla go tswa mo motshamekong ka bonako, tlhatlhoba log ya motshameko go bona fa go na le diphoso tsa tumalano, nako ya go dira, segopotso kgotsa go ikaega.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Bula Satisfactory Control Center morago ga go golaganya API ya selegae. Tlhopha tab ya tiro e o e tlhokang.
KGANGKGOLO Tlhopha Refresh go buisa leina la setlhopha, palo ya badiragatsi ba ba golagantsweng/molelwane, seemo sa motshameko, palogare ya lebelo, nako ya motshameko le maemo a thekenoloji.
Motshameki wa dashboard o bala ka go itsosolosa fa kgokagano e siame tafole ya kakaretso e ntšhwafadiwa fa o e kopa. API eno e re naya dipalo, e seng lenaane la batshameki. Thulaganyo e e emeng kgotsa seva e e emetseng thulaganyo ga se tirego e e emeng.
DITHULAGANYO TSA SERVER Tlhopha Refresh, edit supported values, go tswa foo Apply changes. Tlhatlhoba gape dipalo tse di saletseng morago fa o sena go baakanya. Ditlhopho dingwe di tlhoka go simololwa sesha; go dira diphetogo ga go dire gore motshameko o simolole gape.
Go baya dinotlolo le boleng jo bo amogetsweng go sala mo puong ya motshameko.
DITLHOGO TSE DI BOLOKILENG • Boloka jaanong: Tsenya leina kgotsa dirisa leina le le nang le letlha la Synix. Go dirisa leina gape go ka nna ga kwala mo godimo ga poloko e e setseng e le teng. • Load selected: Sekaseka tlhomamiso. Synix e boloka kgatelopele ya ga jaana pele fa thutopatlisiso e dira; go laisa go ka kgaoganya batshameki. • Upload save: E tsenya faele e o e tlhophileng mme e ka nna ya emisetsa faele e e bolokilweng e e nang le leina le le tshwanang. Ga e e tsenye ka tlhamalalo. • Download selected: E boloka khopi mo tseleng ya lefelo e o e tlhophileng.
Boloka kgatiso e e ikemetseng pele ga o emisetsa kgotsa o tsenya lefatshe lengwe le le botlhokwa. Diphetiso tsa go boloka di na le tekanyetso ya pabalesego ya 512 MB. API e ka nna ya se nne teng ka nakwana fa thulaganyo e ntse e laolwa.
KONSOLE E E GATLEGILENG Romela taelo e le nngwe ya motshameko o o tshegediwang ka nako mme o bale netefatso. Di-script, ditaolo tsa tokene/phasewete, le diphetogo tsa go tsena tse di sa sireletsegang di thibetswe fano.
Ditaolo tse di tshegediwang tsa go emisa di fetisediwa ka modikologo wa tiro ya go emisa wa Synix. Taelo e e ntshiwang e nna mo fensetereng eno go na le gore e romelwe kwa dashboard kgotsa di-log tsa mokwalo wa Synix; motshameko o ka nna wa bo o sa ntse o kwala direkoto tsa one.

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
DIFILE TSA MOTshameko wa BATLHABANA BA LE BANTSI DI KA NNA TSA Tlhokega:
Synix e tsenya sephuthelwana sa seva se se neetsweng mme ga e kgone go jarolla, go kopolola kgotsa go anamisa difaele tse di nang le laesense go tswa mo motshamekong o o tlwaelegileng. Fa seva e bega gore go na le sengwe se se tlhaelang mo motshamekong wa batho ba le bantsi kgotsa fa e sa bereke sentle fa o tshola kgotsa o fetola dimmapa, tsenya Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer ka Steam o dirisa akhaonto e e leng ya yone. Kopa diteng tsa motshameko wa mpsrc go tswa mo papatsong ya motshameko oo go tsena mo foldareng ya seva e e kgethegileng, mme o netefatse gore mapcycle.txt le maplist.txt di na le dimmapa tse o batlang go di tsamaisa.
Kgato eno e tshwanetse go wediwa ke modirisi yo o tsenyang seva. Mefuta ya metshameko ke 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, le 4 Colosseum.

Di-plugin tsa .smx tse di rulagantsweng di tsena mo tf/addons/sourcemod/plugins; dithanolo tse di tsamaisanang le tsone, gamedata le dilwana tse di atolositsweng di nna di ntse di na le difoldara tsa tsone tse di kwadilweng.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Bala maduo a Connect ka boone pele o leka gape. Taelo e e tlhagelelang mo sedirisiweng sa motshameko ga e bontshe gore go tsere letshwao, go le tlhomamisa le go le boloka tsotlhe di atlegile.
TLHALOSOLA BOSETLHOKWA JALO • Console ga e teng: Netefatsa -NewConsole, seva e e tlhophilweng, le maemo a tetla ya Windows. • Taelo e e sa felelang mo go se o se tsentseng: E tlose ka bowena. Synix ga e kitla e e kwala. • Taelo e a dira mme ga go na letshwao le le tserweng: Letla go simololwa go fele, tlhatlhoba di-log tsa motshameko tse di ka kwalwang, mme o letle gore go goroge dipholo tse di feletseng. • Di-filter di kgoreletsa: Tlosa di-filter tse di akaretsang/tse di sa akaretseng mme o letle sedirisiwa se tsiboge. • Kgoro ya API ke ya thulaganyo e nngwe: Baakanya kgoro ya motshameko e e rulagantsweng ya seva e e tlhophilweng. O se ka wa romela letshwao la yone kwa mothong yo o sa amaneng le yone. • Token e e gannweng kgotsa kgokagano e e bolokilweng ga e ka ke ya bulwa: Feleletsa thulaganyo e e leng ya motshameko, go tswa foo o ikgolaganye gape. • API ga e yo: Emela go simololwa kgotsa boloka go laisa o bo o tlhatlhoba log ya motshameko.
Karabo e ntšhwa e ka nna le boleng jo bo tshwanang jwa letshwao jaaka karabo ya pele. Tshwaro e dirisa dipholo tse di tlhagisitsweng morago ga taelo, e seng letshwao la bogologolo le le itlhophetsweng mo lokwalong.
TSHIRELETSA KGANG YA GO FITLHELA Satisfactory e gatisa matshwao a motsamaisi mo console ya yone le di log. Di boloke e le tsa sephiri mme o tlose mela ya matshwao mo ditshwantshong le mo dipegong.
Synix e netefatsa gore endpoint ya selegae ke ya seva e e tlhophilweng mme e beya setifikeiti sa yona. O se ka wa kgoreletsa ditlhatlhobo tsa setifikeiti go rarabolola bothata.
Tlosa tokene e e bolokilweng e phimola kgokagano e e bolokilweng ya Synix; ga e phimole letshwao mo seva.
Go busetsa morago di-tokens tsa tiriso tse di leng teng, dirisa server.InvalidateAPITokens mo khonsoleng ya seva ya Satisfactory kgotsa khonsoleng ya Molaodi wa Seva. Seno se ama gape le go kopanngwa ga tse dingwe tse di dirisang matshwao ao.
Fa e le ka akhaonto e nngwe ya Windows kgotsa go fudusiwa ga thulaganyo, ikgolaganye gape fa o sa kgone go dirisa kgokagano e e sireleditsweng e e bolokilweng.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Bala tiro ya bofelo ya seva e o e tlhophileng le log ya motshameko. Batla phoso ya ntlha e e diragetseng go na le fela molaetsa wa bofelo wa go tima.
GO TLOGELA GANTSI KA GO TLOGELA GANTSI KWA PELE 1. Tlhomamisa fa o tlhophile foldara ya tlhomamiso, executable, kgatiso ya motshameko, le loader. 2. Sekaseka difaele tse di tlhokegang, sebaka sa RAM/disk se se gololosegileng, le dikgoro tse di tserweng. 3. Tlatsa tumalano nngwe le nngwe, go saena mo akhaontong, ditlhokego tsa tokene, kgotsa thulaganyo ya motshameko. 4. Fa e le ka di-mods, bapisa motshameko, mojaro, ditlamelo, le ditlhokego tsa modirisi. 5. Emisa ka Synix pele o fetola difaele, mme o leke go simolola.
Motlhomisi yo o tshelang a ka sala morago ga gore seva ya nnete e retele. Servera e e itekanetseng e ka nna ya bo e letile go laisa lefatshe kana e na le potso e e sa kgonegeng/API. Tlhatlhoba dinaga tseo ka bongwe ka bongwe.
GO TLOGELA KANA GO TSOLA GANTSI GO Tsaya Nako Metshameko e tlhoka nako go boloka le go tswala dithulaganyo tsa badiri. Letela diphelelo tsa Synix mme o bale molaetsa wa yone wa go tima. Go boela morago go ka dira gore o latlhegelwe ke kgatelopele e e sa bolokiwang.
O se ka wa bolaya dithulaganyo ka nako e le nngwe, wa simolola khopi e nngwe, kana wa dirisa molaodi yo mongwe kgatlhanong le thulaganyo e e tshwanang.
SETLHOGO SA KA FA NTLE SE A HWALA Tlhatlhoba bokgoni jwa porofaele le seemo sa ga jaana. Ditlhopho dingwe di thibetswe ka gore motshameko o na le tsona kgotsa ga go na tsela ya tsamaiso e e tshegediwang. Tshedimosetso ya motshameki e e sa dirisiweng ga e reye gore go na le phoso mo sevafong.
Fa bothata bo tswelela pele, kwala kgato, phoso e e nepagetseng, le tshobokanyo e khutshwane ya log pele o dira diphetogo tse dingwe tse di sa amaneng.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
Go tsenya kgotsa go tlhabolola MODPACK ya Seva 1. Dira gore go nne le khopi e e feletseng ya server mme o e emise. Dirisa Synix ka tetla ya Windows e e tlwaelegileng. 2. Tlhoma mme o dirise mofuta wa pakete ya Minecraft e e nepagetseng, mojaro, le go aga mojaro pele. 3. Mo Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, tlhopha Import Server Pack. Tlhopha Modrinth .mrpack kgotsa ZIP e e feletseng ya seva e e nang le di-mods/di-plugins tsa nnete le difaele tsa thulaganyo. 4. Di-optional server mods di a tlolwa ntle fela le fa go tlhophilwe gore Include optional server mods. Go tsenngwa ga Modrinth ya modirisi fela le go sutisiwa ga modirisi ga go a tsenngwa. 5. Sekaseka matswela a go tlhatlhoba, ditlhatlhobo tsa metadata, diteng tse di tloditsweng, le faele nngwe le nngwe e e tshwanetseng go tsenngwa, go emisediwa kgotsa go tlosiwa. Tlhomamisa fela fa motswedi le diphetogo di tshwanela. 6. Simolola ka seatla fa o sena go e tsenya, bala console, mme o leke kgokagano ya modirisi e e tsamaelanang.
Morekantle ga a dirise di-script tse di tsentsweng mo paketeng, go emisetsa lefatshe, kgotsa go kwala godimo ga modi wa server.properties. Tsenya sephuthelwana sa modiri se se tletseng fa CurseForge ya moreki e na le lenane la ditsenyo fela. Ditshidiso tsa poraefete, di-host tse di sa tshegediweng, kgotsa di-loaders tse di sa tshegediweng di tlhoka gore mokwadi a tshegetse difaele tsa seva; Synix ga e fete dithibelo tsa motlamedi.
Modrinth downloads di tlhatlhobilwe ke hash. JAR metadata e e tshegetswang e tlhatlhobiwa go bona loader, diteng tsa modirisi fela, di-ID tse di kopantsweng, le ditshegetso tse di begilweng ntle le go tsamaisa JAR. Metadata e e sa itsiweng le mefuta ya dithanolo tse di raraaneng di tlhoka go sekasekwa. Go tlhatlhoba go go phepa kana go tlhoka dikgotlhang tse di lemogilweng ga go tlhomamise gore mod e babalesegile kana e a tsamaisana. Ditlamelo tse di tlhaelang ga di latlhiwe ka tidimalo.
Go tsenya gape pakete e e nang le leina le le tshwanang go ka tlosa di-JAR tsa yone tse di neng di tsamaisiwa pele tse di sa tlholeng di le teng, mme fela fa difaele tseo di sa ntse di tsamaisana le di-hashes tsa tsone tse di kwadilweng. JARs tse di sa laolweng le difaele tsa lefatshe ga di tlosiwe. Difaele tsa thulaganyo tse di tlamelwang ke pakete e ntšha di ka emisetsa tsa bogologolo; ponelopele e di bontsha pele ga o netefatsa. Boloka leina le le tshwanang la faele ya server-ZIP fa o tlhabolola pakete eo gore e lemogwe jaaka pakete e e tshwanang.
GO LAOLWA GA LEFATSHE Dirisa Worlds go kwala maina a dipolanete tse di lemogilweng. Import World ZIP e kopolola lefatshe le le tshwanang-kgatiso mo foldareng e ntshwa e e nang le leina; ga e kwale lefatshe le le leng teng kgotsa go fetola magareng ga Java le Bedrock. Tlhopha lefatshe le le tsentsweng mme o bo o tsenya Activate World go fetola leina la maemo le Synix's world setting mmogo. Tshimologo e e latelang e tsenya lefatshe le le tlhophilweng. Go fetolwa ga peo go ama go bopiwa ga lefatshe le lesha, e seng lefelo le le leng teng.
GO BOELETSA BOPHELO Tsosoloso e supa diphetogo tsa faele tse di dirilweng ke lefelo leno la tiro. Go busetsa morago go busetsa difaele tse di rekotilweng tsa pele kgotsa go tlosa difaele tse di tlisitsweng ke phetogo eo. Tlogela lefatshe le o le tlisitseng pele ga o dira gore le se ka la tlhola le nna gone. Fa difaele di ne tsa baakanngwa morago ga moo, Synix e gana go di kwala mo godimo ga tsone; boloka dilo tse o di baakantseng mme fa go tlhokega o dirise khopi e e feletseng e e tshwanetseng.
Tlhatlhobo e e santseng e emetse go busediwa e thibetswe go simolola go fitlha go busediwa go weditswe mme rekoto e e bolokilweng e dumalana le difaele tse di buseditsweng. Ditsamaiso tsa bogologolo tse di se nang porofilo e e kwadilweng ya runtime di tlhoka gore go dirwe backup e e feletseng gore e kgone go busediwa gape. Di-backup di sala e le di-backup tse di feletseng tsa server-folder, tse di ikemetseng ka nosi go tswa mo direkotong tsa diphetogo.
Morago ga go busetsa kwa morago ka katlego, direkoto tsa bogologolo tsa phetogo ya lefelo la tiro di tshwaiwa jaaka tse di emiseditsweng ke khopi eo. Di nna di ntse di le teng gore o kgone go di bona mme di ka se ke tsa busediwa morago fa di bapisiwa le difaele tse di tsosolositsweng. Go tsenya kgotsa go fetola diteng morago ga go busetsa go dira direkoto tse dintšhwa tsa go busetsa.
DI-DIAGNOSTICS LE DISCHEDULES Diagnostics e bala di-log tsa bosheng le dipegelo tsa go thulana ga Java, memori, go ikaega, boemakepe, lefatshe, le mathata a nako ya go dira. Fa go se na mokgwa o o lemogilweng ga se bosupi jwa gore seva e siame. Tshebetso e bula sesebediswa sa ho lekola; Dikalafi tsa CPU le RAM ga di tseye maemo a go dira diporofaele tsa ditshenekegi tsa naga.
Dithulaganyo di bula Synix e e leng teng ya go simolola sesha le thulaganyo ya tlamelo. Tlhopha malatsi a o a batlang, nako, boitshwaro jwa go leta ga motshameki, go boloka, le go tlhabolola diitlhophelwa, mme o bo o sekaseka le go boloka. Lefelo la tiro ga le dire thulaganyo ya bobedi kgotsa go fetola thulaganyo ya gago ka tlhamalalo.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Tlhopha seva ya Minecraft, o bo o bula Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Ditsebe tsa Console le Players di tshola didirisiwa tsa taolo le tsa motshameki mmogo. Ditsebe tse dingwe di na le dithulaganyo, lefatshe, ditlaleletso, di-backup tse di feletseng tsa seva, go simolola sesha thulaganyo, go tsosolosa, le go tlhatlhoba.
DIKANALA TSA GO LAELA Dikagego tse di tshegediwang di ka dirisa Synix-e e laolwang ke khonsole, kanala ya tsamaiso e e tshegediwang ya localhost, kgotsa RCON ya boikgethelo. Seteishene se se leng teng se ikaegile ka kgatiso le tsela e sedirisiwa se rulagantsweng ka yone.
Fensetere ya tlholego e e fitlhegileng e santse e ka tlogela tsela ya taolo ya selegae e e tshegediwang e le teng. Fa e le gore ditsamaiso di thibetswe, tlhatlhoba gore a seva e a dira le gore dithulaganyo tsa yone tsa tsamaiso di siame.
DITSHWANTSHO TSE DI RULENG Fa e tshegeditswe, Synix e neelana ka dikitsiso, manane a badiragatsi, tekanyetso, phetogo ya motsamaisi le lenane la ba ba letleletsweng, taolo ya nako/boemo jwa loapi le go boloka.
Tlhopha motshameki yo o ikaelelang go tshameka le go bala tiro pele ga o e tlhomamisa. Go naya motsamaisi tetla ya go tsena mo motshamekong go dira gore a nne le ditshwanelo tse di botlhokwa tsa go tshameka. O se ka wa e aba fela gore o rarabolole bothata jwa go golaganya dilo.
Ditaolo tsa RAW Dirisa mokwalo o o lebeletsweng mo kgatisong eo. Ditaolo tse di jaaka lenane le go boloka tsotlhe ke ditsenngwateng tsa motshameko mme ga di fetolelwe ka segokaganyi sa Synix. Tlhatlhoba melawana ya taolô ya motshameko pele o romela taelo e e fetolang lefatshe kgotsa tetla.
DIPALO LE MAINA Potso e ka naya palo ya batshameki kwa ntle ga gore go nne le lenaane la batshameki. Tafole ya maina e e se nang sepe ka boyone ga e supe gore ga go na ope yo o amanang.
Dirisa letshwao la Stop kgotsa Restart fa go na le diphetogo mo modikologong wa botshelo jwa didirisiwa gore motlhokomedi a itse gore o ne a ikaeletse go di tima.
Boloka RCON e o sa e tlhophang kgotsa mafelo a go e dirisa mo lefelong la lona, ntle le fa o na le thulaganyo e e sireletsegileng ya go e laola o le kgakala. Motshameko wa phatlalatsa ga o tlhoke go senola dintlha tseo kgotsa dintlha tsa bofelo.
