SYNIX CONTROL PANEL ‡ LICENSE E E FITLHILENG KWA LEKWALONG LA MOTHO
Tshekatsheko ya laesense 1.4 November 11, 2026
Eno ke thanolo ya laesense, e seng mofuta wa app ya Synix. Ditshwanelo tsa Mokwadi © 2026 Jason Turner. Ditshwanelo tsotlhe di sireleditswe. U.S. Kopo ya go Kwadisiwa ga Ditshwanelo Tsa Bokaedi: E santse e le teng
Laesense eno e dira mo software ya Synix Control Panel, go akaretsa khoutu ya yone ya motswedi, di-binary tse di rulagantsweng, segokaganyi sa modirisi, ditokomane, ditshwantsho, matshwao le dilo tse dingwe tse di akareditsweng (tse ka kakaretso di bidiwang "Software").
Dikarolo tsa 13 le 14 gape di tlhalosa ditlwaelo tsa khupamarama tsa webosaete ya semmuso ya Synix, khaontara ya tiro, le motsamaisi wa kgololosego wa sekgala. Di tlhalosa tirelo ya ga jaana; ga di fetole laesense ya botho, e e seng ya kgwebo e e neelwang fa tlase fano.
1. Boikarabelo
Software eno e na le laesense, ga e rekisiwe.
Jason Turner o na le ditshwanelo tsotlhe, seriti le dikgatlhego tsa go nna le seabe mo Thekenolong eno, go akaretsa le ditshwanelo tsotlhe tsa go gatisa le ditshwanelo tse dingwe tsa dithoto tsa botlhale. Ga go na ditshwanelo dipe tsa go nna mong wa yone tse di fetisediwang mo go wena ka laesense eno.
2. Go Neelwa ga Laesense e e lekanyeditsweng
Go ya ka ditumelelano tsotlhe tsa laesense eno, o fiwa laesense e e lekanyeditsweng, e e sa akaretseng fela, e e sa fetogeng, e e sa rebolweng, e e sa rebolweng gape e e ka phimolwang go:
- Itseele o bo o dirise Software eno ka maikaelelo a gago, e seng a kgwebo. - Leba le go ithuta khoutu ya motswedi. - Dira dikhopi tsa gago gore o di dirise. - Fetola khoutu ya motswedi gore o e dirise ka namana, e seng mo kgwebong. - Rulaganya o bo o dire diphetogo tsa gago mo didirisiweng tse o nang le tsone kgotsa tse o di laolang.
Ditshwanelo dipe fela tse di sa fiwang ka tlhamalalo ke laesense eno di bolokilwe ke mong wa ditshwanelo.
3. Diphetogo Tse Motho a di Dirang
O ka nna wa fetola Software gore e dumalane le dilo tse o di tlhokang.
Diphetogo tsa gago di tshwanetse go nna sephiri ntle le fa Jason Turner a go naya tetla e e kwadilweng ya go di anamisa.
Ga o a letlelelwa go phasalatsa, go tsenya, go abelana, go golola, go anamisa, kgotsa go dira gore khoutu ya motswedi e e fetotsweng kgotsa di-binary tse di fetotsweng di nne teng mo bathong jaaka mofuta o o farologaneng wa Synix.
4. Dithibelo
O ka se, kwa ntle ga tetla e e kwadilweng go tswa go Jason Turner:
4.1 Tiriso ya kgwebo
- Go rekisa, go hira, go adima, go naya laesense, laesense e potlana, kgotsa go duedisetsa Software. - Go rekisa kgotsa go anamisa di-binary tse di fetotsweng kgotsa tse di sa fetolwang. - Dirisa Software kgotsa khouto ya yone e le karolo ya sengwe se se duelelwang kgotsa tirelo ya kgwebo. - Go dira poelo ka tlhamalalo kana e se ka tlhamalalo ka go anamisa, go aba dilaesense, go fetola leina la gago, kana go dira gore o kgone go fitlhelela Software.
4.2 Redistribution le Hosting ya botlhe
- Tsenya Software eno mo webosaeteng e nngwe, mo lefelong la go boloka tshedimosetso, mo lefelong le lengwe la go itseela tshedimosetso, mo lefelong le lengwe la go abelana difaele kgotsa mo lebenkeleng le lengwe la ditirelo. - Go anamisa khouto ya tshimologo kana di-binary tse di kopantsweng, e ka tswa e fetotswe kana e sa fetolwa. - Dira kgotsa phasalatsa di-installer tse e seng tsa semmuso, diphuthelwana tse o ka kgonang go di tsenya mo sedirisiweng sa gago, diipone, kgotsa dilenke tsa go di itseela. - Go gatisa dikgatiso tse di gololwang go tswa mo forking kgotsa khopi e e fetotsweng ya Software. - Tlhagisa foroko, phetogo, kana mofuta o o tswang mo go yone jaaka selo se se ikemetseng ka nosi kana se se gaisanang le sone.
4.3 Rebranding le Attribution
- Go tlosa, go fitlha, kgotsa go fetola leina la Synix, dikitsiso tsa ditshwanelo, ditlankana tsa mokwadi, dikitsiso tsa laesense, matshwao, kgotsa tlhaloso. - Tlhopha leina le lengwe kgotsa letshwao le lesha la Software gore o kgone go e gatisa kgotsa go e anamisa. - Go bolela gore o tlhodile Software ya ntlhantlha. - Dirisa leina la Synix kgotsa letshwao la yone ka tsela e e dirang gore go lebege e kete ke motshegetsi, o a e amogela, ke molekane wa yone kgotsa e na le maemo a semolao.
4.4 Reverse Engineering le Tshireletso Bypass
Go ya ka selekanyo se se letleletsweng ke molao o o dirang, ga o a tshwanela go dira boenjeniri jo bo boeletsang kwa morago, go kgaoganya, go tlhatlhamolola, kgotsa go leka ka tsela epe fela go itlhokomolosa dikitsiso tsa laesense, go supa gore motho ke mang, dikarolo tsa tshireletsego, ditlhatlhobo tsa ntšhwafatso, kgotsa letshwao le le mo kgatisong ya semmuso e e rulagantsweng.
Thibelo eno ga e thibele ditshwanelo dipe tse di ka se kang tsa ganelwa tse molao o o dirang o go neelang tsone ka tlhamalalo.
5. GitHub Diforoko le Dikabelo
Polokelo ya semmuso ya Synix e ka bonwa ke botlhe mo GitHub. Sethala sa GitHub se ka letla badirisi go bona le go kgaoganya polokelo ya setšhaba ka tiriso ya tiragatso e e ageletsweng ya GitHub.
Foroko ya GitHub ga e go fe tetla ya go:
- Phasalatsa kgatiso e e seng ya semmuso ya Synix. - Go anamisa di-binary tse di fetotsweng kgotsa tse di sa fetolwang. - Leina le lesha Synix. - Dirisa tsebe e e farologaneng ya go itseela dikgatiso kgotsa seipone. - Dira gore foroko e nne software ya gago. - Go anamisa Thekenoloji eno gape kwantle ga gore e dirisiwe ka tsela e e lekanyeditsweng ke GitHub.
Diforoko tsa GitHub di ka dirisiwa fela go sekaseka khoutu, go baakanya tshwaelo, kgotsa go romela kopo ya go ntsha mo bobolokelong jwa semmuso jwa Synix. Diphetogo tsa botho tse di sa romelweng jaaka kabelo di tshwanetse go nna tsa selegae le tsa poraefete.
Ka go romela khoutu ya motswedi, ditokomane, ditshwantsho kgotsa dikabelo tse dingwe kwa bobolokelong jwa semmuso jwa Synix, o supa gore o na le tshwanelo ya go di romela le go naya Jason Turner laesense e e sa feleng, ya lefatshe ka bophara, e e sa ikgatholosegeng, e e sa gogelegeng morago, e e sa dueleng lekgetho go dirisa, go ikatisa, go fetola, go gatisa, go anamisa, go naya dilaesense tse dingwe, le go tsenya dikabelo tseo mo go Synix.
6. Synix Leina le letshwao
Leina la Synix, letshwao, boitshupo jwa ditshwantsho le matshwao a a amanang le tsone e nna e le thoto ya ga Jason Turner.
Laesense eno ga e neye motho tetla ya go dirisa letshwao la kgwebo kgotsa letshwao le lengwe fa e se fela go bontsha leina le letshwao le le sa fetolwang la Synix fa o dirisa Software ka namana.
Tiriso e e sa letlelelwang ya letshwao la Synix e ka nna ya tlola molao o o maleba wa tetlokhopi, letshwao la kgwebo, kgaisano e e sa siamang kgotsa melao e mengwe.
7. Go fedisiwa
Ditshwanelo tsa gago go ya ka laesense eno di tla fela ka tlhamalalo fa o tlola dipeelo dingwe tsa laesense eno.
Morago ga go kgaola, o tshwanetse go:
- Tlogela go dirisa le go fetola Software. - Tlogela go anamisa kgotsa go bontsha khopi epe fela e e sa letlelelwang. - Tlosa dikhopi tsa phatlalatsa tse di sa letlelelwang, tse di gatisitsweng, tse di tshwanang le tsone, kgotsa tse di tserweng mo sedirisiweng se o se laolang. - Phimola dikhopi tsa gago fa molao o batla gore o dire jalo.
Dikarolo tse di malebana le go nna mong, dithibelo, meneelo, go se ikarabele le go patelediwa go diragatsa molao ga di fele fa o fedisiwa.
8. Tiragatso
Mong wa ditshwanelo tsa mokwadi a ka dirisa ditsela dipe fela tse di leng teng go ya ka molao o o dirang malebana le go kopolola, go anamisa, go baya tshedimosetso mo Internet, go rekisa, go fetola leina kgotsa go tlola molao ka tsela e nngwe e e sa letlelelwang.
Ditharabololo tse di leng teng di ka akaretsa dikopo tsa go tlosa, ditsamaiso tsa go tlosa sejanaga, dikgato tsa thibelo, ditshenyegelo le ditharabololo tse dingwe tsa selegae fa go le maleba go ya ka molao.
Ga go na sepe mo laesense eno se se tlhomamisang gore kgato nngwe le nngwe e e rileng ya go pateletsa gore molao o diragadiwe kgotsa tharabololo e tla nna teng mo nageng nngwe le nngwe.
9. Go se Ikarabele le go Fokodiwa ga Boikarabelo
SOFTWARE E FANTSWE E LE E E NENG E LE GONA LE E E BONALENG, E SE NA TLAMAELO YA MOTHO NNGWE fela, e ka tswa e le e e tlhamaletseng kgotsa e e sa tlhamalalang, go akaretsa ditlamelo tsa gore e ka rekisiwa, e siametse boikaelelo bongwe jo bo rileng, e na le leina le gore ga e tlole molao.
GO FITLHA FELA kafa molao o letlelelang ka teng, JASON TURNER GA A KARABELWE KE DIKOTSI dipe tse di tlhamaletseng, tse di sa tlhamalalang, tse di diregileng ka phoso, tse di kgethegileng, tse di bakilweng ke sengwe kgotsa tse di diregileng ka tsela e e rileng, kgotsa go latlhegelwa ke tshedimosetso epe fela, dipoelo, lotseno, difaele tsa server, mafelo a metshameko, kgwebo, kgotsa go nna gone ga ditirelo tse di bakilweng ke kgotsa tse di amanang le SOFTWARE kgotsa tiriso ya yone.
O na le boikarabelo jwa go boloka di-backup le go tlhomamisa gore Software eno e siametse thulaganyo ya gago le lefelo le o tshamekang mo go lone.
10. Dikarolo tsa Batho ba Boraro
Software ya batho ba bangwe, dilaeborari, difaele tsa seva sa metshameko, dikarolo tsa SteamCMD, matshwao a kgwebo le dilo tse dingwe ke tsa beng ba tsone mme di ntse di laolwa ke dilaesense le melawana ya tsone.
Laesense eno e dira fela mo dikarolong tsa Synix e e leng ya ga Jason Turner.
11. Tumelelo e e Kwadilweng
Ditshupetso tsa laesense eno di dira fela fa Jason Turner a di kwadile.
Dipotso kgotsa dikopo tsa tetla di tshwanetse go romelwa ka tsela ya ofisi ya Synix GitHub kgotsa tsela e nngwe ya semmuso ya go ikgolaganya le Synix.
12. Metswedi ya semmuso ya go itseela
Bona Synix fela mo metsweding eno ya semmuso:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Dikhopi tse di tswang mo di-website tse dingwe ga di a tlhomamisiwa ke Jason Turner mme di ka tswa di sa sireletsega, di fetotswe, di siilwe ke nako kgotsa di na le software e o sa e batleng. Jason Turner ga a kgone go tlhomamisa gore di sireletsegile e bile ke tsa mmatota.
Go tsenya Synix mo lenaaneng, go golaganya le GitHub, kgotsa go ntsha kgatiso e o ka e itseelang ga go dire gore e nne ya gago kgotsa go kaya gore o na le tetla, o amana le yone, o a e amogela kgotsa o na le maemo a semmuso. Synix e sa ntse e le ya ga Jason Turner.
Go tshola, go dira di-mirroring, go romela ka moemedi, go phuthela gape kgotsa go phuthela dilo tse di tserweng mo Internet go tlhoka gore motho a nne le tetla e e kwadilweng pele. Go golaganya le motswedi wa semmuso ga go neye tetla eo.
Karolo ya 4.2 ga e thibele go golaganya ka tlhamalalo le metswedi eno ya semmuso e e supang sentle gore Synix le Jason Turner ke batho ba ba ntseng jalo. Di-link tse di ntseng jalo ga di dire gore website e e golaganyang e nne motswedi wa semmuso.
Phuthelwana ya WinGet ubidzz.Synix ke mokgwa o o amogetsweng wa go tsenya fa e tsenya thulaganyo ya go tsenya e e sa fetolwang ka tlhamalalo go tswa mo kgatisong ya semmuso ya GitHub. Seno ga se letlelele gore motho wa boraro a tshole kgotsa go phuthela gape.
13. Live Activity Counter le go Nna Boinotšing
Synix e na le selekano sa tiragatso se se tlhophang se se fopholetsang palo ya dikopano tsa Synix tse di tserweng mo https://synix.info. O ka e tima nako nngwe le nngwe mo Settings > Privacy & Security > Share active count kwa ntle ga go lekanyetsa dikarolo tse dingwe tsa Synix. Tlhopho e e sa bolong go bolokiwa e a tlotliwa.
Fa e tshubilwe, Synix e romela letshwao la go nna teng ga HTTPS kwa go https://synix.info/api/presence fa e simololwa le mo e ka nnang metsotso mengwe le mengwe ya 10 fa app e ntse e dira, go akaretsa kwa morago. Sesupo se na le khoutu ya nakwana e e itlhophileng ya thulaganyo le nomoro ya go supa tiriso ya Synix, mme ga e na mmele wa molaetsa. Khoutu ya setlha e bolokiwa fela mo mogopolong mme e emisediwa fa go simololwa setlha se sesha sa pegelo; ga se sesupo sa leruri sa sediriswa.
Seelo ga se tsenye leina la gago, aterese ya imeile, diphasewete, tshedimosetso ya seva kgotsa ya motshameki, boleng jwa thulaganyo, difaele kgotsa matshwao a motšhini.
Mo thulaganyong nngwe le nngwe, khomputara ya website e boloka fela khoutu ya thulaganyo le nako ya letshwao la yone la bofelo. Webosaete ya setšhaba e bontsha fela palogotlhe ya mananeo a a dirang, e leng tekanyetso go na le palo ya batho ba ba farologaneng. Thulaganyo e emisa go bala morago ga metsotso e le 15 kwa ntle ga letshwao. Direkoto tse di sa direng tsa khaontara di nna le tshwanelo ya go phepafadiwa morago ga metsotso e le 30 mme di a tlosiwa fa dikopo tse di latelang tsa khaontara di phepafatsa. Synix ga e golaganye direkoto tseno tsa khaontara le diakhaonto tsa motsamaisi wa sekgala kgotsa matshwao a khomputara.
Go tima karolo eno go emisa matshwao a mangwe a go nna teng mme go dira kopo e le nngwe ya gore go tlosiwe thulaganyo e o leng mo go yone. Go tswala Synix le gone go leka go tlosa; fa o sa kgone go fitlhelela webosaete e o batlang go e ntsha mo go yone, thulaganyo ya go bala e tla emisa ka bonako fela morago ga nako e o sa direng sepe ka yone.
Fela jaaka go ntse ka kgokagano nngwe le nngwe ya Internet, ditirelo tsa go tshola webosaete di amogela tshedimosetso e e tlwaelegileng ya kgokagano, jaaka aterese ya IP le nako ya kopo, mme ba ka e dira kgotsa ba e kwala go ya ka melawana ya bone ya khupamarama. Tshedimosetso eno ga e a bolokiwa mo tafoleng ya Synix ya go bala ditiro kgotsa go bontshiwa mo palong ya setšhaba.
14. Tshireletsego le Bosaitsiweng jwa go Tsena ka Kgakala
14.1 Go sa patelesege go tsena le go se rekisiwe ga data
Tsamaiso ya sekgala kwa https://manager.synix.info ke e e sa tlhokegeng mme ga e dire go fitlha o kopanya khomputara le go amogela akhaonto e e kopang mo sedirisong sa Synix mo khomputareng eo. O ka dirisa Synix mo lefelong la gago ntle le akhaonto ya motsamaisi. Go na le khaontara ya ditiro tsa botlhe e e ikemetseng mme e ka thibelwa ka boyone.
Synix ga e rekise, go hira, go gweba, kgotsa go senola tshedimosetso ya akhaonto ya gago, tshedimosetso ya khomputara e e kopantsweng, tiro e e kgakala, kgotsa tshedimosetso ya seva go babapatsi kgotsa barekisi ba data. Synix ga e dirise tshedimosetso eno go phasalatsa ka yone kgotsa go dira dipapatso tse di rileng ka yone. Tshedimosetso e dirisediwa go go naya dilo tse o di tlhophileng, go tlhomamisa gore a o kgona go tsena mo go tsone, go tsamaisa tirelo le go e sireletsa gore e se ka ya dirisiwa ka tsela e e sa tshwanelang.
Go fitlhelela tshedimosetso ka tsela e e kgakala ga se tirelo e go sa bolokiweng sepe mo go yone. E tlhoka rekoto ya akhaonto e e lekanyeditsweng, go kopanngwa, tiragatso le tshireletsego tse di tlhalosiwang fa tlase. Direkoto tseno ga di phasaladiwe mo khaontareng ya ditiro tsa setšhaba kgotsa go bontshiwa diakhaonto tse dingwe tsa batsamaisi ka tirelo eno.
14.2 Se se Nnang mo Khomputareng ya Gago
Synix ga e tsenye lefatshe la motshameko, difaele tsa seva ya motshameko, diteng tsa faele ya thulaganyo, diteng tsa faele ya polokelo, dipholo tse di sa dirwang tsa khonsole, kgotsa diphasewete tse di bolokilweng tsa seva ya motshameko. Go dira di-backup le go di busetsa kgakala mo khomputareng e e golagantsweng; Tsamaiso ya go boloka le go busetsa kgakala mo khomputareng e e kopantsweng; Difaele tsa polokelo di nna mo mafelong a a rulagantsweng koo. Fa o tlhopha go kwala taelo ya khomputara ya motshameko mo website eno, mafoko a yone a a kwalwa a bo a romelwa kwa khomputareng e e kopantsweng le yone, go akaretsa le dilo tse di botlhokwa tse o di kwadileng mo temaneng eo. Motsamaisi ga se polokelo ya poloko ya leru mme ga a neelane ka desktop e e kgakala e e sa thibelwang, Windows go fitlhelela taelo-potlako, kgotsa go lebelela faele ka kakaretso.
Synix e boloka diseting tsa yone tsa selegae, lenaane la di-server, hisetori, di-backup, le boemo jwa go kopanya mo khomputareng ya gago. Senotlolo sa khomputara se sala mo polokelong ya Windows. Synix e rata polokelo e tshehetswang ke TPM ha e le teng mme ka tsela e nngwe e tshehetsa senotlolo sa software se sireleditsweng ke Windows, ho kenyeletsa le di-VM tse sebeletsanang. Go nna teng ga TPM ga go tlhomamise gore khomputara ga e na mathata.
Dipolelo tse di tlhalosa tsamaiso ya sekgala sa Synix. Metshameko, Steam, di-mods, Discord tse di kopantsweng, diromelwantle le dipegelo tsa tshegetso tse o tlhophang go di abelana di na le melapo ya tsona ya data. O se ka wa tsenya diphasewete kgotsa tshedimosetso e nngwe e e botlhokwa mo maineng a dikhomputara, maina a di-server kgotsa maina a difaele tse di bolokilweng, ka gonne matshwao ao a ka nna a tlhaga mo molaoding.
14.3 Tshedimosetso e Molaodi a e Dirang le go e Boloka
- Account and authentication: Leina la modirisi le o le tlhophileng, ID ya akhaonto, nako ya go e tlhama, dilo tse o di ratang tsa tshireletsego, hash e e nang le letswai ya phasewete, sephiri se se tsentsweng mo khomputareng fa se letleletswe, dintlha tsa go ikwadisa tsa senotlolo sa go tsena fa se letleletswe, le direkoto tsa nakwana tsa netefatso/kopano. Mafaratlhatlha le dikhoutu tsa netefatso di a sekasekwa go netefatsa fa motho a ikwadisa; diphasewete tsa leruri ga di a bolokiwa jaaka mokwalo o o ka balwang. Synix ga e amogele letshwao la gago la monwana, setshwantsho sa sefatlhego, senotlolo sa poraefete sa sephiri, kana senotlolo sa poraefete sa go saena sa khomputara e e kopantsweng. Go ikwadisa ga go tlhoke leina la mmatota kgotsa aterese ya e-mail. - Go golaganya le go golaganya: Letshwao la khomputara le o le tlhophileng, nomoro e e tlhaolang sedirisiwa se o se dirisang ka tsela e e rileng, senotlolo sa yone sa go saena sa botlhe, go golaganya akhaonto, mofuta wa motho yo o go nayang dinotlolo tse di begilweng, boemo jwa go letlelela go golaganya le nako ya kgokaganyo ya bofelo. Kgokagano e e didimetseng ya relay e ka nna e butswe fa Synix e ntse e dira gore webosaete e kgone go tsosa app e e kopantsweng ka bonako. Mogala ono o na le melaetsa ya go tsosa/go kgaoganya le metadata ya kgokaganyo, e seng difaele tsa motshameko kgotsa ditshwantsho tse di tserweng mo sevafong. - Maemo a a bontshiwang: Di-ID tsa servers tse di lekanyeditsweng, maina, maina a metshameko, maemo a go tshameka, dipalo tsa batshameki, nako ya go tshameka, ditiro tse di leng teng, nako/maemo a bofelo a go dira di-backup, dipalo tse di kopantsweng tsa CPU le RAM tse di tswang mo ditiragalong tsa servers tsa metshameko (go akarediwa le di-launcher tse di latelwang le badiri ba tsone), le CPU e e kgaogantsweng ya khomputara yotlhe, e e dirisitsweng/ palogotlhe ya RAM, le dipalo tsa go romela/go amogela mo netweke. Ditheko tsa marang-rang a dikhomputara di akaretsa pharakano ya LAN mo dithulaganyong tse di dirang tsa kgoro; matshwao a adapter, diaterese tsa IP, diteng tsa sephuthelwana le mafelo a go leba ga di romelwe mmogo le dipalo tse. App eno e romela tshobokanyo eno fa pono ya mookamedi e ntse e dira. Ditlhabololo tsa CPU/RAM di akaretsa dikhomputara tse di kopantsweng; tshedimosetso e e feletseng e e malebana le khomputara e e tlhophilweng. Ditlhabololo ka tlwaelo di dira mo motsotswaneng mongwe le mongwe wa 10 mme di a ema morago ga go tswalwa, go kgaolwa, go felelwa ke nako, kgotsa go iphitlha jaaka go tlhokega. Di-browser tse dingwe tse di dirang di ka nna tsa dira gore tsela e di lebang dilo ka yone e tswelele e bereka. - Ditiro tse di kopilweng le di-backup: Ditshupo tsa seva/ditshupo, nako ya kopo, tswelelopele/phetogo, mme fa o kopa di-backup, di-backup, maina a difaele, matlha, bogolo, le matshwao a boikanngo. Diteng tsa bekapo le ditsela tse di feletseng tsa selegae ga di a romelwa ka mokgwa ono. - Ditaolo tsa khomputara ya motshameko: Letshwao le le sa bonaleng sentle le le supang fa motshameko o ntse o tsweletse, tumelelo ya go lotlolola e e tsayang nako e khutshwane, le taelo e o e romelang. Mokwalo o o emetseng go romelwa o kwalwa ka khomputara mo teng ga database ya tirelo mme o tlosiwa mo rekotong eo fa e romelwa. Ga e a akarediwa mo lenaaneng la ditiro tsa bosheng kgotsa mo direkotong tsa tlhagiso ya akhaonto. Go romelwa ga molaetsa go raya gore o rometswe mo motshamekong, e seng gore motshameko o o amogetse kgotsa o o weditse. Dikarabo tsa motshameko le setlhare sa thulaganyo ya selegae ga di tsenyelediwe. - Tshireletsego le go thibela tiriso e e sa tshwanelang: Mofuta wa go tsena o o paletsweng, palo ya maiteko a a rulagantsweng le dinako, mofuta wa tiragalo ya go busetsa/tshireletso, le matshwao a a maleba a khomputara. Direkoto tsa tekanyetso ya kelo ya botshelo jo bokhutshwane di ka dirisa di-hash tse di nang le dinotlolo tsa diaterese tsa kgokaganyo tsa IP le diitshupo tsa diakhaonto. Direkoto tsa account-alert tsa Synix ga di na diphasewete tse di lekilweng, dikhoutu tsa netefatso, diaterese tsa IP tse di sa dirwang, kgotsa menwana ya sebadi. Moabi wa ditirelo tsa go tshola tshedimosetso a ka nna a dirisa tshedimosetso ya kgokaganyo ka tsela e e farologaneng jaaka go tlhalositswe mo karolong ya 14.6.
Webosaete e tshwanetse go dira dikakgelo le ditaelo tse di letleletsweng gore e tle e kgone go di laola kgakala. HTTPS le dikgolagano tse di tsentsweng mo khomputareng di sireletsa pharakano fa e le mo tseleng; se ga se bolele gore tirelo ya go tshola tshedimosetso ga e kgone go dira tshedimosetso.
14.4 Go boloka le go phimola
- Dintlha tsa akhaonto le di-setting di nna di ntse di le teng go fitlha akhaonto e phimolwa. Direkoto tsa go kopanya tse di amogetsweng di nna di ntse di le teng go fitlha khomputara e sa kopanngwa kgotsa akhaonto e phimolwa. - Ditshwantsho tsa maemo le dipalo tsa CPU/RAM di kwalwa mo godimo ke dipalo tse disha mme di nna di siametse go phepafadiwa morago ga metsotso ya 15 kwantle ga go emisediwa. Nako ya kgokagano ya bofelo e sala e le karolo ya rekoto ya go kopanya. - Direkoto tsa taolo ya sekgala, dipholo, le metadata e e boeletsweng ya go itlhophela di-backup di nna di siametse go phepafadiwa morago ga diura tsa 24. - Ditaelo tse di santseng di emetse tsa khonsole ya motshameko di felelwa ke nako morago ga metsotswana e le 30. Mokwalo o o sa romelwang o nna le tshwanelo ya go phimolwa fa o fela kgotsa o phimolwa; e e amogetsweng e e ntsha ka bonako. Ditshwanelo tsa go dirisa khomputara di tla fela mo metsotsong e le meraro. Letshwao la tiro le phitlhelelo e e tsepameng e latela paka ya rekoto ya tiro ya diura tsa 24. - Ditiragalo tsa go baakanya/tshireletso le ditlhagiso tse di paletsweng ke go tsena di nna di siametse go phepafadiwa morago ga malatsi a 90. Fa o sa kgone go ikwadisa, o tla nna le ditlhopha tsa 100 tsa bosheng; go retelelwa ke go nyalanya mo pakeng ya metsotso e le 10 go kgobokanngwa mmogo. - Ditshupetso tsa sebatli di khutla morago ga metsotso e le 30 kwa ntle ga dikopo tsa motsamaisi kgotsa morago ga diura di le 8 ka kakaretso. Maiteko a netefatso a felelwa ke nako morago ga metsotso e le 5; 'temporary-password recovery' e fela mo metsotsong ya 10 mme e ka dirisiwa gangwe fela. Direkoto tse di feletsweng ke nako tsa go tlhatlhoba, go busetsa, tshireletso ya go tshameka gape le tekanyetso ya lebelo di a tlosiwa ka nako ya phepafatso. Dikwadiso tsa diakhaonto tse di sa felelang di nna le tshwanelo ya go phepafadiwa morago ga diura tsa 24.
Go fela ga nako go emisa tetla tota le pele rekoto e tlosiwa. Thulaganyo ya go phepafatsa database e diragala ka nako ya dikopo tsa tirelo tse di latelang, gantsi gangwe mo metsotsong ya 10 go phepafatsa motsamaisi, ka jalo dipaka tse di fa godimo ke dipaka tsa go khutla kgotsa tsa go siamela go phepafadiwa go na le ditsholofetso tsa go phimolwa ka nako e e rileng. Di-log tsa motlamedi le dikhopi tse di bolokilweng di na le botshelo jo bo farologaneng.
Unpairing e phimola pairing e e tlhophilweng le direkoto tsa yone tse di kgakala go tswa mo polokelongtshedimosetso ya tirelo e e dirang. Hisitori ya go busediwa madi/ya tshireletso e ka nna mo akhaontong mo pakeng e e fa godimo. Go phimola akhaonto ya motsamaisi go tlosa makwalo a gagwe, dikopanyo, ditshwantsho, ditaelo le direkoto tsa tshireletso/tsosoloso ya akhaonto go tswa mo polokelongtshedimosetsong ya tirelo e e dirang. Ga e tlose di-server tsa gago tsa metshameko, dipolanete, dithulaganyo, kgotsa difaele tse o di bolokileng. Dipego tsa nakwana tse di thibelang tiriso e e sa siamang le direkoto tse di tshotsweng ke motlamedi kgotsa di-backup ga se gore di a phimolwa ka yone nako eo.
14.5 Taolo ya gago le Tshireletso ya go Tsena
Go tsena go tlhoka phasewete ya gago mmogo le selotlolo sa go tsena se se leng teng kgotsa sesireletsi, jaaka Google Authenticator. Diakhaonto tse di rulagantsweng go tlhoka mekgwa e mebedi eno di nna le ditlhokego tseno ka bobedi. Go fetola phasewete, go kgaoganya khomputara ka webosaete, le go phimola akhaonto ya motsamaisi go tlhoka netefatso e ntšhwa ya phetogo eo e e rileng.
Go lotlolola letshwao la go tsenya mo sedirisiweng sa motshameko gape go tlhoka gore o nne le phasewete ya akhaonto e o e dirisang gone jaanong le go netefatsa sešwa go ya ka ditlhokego tse di leng teng tsa mokgwa wa akhaonto. Kamogelo e golaganngwa le khomputara e le nngwe, khomputara e e tshwaraganeng, seva e e bolokilweng le motshameko o o tshamekiwang mo metsotsong e le meraro. Go emisa, go simolola gape, go tswala console, go kgoreletsa thulaganyo ya console kgotsa go latlhegelwa ke thulaganyo go thibela ditaelo tse dingwe. Go kgaoganya kana go fitlha thebe ya motsamaisi go khutlisa kamogelo ya thebe eo. Dikonopo tse di tlwaelegileng tsa tiragatso ya seva di boloka ditlhokego tsa tsone tse di leng teng tsa go tsena. Dikgolagano tsa go tsenya tse di tshegediwang fela ke motshameko di a tshwanela; seitshupo se se kgethegileng ka bosone fela ga se letle gore go kwalwe mo taelong ya taelo ya Windows.
Khomputara e e kopantsweng e e neng e setse e letleletswe pele e ka go naya phasewete ya nakwana fa o lebala phasewete ya gago ya webosaete. Ga e kgone go tlhopha akhaonto e nngwe. Sephiri sa nakwana ga se thibele kgotsa go tlosa ditlhokego tsa gago tse di leng teng, mme o tshwanetse go tlhopha sephiri se sesha pele o tsena mo motsamaising. Go feleletsa go busetsa go tla dira gore di-browser tsa gago tse dingwe di se tlhole di bereka.
Motsamaisi wa Synix o tshola letshwao la gagwe la go tsena mo sebatling mo mogopolong wa tab ya ga jaana, e seng mo di-cookie, polokelo ya selegae kgotsa polokelo ya setlhopha. Go ntšhwafatsa kgotsa go tswala thebe go tla dira gore o se ka wa tlhola o tsena. Seno ga se thibele sebadi sa gago kgotsa motsamaisi wa diphasewete go boloka tshedimosetso ya gago fa o batla, e bile ga se tlhalose di-cookie tse di tlhomilweng ka tsela e e farologaneng ke batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa go tshola batho le tsa tshireletsego kgotsa tirelo ya thanolo ya webosaete ya setšhaba.
O ka tswa mo khomputareng, wa phimola di-browser tsotlhe kgotsa wa kgaoganya khomputara le tse dingwe. App ya Synix ya selegae e ka kgoreletsa le go tlosa kgolagano ya yona ya sekgala ntle le go tsena mo webosaeteng. Fa e sa bereke, e emisa go tsena mo lefelong leo mme e bo e leka gape go tlosa webosaete fa go na le kgokagano. Go simolola app kgotsa Windows seshwa ga go busetse pairing e e tlositsweng ka tlhamalalo. Go sa ntse go na le dilo tse di ka dirisiwang mo lefelong leo fela.
14.6 Hosting, ditsebe tsa botlhe le melelwane ya tshireletso
Webosaete ya semmuso e dirisa OpenAI's Sites hosting le ditirelo tsa Cloudflare go tsamaisa, go boloka, tshireletsego, le go romela tshedimosetso. Batlamedi bano ba dira tshedimosetso e e tlhokegang go tlamela ditirelo tseo mme ba ka amogela diaterese tsa IP, ditlhogo tsa dikopo, dinako le metadata e mengwe ya kgokaganyo, kgotsa ba boloka direkoto tsa bone tsa tiragatso le dikhopi tsa tshireletso. Melawana ya bone ya khupamarama e dira mo go tseyeng karolo ga bona: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ le https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Dithanolo tse di itiretsweng tsa ditsebe tsa botlhe le tsa GitHub di kopanyeletsa batlamedi ba tsone. Motsamaisi wa poraefete o kgaogane le ditsebe tsa setšhaba e bile ga a laetse motlamedi wa setšhaba wa thanolo kana dikwalo tsa papatso. Synix ga e bolele ka tlhamalalo gore go etela nngwe ya diwebosaete tseno ga go dire gore go nne le di-cookie, direkoto kgotsa tshedimosetso e e bolokilweng. Tshedimosetso gape e ka senolwa fa molao o batla jalo; Maitlamo a go se rekise a a fa godimo ga a thibele go tshola dilo tse di tlhokegang kgotsa go senola dilo ka tsela e e tshwanetseng.
Synix e dirisa pairing e e netefaditsweng, dikopo tsa khomputara tse di saennweng, dikgokagano tsa marangrang tse di tsentsweng khouto, ditlhatlhobo tsa phitlhelelo ya akhaonto, le ditumelelo tsa botshelo jo bokhutshwane go fokotsa phitlhelelo e e sa letlelelwang. Ditshireletso tseno ga di dire gore go nne le kotsi ya go tsena mo lefelong le le kgakala kgotsa go sireletsa kgatlhanong le tlhaselo nngwe le nngwe, khomputara/browser e e tshwaeditsweng, mekgwa ya go netefatsa e e utswitsweng kgotsa tirelo e e tshwaeditsweng. Tswelela o tlhabolotse Synix le Windows, sireletsa akhaonto ya gago le mekgwa ya go netefatsa, mme o dumele fela dikhomputara le diakhaonto tse o di laolang.
Kitsiso e ke ya botlhe kwa https://synix.info/license/ mme e akareditswe mo Help Center ya app le mo setlamong. Dipotso tsa khupamarama di ka bodiwa ka go dirisa dikgetho tsa semmuso tsa tshegetso kwa https://synix.info/support/. O se ke wa romela diphasewete, dikhoutu tsa go busetsa, kgotsa tshedimosetso e nngwe ya akhaonto ya poraefete mo melaetseng ya setšhaba ya tshegetso. Ditlhabololo tsa kitsiso eno di na le phetogo e ntšha le letlha.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Bula Settings → Report a Problem go baakanya pegelo, kgotsa dirisa mafelo a semmuso a tshegetso fa tlase.
Dira Gore Bothata Bongwe le Bongwe bo Nne Teng Akaretsa mokgwa wa go tsenya, mofuta wa Synix le Windows o tota o o dirisang, motshameko/profaele, le dintlha tse di maleba tsa kgatiso/motshodi.
Tlhalosa: • Se o se kgotletseng kgotsa se o se fetotseng. • Se o neng o se solofetse le se se diragetseng. • Phoso e e tlhomameng le tshobokanyo e khutshwane ya lokwalodikgang lo lo neng lwa kwalwa ka nako eo. • Gore a thulaganyo eno e ne e bereka pele le gore ke eng se se fetogileng.
TLHALOSO PELE O A BUA Tlosa diphasewete, di-token, di-URL tsa webhook, ditsela tsa botho, le tshedimosetso ya netweke e o sa batleng gore e bonwe ke batho botlhe. Mokgwa wa go Sireletsa Sephiri ga o phepafatse faele nngwe le nngwe e e tsentsweng. O se ka wa tsenya direkoto tse di feletseng kgotsa dithulaganyo tsa metshameko o ise o di sekaseke.
Fa go na le bothata jwa thanolo, akaretsa puo e o e tlhophileng, leina la fensetere, le mafoko a a bonalang sentle. Fa e le gore go na le bothata jwa go tlhalosa motshameko, akaretsa thulaganyo e e baakantsweng ya motshameko le ditlankana tse di maleba tsa motshameko.
DITIRAGALO TSA SETLHOPHA Dipegelo tsa kgatiso: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Setšhaba Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Polokelo ya porojeke: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Kopo e e atlegileng ya go tsenya kgotsa go aga ga e ka ke ya leka motshameko mongwe le mongwe, mod, le tikologo ya netweke. Dikgato tse di bonalang sentle tsa go ikatisa di thusa go farologanya bothata jwa Synix go tswa mo motshamekong kgotsa mo bothateng jwa tlhomo ya motlamedi.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Tobetsa mo moleng wa seva pele o dirisa ditaolo tse di kwa tlase. Mola o o tlhophilweng ke one o o laolang gore tiro e ama seva sefe.
TSAMAYA SERVER Dirisa lebokoso la go senka go sefa ka leina la motshameko kgotsa la seva. Sefitlha sa maemo se fokotsa lenaane le go feta. Fa e le gore go lebega go na le sengwe se se tlhaelang, tlosa difilter tse pedi pele ga o tsaya gore se tlositswe.
BALA SETSHWANTSHO • Installed Servers e bala diteng tse di kwadisitsweng tsa seva. • Go Diragadiwa Gone Jaanong go bontsha dilo tse di begilweng gore di a dirwa gone jaanong. • CPU Usage le RAM Usage di tlhalosa PC yotlhe, e seng fela Synix. • Tshedimosetso ya motshameki e bonwa fela fa motshameko o o tlhophilweng o senola motswedi o o tshegediwang.
DITLHAKISO TSA LETSATSI LE LETSATSI • Laola go simolola, go emisa le go simolola se o se tlhophileng. • Configure e bula masimo a yone a setup. • Go ipaakanyetsa go tlhatlhoba dilo tse di ka dirang gore e se ka ya bereka. • Server Options e na le faele, tlhokomelo, kgokagano, le didirisiwa tse di rileng tsa motshameko. • Tobetsa mo moleng o le mongwe gabedi go bona tshedimosetso e e oketsegileng ka serwereng seo.
Activity & Diagnostics e bontsha kgatelopele le ditlhagiso tse di tshwanetseng. Bala molaetsa wa bofelo pele ga o boeletsa se o se dirileng. CLEAR e phepafatsa lefelo le le bonalang la tiro; ga se taelo ya go phimola difaele tsotlhe tsa log.
Thulaganyo e e ntseng e tsweletse ga se gore e setse e siametse go ka dirisiwa ke batshameki. Go tsenngwa, go laisa lefatshe, ditumalano, le thulaganyo ya motshameko e ka tswelela morago ga thulaganyo e sena go tlhagelela. Tlhomamisa gore o ipaakantse mo lokwalodikgannyeng lwa motshameko le ka go ikwadisa.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Bula Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager go bona profaele e e tshegediwang. Synix e lemoga diteng tse di tsentsweng le mafelo a a tshegediwang; ga se lenaane le le nang le mod mongwe le mongwe.
Tsenya LOCAL PACKAGE 1. Boloka lefatshe, ditlaleletso tse di leng teng, le thulaganyo e e amilweng. 2. Emisa seva ka Synix mme o lete setlhopha sa yone go tswa. 3. Sekaseka thulaganyo ya tlaleletso e e lemogilweng, lefelo la go tsenya, le lenaane la tshireletso. 4. Tlhopha Install From File kgotsa Import Package ya faele e e tshegediwang, ZIP, kgotsa foldara e e feletseng ya mod. Ditlhopho tse di leng teng di ikaegile ka tsamaiso ya papadi. 5. Sekaseka lefelo le o yang kwa go lone, diphelelo tsa go tlhatlhoba, ditlhagiso le go tlhomamisa. 6. Letla gore go rulaganngwa, go tsenngwa ga disele le go tlhomamisiwa ga tsone go fele. 7. Synix e ntšhwafatsa lenaane fa tlhomamiso e weditswe. Simolola gape fa go tlhokega, mme o tlhatlhobe log ya motshameko le kgokagano ya modirisi.
Lenaane le bontsha lefelo la go tsenya le le tlhophilweng. Dirisa Search go batla sedirisiwa sa tlaleletso ka leina, mofuta, motswedi, kgotsa tsela. Refresh scans gape le go boloka selo se se tlhophilweng fa e santse e le teng. Go bona dilo ka tsela e e motlhofo go fitlha dintlha dingwe tsa botegeniki kwantle ga go itlhokomolosa ditlhatlhobo.
Boloka fensetere e butswe fa o ntse o tlhatlhoba kgotsa o fetola. Synix e kgoreletsa ditiro tse di thulanang go fitlha e fetsa. Fa tiro e sa atlege, bala phoso ya yone mme o bo o ntsha lenaane pele ga o leka gape.
DIKAROLO TSA TIRO Tsamaiso ya tiro e e tshegediwang e akaretsa diphuthelwana tsa Minecraft JAR, di-plugins tsa Rust Oxide/uMod, diphuthelwana tsa selegae tsa 7 Days to Die, maemo a Empyrion le di-server mods, ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop IDs, le ARK: Survival Ascended provider IDs. Ditsamaiso tse dingwe di kgona go lemoga fela kgotsa di tlhoka thulaganyo ya tsone pele.
Fa e le ka ID ya motlamedi, Synix e laola thulaganyo e e tshegediwang fa motshameko/motlamedi a tsamaisa diteng. Diteng tse di iseng di itseelwe ga di kgone go sekasekwa pele mo lefelong la lona.
SE DITSHEKO DI KA SE DIRANG LE SE DI SA Kgoneng go se Dira Dithekiso di tlhatlhoba tsela e sephuthelwana se rulagantsweng ka yone le kwa se yang teng mme di gana ditsela tse di sa bolokesegeng, dikgolagano, diteng tse di sa letlelelwang, diphuthelwana tsa bogolo jo bo fetang jwa tsone, mafelo a a tshwanang le ao, le di-malware tse di tlhomamisitsweng.
Go tlhatlhoba Defender e e sa bonweng kgotsa e e sa tlhomamang ke tlhagiso, e seng bosupi jwa gore go na le malware. Tshekatsheko e e phepa le hash e e gatisitsweng le yone ga e supe gore sephuthelwana sa motho wa boraro se ka ikanngwa. Di-mods di tsamaisiwa ka tetla ya Windows ya seva.
DIKATALOGO, GO TSHOLA LE GO BUSETSA Browse Catalog e bula webosaete ya motlamedi. Ga e kgone go rarabolola dilo tse di ikaegileng ka yone kgotsa go tsenya modpack e e feletseng.
Thibela seva pele ga go busetsa kwa morago. Seno se fetola dilo tsotlhe tse o di tsentseng, tse di ka nnang tsa nna le dilo tse di oketsegileng. E busetsa dilo tsa ntlhantlha tse di bolokilweng e bo e tlosa difaele tse di tsentsweng ke tse di tsentsweng. Go busetsa dilo tse disha kwa morago pele fa di abelana difaele; Synix e gana go kwala mo godimo ga difaele tse di fetotsweng kwa ntle ga tse di rekotilweng kgotsa go dirisa tsa ntlha tse di bolokilweng tse di palelwang ke go tlhatlhobiwa gore a di siame. Direkoto tsa bogologolo tse di romelwang kwa dinageng di sele di ka nna tsa bo di sa akaretse di-hash tse di bolokilweng.
Fa e le ID e e laolwang ke motlamedi, Remove Selected e tlosa ID eo mo thulaganyong e e tshegediwang ya Synix; ga se go busetsa morago sephuthelwana sa lefelo leo. Synix e rekota diphetogo tse e di dirang, e seng tse di dirwang ka seatla. Boloka di-backup tse di ikemetseng tse di feletseng tsa seva: go tlosa mod go ka dira gore lefatshe le se ka la tsenngwa kgotsa go ntsha diteng tse di leng tsa mod.
Tafole e e se nang sepe e raya gore ga go na ditlaleletso tse di tshegediwang tse di tsamaelanang le lefelo le le tlhophilweng la go tsenya le go batla. Tlosa Search mme o lekole profile, foldara, le foreimi pele o tsaya gore difaele tsotlhe mo disiking di batlisisitswe.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Bula Add Server → Game Support Catalog go lekola gore Synix e itse eng ka motshameko pele ga o tsenya sengwe. Lenaane leno le dirisa ditlhaloso tse di tsentsweng mo sedirisong sa gago se o se tlhomileng.
1. Batla leina la motshameko. 2. Dirisa thulaganyo, tshedimosetso ya motshameki, go tshameka ka tsela e sele, go tsamaelana, kgotsa difiltere tsa netefatso go lekanyetsa lenane. 3. Tlhopha motshameko mme o bule dintlha tsa one, kgotsa tobetsa mola wa one gabedi. 4. Buisa thulaganyo e e tshegediwang, porokeramo ya seva, ditlhokego le tshedimosetso ya netefatso.
Tlosa difilter fa e le gore motshameko ga o yo ka tshoganetso. Minecraft's Java and Bedrock di karolo ya setup workflow go na le di interchangeable mod systems.
BALA DITIRO TSE DINGWE KA KELETSO Profaele e ka nna ya neelana ka thulaganyo e e laolwang, thulaganyo e e kaelwang, thulaganyo ya go simolola, kgotsa tshegetso e e lekanyeditsweng/ya motheo. Letshwao le le tlhagelelang mo lenaaneng kgotsa Steam AppID le tlhalosa gore thulaganyo e bereka jang; ga e netefatse kgatiso nngwe le nngwe ya motshameko.
Tlhokego ya SteamCMD e e netefaditsweng e kaya gore porofaele e kopa phitlhelelo ya akhaonto. Beng ba metshameko le melao ya bagatisi e ka nna ya batla dilo tse dingwe gape.
DIFOLT PORTS GA SE FIREWALL CHECKLIST Boleng jo bo bolokilweng jwa kgoro ya dipotso ga bo supe gore go na le motho yo o reetsang dipotso kgotsa gore o tshwanetse go senolwa. Dirisa thulaganyo ya motshameko le melao e e tlhokegang.
Katalogi ke lefelo le o ka tlhatlhobang ditlhaloso tse di tsentsweng mo go lone. Direkoto tsa netefatso ya selegae di bontsha se se lemogilweng mo PC eno, e seng dipholo tse di akaretsang mo motšhineng mongwe le mongwe kgotsa motswako wa mod.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Bula letshwao la dikere mo tafoleng ya didirisiwa gore o kgone go dirisa thulaganyo yotlhe. Dirisa konopo ya Configure ya seva go bona di-setting tse e leng tsa seva seo fela.
KAKARETSO • Show Server Console Window e laola gore a di-server tse di tshegediwang di bontsha console ya tsone. Fensetere e e fitlhegileng ga e reye gore seva e emisitswe. • Dark Mode e fetola tema ya tiriso. • SteamCMD Download Speed e tlhopha lebelo le le feletseng kgotsa tekanyetso ya download e e tshegediwang. • Diphetogo tsa puo di ne di tshegetsa matshwao a segokaganyi, dipuisano le melaetsa ya seemo.
Ditsebe tse dingwe di na le mafelo a go boloka le go fetisa, dikgetho tsa sephiri/tshireletsego, go bega mathata, le ditlhophiso tse di tsweleletseng/tsa kwa morago. Ga go tlhokege gore o letle diitlhophelwa tse di kwa godimo go dira seva e e tlwaelegileng.
BOITSHWARO JWA PUO Tlhopha go tswa mo dipuong tse di leng teng. Taolo ya Synix, ditlhogo tsa thuso le melaetsa e e tlhagisitsweng ke app di dirisa puo e e tlhophilweng. Ditaolo tsa motshameko, boleng jwa thulaganyo, le dipholo tsa pele tsa seva ga di a ranolwa. Difaele tsa log ya botegeniki di boloka mafoko a tsone a ntlha a tlhatlhobo.
Mokwalo o o lebaganeng le motshameko ga o a ranolwa: ditaolo, dinotlolo tsa thulaganyo le boleng, maina a dimmapa, mekgwa, maina a difaele, mabaka a go simolola, matshwao, le mokwalo wa go lemoga o tshwanetse go nna ka mokgwa o o lebeletsweng ke motshameko.
Go fetola puo ya segokaganyi ga go fetole tsela e motshameko o laelang ka yone kgotsa go ranola se o se tlhagisang mo sedirisiweng sa gago. Fa letshwao le le tlwaelegileng la Synix le sa ranolwa ka tshoganetso, bega mafoko a lone a a tlhomameng, lebokoso le puo e e tlhophilweng.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Bula Settings → Privacy & Security pele o abelana sekirini kgotsa o sekaseka diitlhophelwa tsa tshireletsego.
KGANG YA BOPHIRI Di-mask tsa Privacy Mode di ne di tshegetsa ditshwantsho tse di botlhokwa, jaaka diaterese le dintlha tsa go ikwadisa. Ga e fetole IP ya gago ya botlhe, ga e tsenye dikhoute tsa pharakano ya netweke, kgotsa ga e phepafatse log ya motshameko mongwe le mongwe le faele ya thulaganyo.
Sekaseka setshwantsho sa sekirini pele ga o se abelana le ba bangwe. Kgato ya go kopisa mo tshimong e e sireleditsweng e ka nna ya bo e sa ntse e kopisa boleng jwa mmatota.
MAFOKO A O A BOKELETSENG LE DITEKANYO TSA SETSHWAO Synix e sireletsa di-password tse di tshegediwang tse di bolokilweng, di-tokens le di-webhook tsa boleng jwa modirisi wa ga jaana wa Windows. Motshameko o sa ntse o ka tlhoka credentials tse di balwang mo thulaganyong ya ona kgotsa go simolola di arguments.
Khopi ya folda e e senang sepe mo akhaontong e nngwe ya Windows ga e netefatse gore boleng jo bo sireleditsweng joo bo ka bulwa. Dirisa motsamao wa go fetisa o o sa kwalwang mo go tshegediwang go fuduga ga makwaloitshupo.
DIKAELELO TSA FENETERE Tsamaisa Synix le di-server tsa metshameko tse di tlwaelegileng ka ditetla tsa tekanyetso tsa Windows. Phetogo e e rileng ya tsamaiso kgotsa motshameko o o simololang o ka kopa go tlhatlosiwa kwa godimo ka go farologana; ga se lebaka la go dira sengwe le sengwe jaaka motsamaisi wa leruri.
Kgatelopele ya go phepafatsa firewall e ne ya tshegetsa melao ya Synix. Sekaseka melao e e akantshiwang pele ga o dumela gore go tlosiwe. Ga e laole difoldara tsotlhe tsa tlwaelo kgotsa go letlelela go phimola melao ya firewall e e sa amaneng le yone.
Fa sephiri se senolwa, se emisetse ka sengwe kgotsa se se golole mo tirelong e e se ntshitseng. Go fitlha tshimo kgotsa go tlosa khopi e e bolokilweng ya Synix ga go dire gore tumelelo eo e se ka ya dira mo lefelong le lengwe.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Go tswala fensetere ya ngwana, go fokotsa Synix, le go tswa ka tlhamalalo mo tirisong ke ditiro tse di farologaneng. Sekaseka tsela e o itshwarang ka yone le go tswa mo lefelong lengwe le lengwe.
GO BULA PANELE YA GO LAOLELA GAPE Synix e kgona go lemoga dithulaganyo tse di tshegediwang tsa seva tse di santseng di dira le go busetsa beng ba tsone. Letla tlhatlhobo ya tshimologo ya thulaganyo go fela pele o simolola tiragalo e nngwe.
Tsela e thulaganyo e lemogiwang ka yone e tshwanetse go tsamaisana le thulaganyo e e tlhophilweng, e seng fela leina le le tlwaelegileng la thulaganyo e e dirisiwang. Go ka nna ga tlhokega gore go tlhokomelwe thata dilo tse di phuthetsweng tse di dirilweng ka tsela e motho a batlang ka yone kgotsa ditirelo tse di laolwang ke batho ba bangwe.
DITSHWANTSHO TSA BACKGROUND Ditlhophiso tse di sa patelesegeng tsa go simolola/baagente ya kwa morago e tshegetsa go lekola fa Windows e tsena. Ga go tlhokege gore ba tlhame seva ya gago ya ntlha.
Tiro e e rulagantsweng e tlhoka thulaganyo ya Synix e e maleba kgotsa sediriswa, thulaganyo ya Windows e e leng teng le PC e e tsogileng. Go simolola go ikwadisa ga se tsholofetso ya gore tiro e tla tswelela pele fa motšhini o tswetswe.
PELE O TSOLA DIFENSTERE SETLHA Feleletsa go dira di-backup, go di tsenya mo Internet le go di fetisa. Emisa metshameko ka Synix gore e kgone go boloka ka tlwaelo, mme o tswa kgotsa o simolole Windows gape.
O se ka wa akanya gore khomputara ya motshameko e e fitlhegileng e emisitse go tshameka kgotsa gore fa o tswala fensetere ya yone ya go lekola motshameko o tla bo o emisa go tshameka. Tlhatlhoba dashboard mme o dirise ditaolo tsa botshelo tse di ikaeletsweng.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Bula maduo a go ipaakanyetsa ga seva e o e tlhophileng go supa se se tlhokegang. Nako ya go tshameka e e tsentsweng le Synix ga e emisetse ditlhokego tse di farologaneng tsa motshameko.
Melaetsa e e Tlhaelang ya DLL Diphoso tse di umakang MSVCP140.dll kgotsa VCRUNTIME140.dll gantsi di supa go Visual C++ runtime requirement. Dirisa dikaelo tsa motshameko le Microsoft e e tsamaelanang e e tshegediwang go anamisiwa gape.
Tshedimosetso ya Microsoft e e ka anamisiwang gape: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
O se ka wa latlhela difaele tsa DLL go tswa mo diwebsaeteng tse o sa di tlwaelang kgotsa wa baya difaele tsa DLL tse di sa amaneng le tsone fa thoko ga sedirisiwa se o se dirisang.
DINTLHA TSE DI OKETSEGILENG Motshameko o ka tlhoka akhaonto, tshwanelo ya seva, nako e e rileng ya Java, karolo ya Windows, kgotsa didiriswa tse di tshegediwang. Tlatsa ditlhokego tseo pele o fetola maemakepe a a sa amaneng kgotsa o busetsa thulaganyo.
Go Minecraft Java, dirisa kopanyo e e tshegediwang ya mofuta/morwalo go tswa go batlhophi ba Synix. Bedrock ga e dirise Java.
Fa o batla go dirisa Hyper-V kgotsa didirisiwa tsa thekenoloji, tlhatlhoba gore a e siametse motshameko mongwe le mongwe. O se ka wa dira gore dikarolo tsa tsamaiso di bereke kgotsa wa dira gore seva nngwe le nngwe e bereke jaaka motsamaisi fela gore o tile tlhagiso.
Morago ga go baakanya tlhokego, dira tshimologo e nngwe gape le go sekaseka phoso ya ntlha e e nang le bokao ya log ya motshameko fa e sa ntse e retelelwa.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
GO TLHOKOMELWA KGATISO E E BOTLHOKWA:
1. Synix e bula Space Engineers Dedicated Server Manager ya semmuso mme e nna e bonala ka dinako tsotlhe.
2. Tlhopha 'Local/Console', tlhopha 'Continue to server configuration', tsenya server le world settings, o bo o tlhopha 'Save & start'.
3. Dirisa molaodi wa maemo a a kwa godimo, mafatshe, di-mods, balaodi, le sedirisiwa se se tshelang. Tshedimosetso ya seva e bolokilwe mo teng ga folda ya Instance ya seva ya Synix.
4. Mokgwa wa Local/Console ga o tlhoke ditshwanelo tsa motsamaisi. Mokgwa wa tirelo wa Windows o dira jalo.
5. Ditlhokego: .NET Framework 4.8 kgotsa e ntšhwa, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 le 2017, bonnye 6 GB ya system RAM, le UDP port 27016 e letleletswe ka Windows Firewall mme e romelwa kwa pele go bapalami ba inthanete.
6. Ditokomane tsa semmuso: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5CA69EB89BDD805145B9
data.value: Bula Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg mme o tlhome g_console "1". Simolola motshameko o o tlwaelegileng wa Euro Truck Simulator 2, tsenya profaele ya gago le mmapa, tobetsa ~ go bula khonsole, mme o simolole export_server_packages. Tswala motshameko, o bo o tobetsa Start in Synix gape. Synix e tla tsenya difaele tse di tlhagisitsweng ka go itirisa.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Dirisa kaelo eno fa go tshameka LAN go bereka mme teko ya aterese ya botlhe e sa bereke.
Aterese ya Gago ya Phatlalatsa e a Tlhaela Di-router dingwe ga di tshegetse NAT loopback, gape e bidiwa hairpinning. Kamano e e tswang mo teng ga legae go ya kwa atereseng ya lone ya botlhe e ka nna ya palelwa le fa badiragatsi ba ba kwa ntle ba kgona go tsena.
Dirisa aterese ya LAN kwa gae mme o kope mongwe yo o nang le kgokagano e nngwe ya Internet go leka aterese ya botlhe. Go palelwa ga thulaganyo ya go dira dipatlisiso mo khomputareng ya WAN ka bogone fela ga se bosupi jwa gore Internet e kgaotswe.
PORT FORWARDING GA E KETLHAGANYE Tlhatlhoba gore a go na le motsamaisi yo mongwe kwa godimo, NAT e e gabedi, kgotsa NAT ya maemo a modirisi (CGNAT). Bapisa tshedimosetso ya WAN ya router le aterese ya botlhe mme o botse ISP gore a dikgolagano tse di tsenang di a tshegediwa.
Molawana wa go fetisa mo mothalading wa gago ga o kgone go bula NAT e e laolwang ke ISP. Go ikaegile ka kgokagano, tirelo ya aterese ya botlhe, VPN/tunnel e e maleba, kgotsa seva e e tshotsweng e ka tlhokega. Tseno ke dithulaganyo tsa kwa ntle, e seng dikarolo tse di ageletsweng tsa Synix.
O SE KA WA TSHWANETSA GO LAOLWA LE GO FITLHELELA MOGAMEGI Kgokagano e e laolwang ka kgakajana le kgokagano ya motshameki wa motshameko ke ditsela tse di farologaneng. Go dira gore API kgotsa Discord e nne teng ga go dire gore motshameko o fitlhelelwe go tswa mo inthaneteng.
Dira gore teko nngwe le nngwe ya mafaratlhatlha e dirwe fela mo kgorong ya mmatota ya motshameko le mo thulaganyong ya teng. O se ka wa anamisa diphasewete, di-token, ditshwantsho tsa router kgotsa dintlha tsa netweke ya gago fa o kopa thuso.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Dirisa log e e leng ya karolo e e paletsweng.
SYNIX ACTIVITY Activity & Diagnostics e bontsha kgatelopele le ditlhagiso tse di maleba tsa modirisi mo dashboard. Go phepafatsa lefelo leo go phepafatsa fela melaetsa e e bonalang; ga e tlose tshedimosetso yotlhe e e bolokilweng.
DITLHOGO TSA KOPANYO Synix ditlankana tsa melaetsa le dipegelo tsa dikotsi tse di bolayang gantsi di fitlhelwa mo: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Puisano ya go phutlhama e ka nna ya bitsa faele e e rileng. Dirisa tsela eo le nako ya go palelwa go bona rekoto e e maleba.
Ditshupetso tse di tshwerweng di ka kwalwa mo lokwalong lwa dikwalo kwa ntle ga go tlhagelela mo sedirisiweng. Kgwetlho e e tserweng mo logong ga se sesupo sa gore go na le bothata jwa tiriso.
DITLHOGO TSA GAME Dirisa log ya motshameko ya sebele ya seva e o e tlhophileng go bona diphoso tsa world-loading, configuration, mod, le game-runtime. Lefelo la yone le ikaegile ka motshameko mme e ka nna kwa ntle ga motswedi wa tlhomamiso.
BALA MO MAKGWARENG Ela tlhoko se se diragetseng le nako e se diragetseng ka yone, go tswa foo o bo o tlhatlhoba melaetsa e e amanang le phoso ya ntlha e e botlhokwa. Mogala o o tswetsweng kwa bofelong e ka nna matswela go na le gore e nne one o bakang bothata.
Pele o abelana karolo nngwe le nngwe, tlosa diphasewete, di-token, di-webhook, diaterese tsa poraefete, le ditsela tsa poraefete. Satisfactory's own console/log e ka nna ya nna le tokene ya motsamaisi. Boloka lokwalodikgang lwa sephiri lwa ntlhantlha gore o tle o dire dipatlisiso tsa gago.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Go busetsa go ka emisetsa diteng tsa tlhomamiso ya seva e e tlhophilweng. Tlhopha seva e e nepagetseng mme o boloke sengwe le sengwe se sesha pele ga o tswelela.
1. Tswala seva mme o dire khopi e e farologaneng ya difaele tse o ka nnang wa di tlhoka. 2. Bulela Restore backup workflow mo go Server Options. 3. Tlhopha akhaefe e o e batlang mme o sekaseke seva ya yone, letlha, bogolo, le maemo a yone. 4. E tlhomamise pele ga o e tsosolosa. di-backup tsa Synix tse di nang le diakhaonto tsa SHA-256 di ka tlhatlhobiwa kgatlhanong le diakhaonto tseo; Diakhaefe tsa bogologolo di ka nna tsa tsewa e le tsa bogologolo. 5. Bala tlhagiso ya gore o e emisetse ka e nngwe mme o tlhomamise fela fa e le gore eno ke yone nako e o batlang go e dirisa. 6. Letla gore go rulaganngwa le go busediwa go felele kwa ntle ga go tswala Synix kgotsa go kgaoganya polokelo. 7. Simolola seva mme o netefatse gore lefatshe le le ikaeletsweng le dithulaganyetso di buseditswe.
SE DIPATLISISO DI SE SENOLANG Tshekatsheko ya boikanyego e lemoga diphetogo tse di amanang le rasiti. Ga e bontshe gore lefatshe le ne le itekanetse fa le ne le bolokiwa kana gore rekoto ya motho yo mongwe e ka ikanngwa.
FA GO NA LE TLOTLEGO Boloka difaele tse o di bolokileng le fa e le dife tsa go busetsa kwa morago kgotsa tsa go baakanya. Bala molaetsa wa go busetsa pele o leka go busetsa kgotsa go tlosa difaele.
O se ka wa ntsha ZIP mo serwereng se se dirang. Fa e le gore motshameko o tshola dipoloko kwa ntle ga foldara ya tlhomamiso, busetsa tseo ka go farologana ka thulaganyo e e tshegediwang ya motshameko.
Boloka khopi ya kwa tshimologong go fitlha o lekeletsa seva e e tsosolositsweng le kgokagano ya modirisi.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Import Existing Server e kwadisa thulaganyo e e tshegediwang e e setseng e le mo disikeng. Ga se go tsenya sesha mme go farologana le go tsenya sephuthelwana sa phetiso se se feletseng sa Synix.
PELE O ITSE gore go botlhokwa go le kana kang Dira backup e e farologaneng, go akaretsa le fa e le efe e o e bolokileng kwa ntle ga foldara ya tlhomamiso. Thibela seva mme o thibele motsamaisi yo mongwe kgotsa morulaganyi yo a ka e simololang fa Synix e ntse e e laola.
KENYELETSA SETLHOGO 1. Tlhopha Add Server → Import Existing Server. 2. Tlhopha foldara ya tlhomamiso ya sebele ya seva, e seng tsela e khutshwane, faele ya ZIP, kgotsa foldara ya modirisi wa motshameko. 3. Dira gore Synix e e tlhatlhobe, go tswa foo o bo o tlhomamisa motshameko o o lemogilweng, kgatiso, thulaganyo e e ka dirisiwang le dithulaganyo. 4. Naya rekoto leina le le sa tshwaneng le lepe mme o tlatse dinomoro tse di tlhaelang. 5. Feleletsa go tsenya, bula Configure, mme o sekaseke ditsela tsa yone le dikgoro. 6. Tsamaisa Readiness, go tswa foo o dire tshimologo e le nngwe e e laolwang. Tlhomamisa gore lefatshe le le ikaeletsweng le thulaganyo di ne di tsentswe.
DIPHETOGO TSE DI BOTLHOKWA Go ikwadisa ga go dire gore o fuduse sedirisiwa, o se tsenye gape, kgotsa o emisetse difaele tsa sone tsa thulaganyo. Ditiro tsa moragonyana tse o di tlhophang ka tlhamalalo, jaaka Update, Validate, kgotsa configuration repair, di ka fetola difaele.
Go ka nna ga se ke ga lemogiwa di-wrapper tse di diretsweng go bulwa, di-modpack, diphasewete, le di-save tsa kwa ntle. Tsela e e tshwanang ya go tsenya e ka se kwadisiwe gabedi.
FA GO SE Kgonwe go Lemoga Tlhomamisa gore o tlhophile go tsenngwa ga seva e e kgethegileng e e tshegediwang ke profaele e o e tlhophileng. O seka wa fetola leina la executable e e sa amaneng le yone go pateletsa gore e tshwane. Neela pegelo ya motshameko le thulaganyo e e kgaotsweng ya difoldara gore tlhaloso ya yone e kgone go tlhatlhobiwa.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Dirisa kaedi eno fa thulaganyo ya go rulaganya e bega gore go na le tshimo e e sa laolweng e e tlhaelang, popego e e sa nepagalang, kgotsa go sa tsamaelaneng ga themplate.
TLHALOSO TSA DITHOPHO • Ditlhabololo tse di tlwaelegileng tsa go boloka di ne di tshegetsa boleng mo thulaganyong e e tlhophilweng. • Go baakanya go rarabolola bothata jo bo begilweng jo bo tshegediwang. • Reset e busetsa dilo tse di neng di le mo thempleteng e bile e kgona go tlosa dilo tse o di tlhophileng.
Go simolola sesha ga se kgato ya ntlha mo go palelweng gope fela ga seva. Dinako tse di tlhaelang tsa motshameko, maemakepe a a tserweng, le di-mods tse di senyegileng ga di baakanngwe ka go emisetsa difaele tsa thulaganyo gangwe le gape.
PELE O BAakanya Emisa motshameko, boloka khopi e e sa senyegang ya difaele tse di amilweng, mme o bale phetogo e e tlhomameng e e akantshiwang. Diporofaele dingwe di na le dimela tse di feletseng; Ba bangwe ba solofela gore motshameko o tla ntsha difaele fa o simolola kgotsa o tlhoka go rulaganngwa ka seatla.
Synix e bega gore go tlhaela matshwao a a tlhokegang go na le go akanya gore e ka emisetsa mola mongwe le mongwe ka pabalesego. Go dirisa phetogo ya themplate e e laolwang go ka boloka khopi ya nako e le nngwe e e bidiwang .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
KA MORAGO ga go Palelwa ke go Baakanya Kgotsa go Baakanya Boloka faele nngwe le nngwe e o e bolokileng kgotsa e o e tsosolositseng mme o bale molaetsa wa go busetsa. Bapisa thulaganyo ya kwa tshimologong le e e fetotsweng pele o tlhopha gore o batla go busetsa eng. O se ka wa phimola bosupi ka go leka go bo busetsa gape gangwe le gape.
Fa o sena go fola, simolola gangwe fela mme o lebe log ya motshameko ka bowena. Netefatsa gore e bala tsela e e nepagetseng le gore diseting tsa tlwaelo tse o di tlhokang di santse di le teng.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune e dirisa thulaganyo ya kwa ntle ya tiriso ka metšhine e e leng ya motshameko le maemo a setlhopha sa ntwa. Ga se sedirisiwa se se tlwaelegileng sa motshameko wa thulaganyo e le nngwe.
DITSHWANTSHO Bala Synix'Ditshekatsheko tsa go ipaakanyetsa memori ya tsamaiso, AVX2, hardware virtualization, Hyper-V, le Professional- kgotsa e e kwa godimo e e tshegediwang Windows kgatiso. Ditlhokego tsa segopodiso di ikaegile ka setlhopha sa ntwa le dimmapa tse o di dirisang.
Synix ga e dire gore go nne le tiriso ya thekenoloji kgotsa go tsenya Hyper-V. Feleletsa ditlhokego tsa semmuso tsa motshameko pele ga o simolola.
TSAMAYA LE GO TSWAATSA 1. Tlhopha tsenyeletso ya Dune: Awakening mme o sekaseke ditlhokego tsa yone le folda ya go tsenya. 2. Boloka mme o simolole. 3. Synix e simolola sediriswa sa semmuso sa battlegroup.bat ka taelo ya motsamaisi e e tlhokwang ke tiriso eo. 4. Tlhopha initial-setup mo sedirisweng sa motshameko mme o ntshe Token ya gago ya Self-Host. 5. Tlatsa thulaganyo ya VM, netweke le setlhopha sa ntwa mo sedirisweng seo.
Fumana Self-Host Token ka tsela ya semmuso Funcom akhaonteng-portal sebelisa yona eligibility/setup tshebetso: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Boloka matshwao ano e le sephiri. Go tlhatlosiwa ga sedirisiwa se sa go tsenya tirisong ga go reye gore modirisi mongwe le mongwe wa Synix o tshwanetse go dira jaaka motsamaisi.
MEKGATLHO YA GO TSHWANETSA LE GO LAOLELA Dirisa tlhamo ya neteweke ya host/VM ya tiragatso le dikgoro tse di tlhokegang. Metadata ya patlisiso mo Synix e emela RMQ, e seng modirisi wa patlisiso wa A2S o o tlwaelegileng.
Fensetere e e tswetsweng ga e supe gore di-VM tsa yone di emisitse. Netefatsa seemo sa motshameko mme o dire ditiro tsa setlhopha sa ntwa ka ditaolo tsa motshameko.
Synix e ka tsenya, ya tlhabolola, ya simolola, le go boloka foldara ya tlhomamiso e e tlhophilweng. O se ka wa akanya gore go fedisiwa ga thulaganyo e e tlwaelegileng, dipotso tsa motshameki, kgotsa go busediwa ga modisa go laola tiragatso ya kwa ntle ka botlalo. Go romela faele kwa ntle ga go a letlelelwa mo thulaganyong eno.
Dirisa motshameko o o tshegediwang wa go tswala le go boloka ditsamaiso tsa data ya VM/database e e sa fetogeng. Sephuthelwana sa ZIP se le nosi ga se tshupetso e e tlhomameng ya yone.

Thitokgang e ke ya badirisi ba ba nang le maitemogelo le ba ba nang le seabe. Ga o tlhoke didiriswa tsa motlhami go tlhama seva go tswa mo porofaeleng e e tshegediwang.
KAFA DITSHWANTSHO TSE DI DIRANG KA GONE Tlhaloso e e ageletsweng ya motshameko e tlhalosa dilo tse di tsentsweng, tse di ka dirisiwang, Steam AppIDs le ditlhokego tsa go tsena, di-argument tsa go simolola, dikgoro, boitshwaro jwa phetogo, ditlhokego le bokgoni jwa molaodi.
Ditlhaloso di tlhopha maitsholo a a tshegediwang a a agilweng mo teng. Ga di tsenye di-handler, di-assembly kgotsa di-script tse di tsentsweng. Go latlhela faele ya JSON mo foldareng ya tiriso e e tsentsweng ga go oketse porofilo e ntšhwa ya motshameko o o rulagantsweng.
TSHWANTSHOKA KANA Tsenya Profaele 1. Simolola ka ditaelo tsa semmuso tsa seva e e kgethegileng le difaele tsa thulaganyetsoruri tse di dirilweng. 2. Dirisa ditsela tse di amanang le modirisi-motswedi fa go tlhokega le matshwao a a maleba a motshameko. 3. Tsenyeletsa dithempelete tse di tshegediwang ka botlalo mo mafelong a tsone a a tshwanetseng. 4. Tlhabololwa ga tlhaloso e e maleba/tlhabololo ya thulaganyo/thempele. 5. Netefatsa laeborari, aga ka SDK e e tlhokwang ke porojeke, mme o dire diteko tse di maleba. 6. Leka go tsenya, go simolola, go emisa le go lebelela motshameko ka sebele pele ga o rekota netefatso.
Definition Builder ke sediriswa sa go aga tlhabololo, e seng tlhokego ya tlwaelo ya tlhomamiso ya kgatiso.
TSHIRELETSO YA MOTSOTSO • UI: Difensetere tse di kgethegileng. • ServerHandler: Taolo ya metshameko le go kopanngwa ga diserver. • SynixEngine: Application lifecycle, maintenance, networking, backups, le tshireletso. • Thulaganyo: Didirisiwa tse di laolwang, ditlhogo le dilo tse di thusang mo go rulaganyeng. • Database/GameDefinitions: Game profiles and templates. • Database/ModSystems: Go tshegediwa go tlaleletsa mo ditsamaisong tsa tiro. • Go dira mo lefelong le o nnang mo go lone: Dirisa didirisiwa tse di dirisiwang go rulaganya tshedimosetso le di-generator. • Diteko: Go tlhatlhoba go go ikaegileng ka dilo tse di rileng.
Fa o batla go ranola, tlhabolola lenaane lengwe le lengwe la dipuo ka nako e le nngwe mme o boloke dintlha tse di tshwereng maemo. Tsenya ditlhogo tsa thuso, go tlhatlhoba malwetse, mokwalo o o tlhalosang gore a motho a ka kgona go tsena mo motshamekong, le ditlhaloso tse di tlhalosang kafa metshameko e thusang ka teng. O se ka wa ranola ditaelo, dinotlolo, matshwao, boleng jwa modirisi, kgotsa matshwao a go lemoga dipholo. Dipego tsa ntlhantlha tsa kalafi ga di fetoge.
Bala Melawana ya Laesense le ya Ditshwanelo pele o anamisa khoutu kgotsa go aga. O se ka wa tsenya makwalo a gago a go ikwadisa le direkoto tsa gago mo dithulaganyong tsa gago.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Rulaganya thulaganyo ya tlhokomelo ya seva fela morago ga gore o lekeletse tsela e e tlwaelegileng ya go boloka, go tlhabolola, go emisa le go simolola.
1. Bula thulaganyo ya yone ya go itirisa/go rulaganya mme o dire gore thulaganyo e kgone go dira. 2. Tlhopha malatsi le dinako. 3. Ntsha Smart Maintenance mme o tlhophe di-backup/update options tse di leng teng. 4. Tlhopha gore a o tla letela batshameki le go baya nako e e kwa godimo ya go diega. 5. Boloka o bo o tlhatlhoba ka nako ya fa go dirwa tiro ya go baakanya e o ka kgonang go e okamela.
Dithulaganyo di dirisa nako ya mo lefelong la PC. Dira gore tshupanako ya yone le nako e e mo go yone di nne di siame.
FA Thulaganyo e Tshwanetse go Dirwa Synix e ka emela badiragatsi ba ba golagantsweng, mme morago ga moo e rulaganye go emisa setlhopha sa tirego se se netefaditsweng, go dira bekapo fa e emisitswe, go tlhabolola le go simolola gape go ya ka dikgetho tse di tlhophilweng.
Nako e o ka se kang wa diega go e leta e lekanyeditswe, ga se tsholofetso ya gore o tla leta ka bosakhutleng. Tlhokomelo e ka tswelela pele fa e fela le fa go santse go na le batshameki. Go diega ga lefela go raya gore ga go na nako ya go leta.
GO NA LE MAKGELELO MO TSHEDIMISONG YA BATLHABADI Go leta go ikaegile ka tshedimosetso e o e bonang mo motshamekong o o tlhophilweng. API e e golagantsweng le Satisfactory e tshwara dipalopalo tse di sa dirisiweng sentle kgotsa tse di sa bonweng ka nako ya paka e e beilweng ya go leta. Seo ga se dire gore tshedimosetso ya dipotso tse di sa tshegediweng e ikanyege.
Itsise batshameki go sa le gale mme o bale melaetsa ya tiro e e tlhagelelang. Dikitsiso tsa Discord di ka bega ditiragalo tsa tlhokomelo tse di tshegediwang fa ditsela tsa tsone di rulagantswe.
PC e tshwanetse go bo e tsogile mme thulaganyo ya Synix e e maleba kgotsa sediriswa sa motheo se tshwanetse go bo se dira. Khomputara e e tswetsweng kgotsa e e robetseng ga e kgone go dira dilo tse di tlwaelegileng tse di rulagantsweng le go simolola gape.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Bula Windows Terminal kgotsa PowerShell mme o dirise nomoro e e nepagetseng ya sephuthelwana e e fa tlase fano. Ditaolo tseno di laola Synix ka boyone, e seng di-server tsa metshameko.
Tsenya winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
TLHOKOMELA PAKETSO E E TSADILENG winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
TSA MOSHA Tswala Synix mme o fetse tiro ya yone pele ga o e dirisa: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
TLOGELA go tsenya APPLICATION winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Boloka DITAELO TSA GAGO Go tsenngwa ga seva, go boloka le go boloka di-backup go farologane le sephuthelwana sa tiriso. O se ka wa phimola C:\Synix kgotsa di-folders tsa data tsa tlwaelo ntle le fa o batla go tlosa data eo ka boomo.
FA THUTO E SETLHAKA Bala lebaka le le begilweng. Fa WinGet e bega gore go na le go sa tsamaisaneng ga di-hash tsa motlhatlhobi, emisa mme o e bege; o se ka wa itlhokomolosa go tlhatlhobiwa ga hash. Tlhabololo e e tlhaelang e ka raya gore polokelo ga e ise e gatise sephuthelwana se sesha.
Tshegetso ya WinGet le tshupetso e e tsamaelanang ya download hash ga e tshwaye Synix ka letshwao la khoutu kgotsa go netefatsa gore software ya tshireletso ya Windows e tla e tshepa.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Bontsha pele gore a motshameko o a bereka mo kgwebong ya gago. Diphetogo tsa tsela ga di ka ke tsa siamisa motshameko o o iseng o simolole kgotsa o o iseng o fetse thulaganyo ya one ya ntlha.
Tlhopha Aterese e e Siameng • Mo PC ya seva: Dirisa kgokagano e e tshegediwang ya selegae kgotsa ya loopback ya motshameko. • Mo sedirisiweng se sengwe sa mo gae: Dirisa aterese ya LAN ya PC ya seva. • Kwa ntle ga netweke ya gago ya legae: Dirisa aterese ya gago ya botlhe kgotsa mokgwa wa go senka/go ikgolaganya o o tshegediwang ke motshameko.
Bulela Tshedimosetso ya Kgokagano ya rekoto e e tlhophilweng go tlhatlhoba mafelo a yone. Aterese ya LAN ya poraefete e ka se dirisiwe ka tlhamalalo ke batshameki ba inthanete.
LEBAKA LA GO LE LEBANA 1. Leta gore motshameko o feleletse go laisa. 2. Sekaseka boemakepe jo bo rulagantsweng le maduo a go ipaakanyetsa ga seva. 3. Ikgolaganye go tswa kwa PC e o e dirisang, go tswa foo go tswa mo sedirisiweng se sengwe sa LAN. 4. Fa LAN access e sa atlege, tlhatlhoba log ya motshameko le Windows Phitlhelelo ya firewall ya sererwa se se diragadiwang tota.
LETLA BATLHAKISI BA MO INTERNET 1. Neela moamogedi aterese e e tlhomameng ya LAN, gantsi ka paakanyo ya DHCP ya tsela. 2. Tlhalosa dikgoro tse di tlhokegang le dithulaganyo tsa TCP/UDP tsa thulaganyo ya motshameko tota. 3. Romela fela mafelo ao kwa atereseng ya LAN ya motlamedi. 4. Letlelela pharakano ya metshameko e e tsamaelanang ka Windows Firewall mo diporofaeleng tsa marangrang tse o di dirisang. 5. Tlhatlhobo go tswa mo kgokaganong ya inthanete e e farologaneng tota.
O se ka wa dira gore DMZ ya motsamaisi e bereke, o se ka wa kgoreletsa firewall, kgotsa go senola boemakepe bongwe le bongwe jwa tsamaiso jaaka tharabololo ya kakaretso. Boloka tshedimosetso ya go ikwadisa ya router e le sephiri.
Synix ke molaodi wa desktop ya selegae. Ga e akaretse phanele ya web kgotsa relay ya setšhaba e e dirang gore ditlhokego tseno tsa netweke di nyelele.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD laisa le go tlhabolola difaele tsa seva e e neetsweng tse di tshegediwang Steam games. Synix e baakanya khopi ya yone e e abelanwang ka tlhamalalo; setup ya server e e tlwaelegileng ga e tlhoke tab ya SteamCMD e e ikemetseng.
LATELA TIRO E E NENG E DIRWA Tlhopha seva mme o bale Activity & Diagnostics. Tshedimosetso e e mo lomating lwa didirisiwa e bontsha gore tiro ya go tsenya e tsweletse. SteamCMD e kgona go fetofetoga fa gare ga go laisa, go abela, go phutholola le go netefatsa, ka jalo dipholo tsa yone ga se ka metlha di nayang peresente e e tlhomameng kgotsa nako e e setseng e e ka ikanngwang.
Letla tiro ya disiki gore e fele le fa pharakano ya netweke e wela kwa tlase. Bala molaetsa wa bofelo wa katlego kgotsa go palelwa pele o simolola tiro e nngwe.
FOKOTSA KGATELELO YA GO TLODOLELA Bula Settings → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Tlhopha mokgwa o o lekanyeditsweng o o tshegediwang mme o tsenye lebelo le le bontshiwang, kgotsa tlhopha lebelo le le tletseng.
Se se ama SteamCMD downloads, e seng bapadi ba bandwidth, motshameko mongwe le mongwe o e seng wa Steam downloader, kgotsa sephethephethe sotlhe mo PC.
Go Kwala le go Palelwa Diporofaele dingwe tsa metshameko di tlhoka akhaonto ya Steam e e dumeletsweng le netefatso ya Steam Guard. Dirisa Synix's sign-in prompt; ga ba a tshwanela go tsenya dintlha tsa akhaonto mo dikwalelong kgotsa mo dipegong tse di leng mo pepeneneng.
Fa o sa kgona go downloader, bala phoso ya SteamCMD e e nepagetseng mme o sekaseke sebaka se se setseng mo disikeng, go fitlhelela difoldara, go fitlhelela marangrang le ditlhokego tsa akhaonto. Netefatso e ka nna ya jarolla difaele tse laolwang ke motsetedi, ka jalo boloka diphetolo tsa tlwaelo pele o e dirisa.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Ditiragalo tsa Empyrion le tse di fetotsweng mo khomputareng di farologane. Mo go Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, tlhopha Empyrion scenarios kgotsa Empyrion server mods. Emisa seva mme o tshole sesireletsi se se feletseng sa seva pele ga o dira diphetogo.
TSAMAYA SENARIO 1. Browse Catalog e bula Steam Workshop. Ikwadise mo go yone mme o letele gore Steam e fetse go e itseela. Ditshwantsho tsa botaki le dikokoano ga se dilo tse di dirwang mo serwereng. 2. Tlhopha Import Package, go tswa foo Tlhopha Folder. Tlhopha folda ya maemo a a rileng mo teng ga folda ya Steam ya laeborari ya gago ya steamapps\workshop\content\383120. Gape o ka tlhopha ZIP e e feletseng ya tiragalo. 3. Tsenya leina la foldara ya seemo se o kgonang go se lemoga. O se ka wa dirisa fela nomoro ya ID ya bodirelo. Boloka leina le le tshwanang la foldara go e tlhabolola moragonyana. 4. Tlhatlhoba diphuthelwana le kwa di yang teng, go tswa foo o bo o tlhomamisa gore di a tlisiwa. Synix e kopisa tiragalo yotlhe mo go Content\Scenarios kwa ntle ga go e tsenya tirisong kgotsa go fetola lefatshe lepe. 5. Tlhopha Scenario go bontsha maemo a a tsentsweng. Tlhopha nngwe ya tsone mme o bo o sekaseka leina le le farologaneng le o le bolokileng. Go fetogela mo seemong se se farologaneng go tlhoka leina le lesha, le le sa dirisiwang la poloko; Synix e akantsha gore go nne le nngwe mme e tlogela di-saves tse di leng teng di sa amiwe. 6. Dirisa tlhopho, simolola seva, mme o lebe log ya sona le kgokagano ya modirisi. Ditiragalo dingwe di na le dithulaganyo tse dingwe kgotsa dilo tse di tlhokegang tse mokwadi wa tsone a di kwadileng.
Leina la seemo ke GameConfig.CustomScenario; leina la lefatshe le le bolokilweng ke GameConfig.GameName. Synix e baya dedicated.yaml kwa morago pele e fetola masimo a mme e tshola go tsenngwa ga seva go tsamaelana. Ga e busetse peo, diphasewete, kgotsa dilo tse di sa amaneng le yone.
Tsela ya go tsenya sediriso Dirisa Empyrion server mods profile le Import Package go tlhopha mod ZIP e e rulagantsweng kgotsa foldara ya mod e e feletseng. Akaretsa DLLs tsa yona, go tshegetsa dithoto, go ikaega, le _Info.yaml fa di tlamelwa. Synix e tsenya tseno ka fa tlase ga Content\Mods; motshameko o tsenya khoutu fa o simolola. Di-source-code downloads le di-standalone installers ga se diphuthelwana tse di tshegetswang.
Synix ga e tsenye mod loader kgotsa go kgontsha mod e e sa dirisiweng ka tlhamalalo. Latela ditlhokego tsa mokwadi, go akaretswa le tse dingwe tse di tlaleletsang, tlhamo, le thulaganyo ya modirisi. Go tsenngwa mo motshamekong ka katlego ga go supe gore mod e tsamaelana le motshameko wa gone jaanong kgotsa di-mod tse dingwe tse di tsentsweng.
DITLHAGISO LE GO TSOGA FELA Steam e tlhabolola khopi ya yone ya Workshop, e seng khopi ya seva e e tsentsweng ke Synix. Go ntšhwafatsa, emisa seva mme o tsenye sephuthelwana se se ntšhwafaditsweng o dirisa leina le le tshwanang la foldara ya maemo. Lekola gore a mokwadi o tlhoka go bolokwa sesha. Difaele tse di emisitsweng di amogela dikhopi tse di busediwang morago; go tsenya ntšhwafatso ga se go e tsenya sesha e bile ga go tlose difaele tse di tlhaelang mo sephuthelwaneng se sesha.
Tsosolosa lenaane la diphuthelwana tse di feletseng go na le la thoto nngwe le nngwe e e rileng. E tsentswe (e sa netefatswe gape) go raya gore e ne ya kwalwa, e seng gore faele nngwe le nngwe e e tsentsweng e tlhatlhobilwe gape. Roll Back Import e busetsa morago import yotlhe e e tlhophilweng, go akaretsa le di-mods tse dingwe mo sephuthelwaneng se le sengwe, mme e gana go emisetsa difaele tse di fetotsweng kwa ntle ga Synix. Maemo a a tlhophilweng le dithoto tsa maemo tse di tlhokwang ke mafatshe a a bolokilweng di sireleditswe gore di se ka tsa tlosiwa; o ka kgona go busetsa seemo se se tsentsweng mo direkotong tsa gago tse di fetileng.

data.name: Content.9C9046B6659057C8B0D0
data.value: ● TELEMETRY E E Dirwang ka Maatla

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Bulela Configure → Network & RCON go lebelela mafelo a a tshegediwang ke motshameko o o tlhophilweng. Dirisa thulaganyo ya mmatota ya motshameko, e seng lenaane le le tlwaelegileng la dikgoro.
PORT ROLES • Go tsena mo motshamekong: Go tsena mo motshamekong. • Port ya dipotso: Tshedimosetso ya seva kgotsa go senolwa, fa e le gore porotokolo eo ya dipotso e a tshegediwa. • RCON/admin port: Tsela e nngwe ya tsamaiso. • App/API port: Tirelo e e rileng ya motshameko kgotsa tirelo ya tsamaiso.
TCP le UDP ke melawana e e farologaneng. Melawana e mebedi e e farologaneng e ka dirisa nomoro ya boemakepe jo bo tshwanang, mme di-server tse pedi ga di ka ke tsa dirisa mafelo a go reetsa a a sa tshwaneng. Synix gape e tlhatlhoba diporofaele tse di bolokilweng go bona dikgotlhang tsa boemela-kepe, go akaretsa le go emisa go tsena.
Boloka dintlha tsa bofelo tse di letleletsweng e le tse di kgethegileng mo mabakeng a a farologaneng mme o boloke kamano nngwe le nngwe e e tlhokegang ya motshameko magareng ga maemakepe. O se ka wa akanya gore motshameko otlhe ke UDP kgotsa gore karolo nngwe le nngwe ya dipotso e emela moreetsi wa mmatota.
TIRELO GA SE GO tshameka metshameko fela Gantsi batshameki ga ba tlhoke go fitlhelela RCON kgotsa endpoint e nngwe ya motsamaisi. Tshola kalafi eno mo lefelong la lona ntle le fa o na le thulaganyo e e kgethegileng ya go e dirisa ka tsela e e sireletsegileng.
DIKGATLHOGO TSE DI TSWANG KWA MOTLHANENG • Minecraft Java le Bedrock di dirisa maitsholo a a farologaneng a kgokagano; latela kgatiso e o e tlhophileng. • Satisfactory's local API e dirisa motshameko wa yone o o rulagantsweng/ API port; tlhotlhwa ya yone ya legacy query-field ga se tlhokego e nngwe gape mo go Synix. • Dune's query-field metadata e emetse RMQ deployment port ya yone, eseng tirelo ya Steam A2S ya dipotso. • Rust+ e dirisa endpoint ya yone go tlaleletsa mo motshamekong.
Difaele tsa themplate ke boleng jwa go simolola, e seng lenane la go bula tsela ya botlhe. Tlhatlhoba moreetsi wa nnete pele o fetola molao wa firewall.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: Dune: Awakening e dirisa tsamaiso ya semmuso ya go tlhoma seva e e kgethegileng. Hyper-V le hardware virtualization di tshwanetse go kgontshiwa, mme Windows Pro kgotsa Enterprise e a tlhokega. Fa e simololwa, Synix e simolola battlegroup.bat jaaka Molaodi. Tlhopha initial-setup mme o bo o baakanyetsa Token ya gago ya Self-Host. Synix e ka tsenya, ya tlhabolola, ya boloka, le go simolola tiragatso, mme motshameko o na le metšhini ya maranyane le maemo a yone a go dira. Kaedi ya semmuso: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks e romela ditiragalo tse di tlhophilweng tsa seva mo kanaleng. Ke dikitsiso, e seng Discord bot e e laolang Synix go tswa kgakala.
ITSHWARELETSE SE O TLHOPEGANG KA SONE 1. Tlhopha kgotsa bona webhook ya kanale e o letleletsweng go e laola. 2. Bula tsebe ya Configure → Discord ya seva e o e tlhophileng. 3. Tsenya webhook mme o tlhophe dikgetho tse di leng teng tsa go tsamaisa ditiragalo. 4. Boloka thulaganyo. 5. Dirisa kgato ya teko fa e le gore o a e fiwa, kgotsa tlhomamisa gore e tla romelwa ka nako ya tiragalo e e rulagantsweng.
Go simolola, go tima, go tsosolosa, go boloka, le melaetsa ya tlhokomelo e ikaegile ka ditsela tse di kgontshiwang le gore a tota tiro e diragetse.
Sireletsa URL Webhook URL e na le dintlha tsa go romela. Mongwe le mongwe yo o e bonang a ka nna a kgona go romela melaetsa mo kanaleng eo. O se ka wa e tsenya mo di-screenshots tsa batho botlhe, mo ditlhogong, mo dikwalelong le mo dipuisanong.
Synix e sireletsa webhook e e bolokilweng ya modirisi wa Windows. Fa e le gore URL e a tlhagelela, e dikologe kgotsa e phimole mo Discord, o bo o tlhabolola kwa Synix e yang teng. Sekaseka maina a seva le dintlha tsa tiragalo tse di rometsweng go kanale e e abelanwang.
FA E LE gore melaetsa ga e goroge Tlhatlhoba tsela ya tiragalo e e tlhophilweng, URL, kanale/webhook go nna teng, le gore a PC e ka fitlhelela Discord. Sekaseka phoso e e begilweng kwa ntle ga go gatisa URL e e feletseng.
Dikitsiso di dirisa kgokagano e e yang kwa Discord. Ga di tlhoke gore go bulwe boemakepe jo bo laolang tsela e e tsenang.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Tlhopha gore a o tlosa fela control panel kgotsa o tlosa le di-server tsa gago tse o di tsentseng. Tseo ke ditiro tse di farologaneng.
TLOGELA FELA KA TIRISO E O E Dirisang 1. Feleletsa go tsenya, go fetisa kgotsa go boloka sengwe le sengwe se se ntseng se dira. 2. Emisa di-server tsa gago ka Synix, emela gore di fetse go boloka, mme o tswa mo Synix. 3. Boloka dikhopi tse di tlhomamisitsweng tsa dipolanete tse di botlhokwa, difaele tsa thulaganyo le makwalo a go ikwadisa. 4. Tlosa Synix ka go dirisa Windows Installed apps kgotsa motsamaisi wa gago wa sephuthelwana.
Boloka C:\Synix, difoldara tsa seva tse o di tlwaetseng, dipapadi tse di bolokilweng kwa ntle, le mafelo a go boloka fa e le gore o ikaelela go di dirisa gape. Go tsenya tiriso gape ga go tlhoke gore o phimole difoldara tseno.
TLHOKOMISA TENG E NNGWE YA DIKGATLO TSA MO SERVER Dirisa tiro ya go phimola ya seva e e tlhophilweng mo Synix mme o bale netefatso. Go phimola mokwalo wa dashboard ga go tshwane le go dumela go phimola difaele tsa tlhomamiso kgotsa di-backup. Tlhomamisa gore ke tshedimosetso efe e e tla tlosiwang.
O se ka wa dirisa go phimola jaaka tsela e khutshwane ya go rarabolola mathata. Sephuthelwana se se bolokilweng fela mo teng ga folda e o e phimolang ga se khopi ya go busetsa.
Fa e le gore o fetogela kwa phanele e nngwe ya taolo, netefatsa gore e ka simolola go tsenngwa sentle le go tsenya lefatshe le o le batlang pele ga o tlosa data ya gago ya bogologolo.

data.name: Content.B6FC67DB36AEA1C2C9E1
data.value: ATLAS e tlhoka gridi ya seva e e rometsweng ntle le database ya Redis pele ShooterGameServer.exe e ka simolola. Synix e tlaa thibela go simololwa go fitlha ShooterGame\ServerGrid.json le ShooterGame\ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json di le teng. Dira gridi ka Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor ya semmuso, baya difaele tse pedi mo foldareng ya ShooterGame, mme o simolole AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat pele o simolola ATLAS server. Redis e tshwanetse go nna mo lefelong la 127.0.0.1 mme boemakepe jwa 6379 ga bo a tshwanela go tlhagelela mo inthaneteng.
