data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Tlhopha seva mme o dirise dithulusu tsa yone tsa go leka go ikgolaganya le yone kgotsa tsa go tshameka fa di le teng. Synix e tlhopha ditlhatlhobo go ya ka potso e e tshegediwang ya motshameko, TCP/UDP/HTTP, API ya selegae, le bokgoni jwa thulaganyo.
SE DIPHELELO DI SE Kayang Karabo ya kgokagano ya maemo a a kwa tlase ga e supe gore motshameki a ka kgona go ikwadisa le go tsena. Go nna gone ga thulaganyo go ka se bontshe gore tirelo ya yone ya dipotso e setse e siametse go ka dirisiwa.
Palo ya batshameki le maina a batshameki ke dilo tse di farologaneng. Motlhankedi a ka bega gore ke batshameki ba le kae ba ba golagantsweng ntle le go senola lenaane la batshameki. Setlhopha sa batshameki se se se nang sepe ga se bolele gore ga go na ope yo o tshamekang.
DITLHOGO TSE DI IPHITLHILENG KANA N/A Mekgwa mengwe ya EOS-only kgotsa crossplay ga e bontshe dikopo tse di tshegediwang tse di ka ikanngwang kgotsa tsela ya go laola motshameki. Synix e ka nna ya bontsha N/A kgotsa ya se ka ya dira teko go na le gore e bontshe maduo a a tsietsang.
Tlhatlhoba kgatiso e e tlhophilweng le tsela ya tsamaiso e e rulagantsweng ya Minecraft. Satisfactory dipalo tsa batshameki di ikaegile ka lefelo la yone la boikgethelo API connection. O se ka wa itlhamela ditlankana tsa EOS tse di ka dirisiwang fela ke motlhami go pateletsa teko.
DITLHOGO TSA SERVER-BROWSER Metshameko e mentsi ya Steam e dirisa dipotso tsa A2S, mme seno ga se mo lefatsheng lotlhe. Go ikwadisa, dithulaganyo tsa metshameko le tirelo ya sebatli di ama tsela e o bonang dilo ka yone, mme ga go na nako e e tlhomamisitsweng ya gore o tla bona eng.
Fa e le gore go na le seva mo sebatling, leka mokgwa wa motshameko wa go golaganya ka tlhamalalo mme o sekaseke log ya yone. Go fetola dikgoro tsa dipotso tse di sa amaneng gangwe le gape go ka tlisa mathata a mangwe.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Dirisa Configure mo masimong a a tlwaelegileng a Synix e a tsamaisang. Dirisa thulaganyo ya go rulaganya faele mo Server Options fa o tlhoka go tlhatlhoba kgotsa go fetola thulaganyo ya motshameko tota.
1. Emisa seva fa e bala faele fa e simololwa kgotsa e e kwala gape fa e ntse e dira. 2. Dira backup mme o netefatse faele le seva e o e tlhophileng. 3. Bala ditekanyetso tse di leng teng le dikakgelo. 4. Fetola fela se o ikaeletseng go se fetola. 5. Rarabolola diphoso tse mokwadi a di dirileng le go sekaseka ditlhagiso tsa yone. 6. Boloka, simolola seva ka Synix, mme o lebe log ya motshameko wa bofelo.
DIFORAMETSO TSE DI THUSANG Synix e tlamela ka tsamaiso ya fomete-e e lemogileng ya INI/dithoto tse di tshegediwang, JSON, XML, YAML, le difomete tse dingwe tse di rileng tsa porofaele. Ga se faele nngwe le nngwe kgotsa tlhopho nngwe le nngwe e nang le thulaganyo ya go rulaganya. Tsamaiso ya YAML e tshegetsa ditlhophiso tse di tsentsweng, lenaane le le tsentsweng, le boleng jwa mola o le mongwe fa e ntse e tshola dikakgelo le go tsentshiwa. Dikarolo tse di raraaneng tsa YAML jaaka di-anchor, di-aliases, dikokoano tsa mo moleng, le boleng jwa multiline di a ganwa ntle le go bolokwa.
Boloka dinotlolo tsa thulaganyo, boleng jo bo amogetsweng, maina a dimmapa, le ditaolo fela jaaka motshameko o di lebeletse. O se ka wa di ranola gore di tsamaisane le puo e o e dirisang.
GO LEBANTSHA SETSHWANTSHO GA SE Teko ya go Tshameka Faele e e rulagantsweng sentle e sa ntse e ka nna le dithulaganyo tse di sa tsamaisaneng. Di-mods kgotsa ditlhabololo tsa metshameko di ka tsenya dilo tse mokwadi a sa di lemogeng. Lekola gore a motshameko o tsentse faele e e tlhokegang le lefatshe morago ga go simolola gape.
Fa mogatisi yo mongwe kgotsa motshameko o fetola faele fa e butswe, e tsenye gape mme o e bapise pele o e boloka. Difaele tsa motshameko di ka nna le diphasewete tse di kgonang go balwa kgotsa di-token; di sekaseke le go di fetola pele o di abela ba bangwe.
Ditlhopho tsa Satisfactory tse di tshelang tsa API di mo Control Center ya yone mme di kgaogane le go baakanya difaele tsa thulaganyo ya diski.

Advanced mode e senola taolo ya tlaleletso ya setegeniki, go akaretsa RCON e e tshegetswang le dikgetho tsa go thunya tse di sa tlhotlhiwang. Go fetola mekgwa ga go phimole dilo tse di bolokilweng. Dikitsiso tsa Discord di teng ka mokgwa mongwe le mongwe.
SE SE MO LETLHAKGATLHANONG LENGWE LE LENGWE • Kakaretso: Leina la seva, motshameko, kgatiso/mofuta, le go tlhophiwa ga porofilo ya motshameko e e tshegediwang. • Tshireletsego: Mafaratlhatlha a go tsena le dithulaganyo tse dingwe tsa go tsena tse di tshegediwang ke thempleite. • Kgolo ya Lefatshe: Leina la lefatshe, peo, bogolo jwa lone le dilo tse di ka dirisiwang mo lefatsheng. • Network & RCON: Tshegetso ya go tshameka, potso, molekane/API, le mafelo a tsamaiso. • Go itirela: go dira di-backup/go di tlhabolola fa di simololwa le go di tlhokomela ka thulaganyo. • Discord: Mafelo a go romelwa melaetsa kwa go one le tsela e ditiragalo di dirwang ka yone. • Install & Launch: Foldara ya go tsenya le dikgetho tse di tshegediwang tsa go simolola.
Mafelo a a kgoreletsweng a a rileng a motshameko a dirilwe ka boomo. Motshameko o ka nna wa nna le thulaganyo eo ka boone kgotsa wa se ka wa e tshegetsa; go pateletsa mabaka a tlaleletso mo taelong ga se tsela e e babalesegileng.
DITLHOGO TSE NNE TSA GO LEBANTSHA Tshedimosetso ya Sefaenara → Ditlhophiso tse di Tlhokegang → Sekaseka → Boloka Sefaenara
Seno se kaya gore tsela e e rulagantsweng e setse e siametse go ka dirisiwa, e seng gore e setse e tsentswe kgotsa e tsentswe. Fa di-setting tse di batlegang di setse di fetisitswe, Synix e bula kgato ya 3 gore o kgone go sekaseka ditlhopho tsa gago, morago ga moo e bo e golola Save Server. Go fetola setlhophiso sa dilotlele Boloka gape go fitlha ditlhopho tse di tlhabolotsweng di bontshiwa mo Tshekatshekong. O tshwanetse go itlhophela gore a o tla boloka botshelo jwa gago; go bula Tshobokanyo ga e ke e bolokiwa ka tlhamalalo. Fa go na le sengwe se o tlhokang go se ela tlhoko, bala molaetsa o o kwadilweng fa fatshe.
Fa o baakanya seva, e emise pele fa phetogo e ama difaele kgotsa ditlhopho tse di balwang fa e simololwa. Save Changes e tlhabolosa porofaele ya yone; ga e bolele gore motshameko o o ntseng o tsweletse o dirisitse mekgwa eo. Simolola gape ka Synix fa motshameko o go tlhoka.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Bulela Configure → Automation gore seva e e tlhophilweng e tlhophe tiro e e diragalang pele go simololwa tse di tshegediwang.
Tlhatlosa gore o simolotse leng Dira gore se se kgone go dira polokelo ya seva e e emeng pele ga e simololwa. Beela motswedi wa polokelo le go boloka mo Application Settings → Backups.
Go busediwa morago ga kotsi go simologa ka boomo o tlola thulaganyo e e tlwaelegileng ya go boloka. Di-backup tse di itirisang fa o simolola ga se tsone tse di tshwanetseng go nna mo boemong jwa go boloka dintlha tse di ikemetseng tsa go busetsa dilo pele ga diphetogo tse dikgolo di direga.
TSAMAISETSO YA GO TLOGELA Dira gore seno se kgone go dira tlhatlhobo ya tlhabololo ya motshameko e e tshegediwang pele o simolola. E tlhabolola difaele tsa seva sa motshameko, e seng tiriso ya Synix.
Go tlhatlhoba gore a go na le sengwe se se tlhabolotsweng ga se tsholofetso ya gore fa o simolola sengwe le sengwe se tla tsenya difaele. SteamCMD le motlhomisi wa motshameko ba swetsa gore ke eng se se tlhokegang.
DIFILE TSA TLAKANYO LE TSA BOITEKANELO Kgato ya go netefatsa ka seatla e ka baakanya kgotsa ya tsenya gape difaele tse di laolwang ke motlhami. Boloka diphetogo pele o di tlhabolola kgotsa o di tlhomamisa; o se ka wa akanya gore difaele tsa gago tse o di tlhophileng ga di kitla di senngwa.
LEKANG DITHOPHO TSA LONA Boloka diikgethelo mme o dire tshimologo e o neng o le teng mo go yone. Buisa dipholo tsa tiro go di boloka, go di tlhabolola le go di simolola. Fa o setse o e tsentse ga go reye gore lefatshe la motshameko le tsentswe sentle.
Tlogela lefelo le le lekaneng la go boloka tshedimosetso, dilo tse o di tsentseng mo sedirisiweng, difaele tsa nakwana le motshameko o o tsentsweng. Fa tiro ya pele ga e simololwa e bega go palelwa, tlhotlhomisa lebaka le le boletsweng go na le go simolola seva e e tshwanang kwa ntle ga Synix go e dikologa.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Bulela Ready for the selected server pele ga e simolola kgotsa fa sengwe se palelwa. E kgobokanya ditlhatlhobo tse di tshegediwang ke porofilo eo, jaaka difaele, dinako tsa go dira, thulaganyo, sebaka sa disiki, dikgoro, seemo sa thulaganyo, le direkoto tse di maleba.
TLHALOSO TSA DIPHELELO • Go siame: Ga go na bothata jwa go thiba jo bo bonweng ke ditlhatlhobo tse di leng teng. • Sekaseka: Bala se o se lemogileng mme o dire tshwetso ya gore a go na le sengwe se o tshwanetseng go se dira. • Go thibetswe: Rarabolola bothata jo bo tlhalositsweng pele ga o tswelela.
Go nna o ipaakantse ga go reye gore o tshwanetse go baakanya sengwe le sengwe fela se o akantshang gore se baakanngwe. Sekaseka kgato e e akantshiwang le go tlhomamisa ga yone.
FA O SE KILE WA Boloka A NEW PROFILE Tshimologo ya ntlha e ka kgona go tsenya difaele, go tsenya nako ya tiragatso e e tshegediwang, go tlhama thulaganyo, le go emela go simololwa ga motshameko. Latela kaelo ya go simolola pele le Activity & Diagnostics go na le go tsaya se o se bolokileng jaaka motshameko o o tsentsweng.
Metshameko mengwe e tlhoka tumalano, netefatso, kgotsa mo-motshamekong wa go kopa/tiriso ya thulaganyo pele mongwe le mongwe a ka tsenela. Feleletsa kgato eo mo lefelong le le batliwang ke motshameko.
TLHAKISO YA GO TSHWANEGANA Go tsenya, go simolola, go emisa le go lebelela diphelelo tsa rekoto ya ditiro tse Synix e di lemogileng. Ga e ise e tlhatlhobiwe go raya gore ga go na maduo a a kwadisitsweng; ga go reye gore motshameko o itsege o senyegile.
Matswela a Ready kgotsa netefatso e e atlegileng ya selegae ga se tiisetso ya go fitlhelela inthanete, di-mods tse di itekanetseng, kgotsa go tsamaelana le modirisi mongwe le mongwe. Feleletsa ka go leka kgokagano e e ikaeletsweng le lefatshe.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Polokelo ya selefera e e tlhophilweng e boloka difaele mo foldareng ya tlhomamiso ya selefera eo. Tlhatlhoba gore tota motshameko o boloka lefatshe la one kae pele ga o ikaega ka one.
TSAMAYA BACKUP 1. Emisa seva ka Synix mme o lete gore dithulaganyo tsa yone di tswa. 2. Tlhopha tiro ya go boloka mo go Server Options. 3. Sekaseka motswedi, lefelo le o yang kwa go lone, bogolo jo bo fopholediwang, le sebaka se se leng teng mo disiking. 4. Netefatsa mme o letele gore e feleletse. 5. Tlhopha Open Backup Folder go bona fa polokelo e leng teng. Boloka setlankana sa yone se se bontshang gore e dirilwe sentle.
KGATLHO Poloko e akaretsa folda ya go tsenya, e seng fela foldapotlana e nnye ya poloko. Metshameko e megolo e ka tlhoka nako e ntsi le go bolokiwa mo go yone.
Dipolokelo tsa AppData, Documents, di-drive tse dingwe, kgotsa metšhini e e leng ya motshameko e ka tswa e le kwa ntle ga folda eo. Dira di-backup tsa tsone ka go dirisa mokgwa o o tshegediwang ke motshameko.
GO TSAYA LE GO Boloka Motswedi o o tlwaelegileng wa poloko ke C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups e go letla go tlhopha motswedi o mongwe le go baya tekanyetso ya poloko-poloko.
Lefelo le o yang kwa go lone le tshwanetse go nna kwa ntle ga foldara ya seva sa motswedi. Go fetola modi wa polokelo ga go sutise kgotsa go phimola diakhaefe tse di leng teng; tlhatlhoba lefelo la bogologolo go bona gore a ga go na di-backup tsa bogologolo.
Go boloka go tlosa diakhaefe tsa bogologolo fa tekanyetso e e beilweng e fetwa ka nako ya go dira bekapo. Boloka mafelo a ka metlha a go busetsa dilo kwa morago a le kwa ntle ga lefelo leo.
Boloka khopi e nngwe e e netefaditsweng ya dipolanete tse di botlhokwa mo bobolokelong jo bo farologaneng. Fa diseke e sa bereke sentle e ka senya server le di-backup tse di bolokilweng mo disekeng eo. ZIP ya foldara e e kwa ntle ga e dire gore go nne le VM kgotsa database ya backup.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Bala molaetsa o o feletseng wa Windows pele ga o swetsa gore ke eng se o tshwanetseng go se fetola. Go thibelwa ga executable, phoso ya go fitlhelela faele, le go tlhaela ga nako ya go tshameka ke mathata a a farologaneng.
SYNIX GA E TLA ITSEETSA OR E BULE Dirisa kgatiso ya semmuso kgotsa WinGet sephuthelwana sa Ubizz.Synix. Fa go emisediwa ga faele go bega phitlhelelo e ganetswe, tswala sekai sa Synix o dirisa tsela eo ka tlwaelo mme o leke gape. Sekaseka melaetsa ya go tsena mo difoldareng le ya software ya tshireletso fa bothata bo tswelela pele.
O se ka wa phimola data ya seva kgotsa wa thibela tshireletso jaaka go baakanya dilo ka kakaretso.
SMARTSCREEN Tlhagiso ya leina e ka neela More info → Run anyway, go ikaegile ka pholisi ya Windows. Go nna teng ga kgetho eo ga se bosupi jwa gore faele e sireletsegile. Tlhomamisa gore metswedi ya tshedimosetso e boammaaruri le go batlisisa ka tlhagiso pele ga o dira tshwetso ya gore a o tla tswelela pele.
SMART APP CONTROL Se se ka thibela app fa Windows e sa kgone go tlhoma tshepo e e lekaneng. Ga e na app ya motho ka nosi e e tshwanang le ya SmartScreen's Run. O se ka wa tima dikarolo tsa pabalesego tsa Windows fela go tsamaisa Synix.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAILURE Batlisisa ka tlhomamo gore o bonwe ke mang mme o dire jalo. O se ka wa akanya gore tlhagiso ke ya maaka fela ka gonne faele e bidiwa Synix. Hash ya SHA-256 e e tsamaelanang e supa faele e e tsentsweng; ga e dire gore batho ba tshepe motho yo mongwe kgotsa go saena khoutu.
Kwala tlhagiso e e nepagetseng le mokgwa wa go tsenya o ntsha dintlha tsa sephiri. O se ka wa dirisa mokgwa o o sa tlwaelegang wa go gana kgotsa go itlhokomolosa thulaganyo ya go tlhatlhoba gore khomputara e siame.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Dirisa Settings → Backups go dira Synix export/import e e feletseng. Seno se farologane le go kwadisa folda e le nngwe ya seva e e leng teng.
TLHATLHAGANYA SE SE TSHwanetseng go Tsamaisiwa Diphuthelwana tsa thomelontle ke setlhare se segolo sa C:\Synix. Sephuthelwana se se itlhophetsweng kgotsa difoldara tsa poloko kwa ntle ga sona le dipapadi tse di bolokilweng kwa ntle di tlhoka go tsamaisiwa ka go farologana. Kwala tsela e ba tsamaileng ka yone pele ga ba tsamaya. Ditlhopho tse di tlwaelegileng tsa Windows le tsone di ka tlhoka go sekasekwa malebana le lefelo le di yang kwa go lone.
EXPORT 1. Emisa di-server mme o fetse go di tlhokomela, go di tsenya mo Internet le go di boloka. 2. Tlhopha go romela ka tsela e e sa kwalwang kgotsa e e tlwaelegileng. 3. Tlhopha lefelo le o yang kwa go lone kwa ntle ga setlhare sa motswedi mme o sekaseke bogolo le ditlhokego tsa sebaka sa nakwana. 4. Fa o batla go romela tshedimosetso ka khomputara, tlhopha lefoko la sephiri le le nonofileng mme o le boloke le le nosi. 5. Letela gore sephuthelwana sa .synixbackup se fele, go tswa foo o se netefatse.
TSAYA TSHIRELETSO E E SIAMENG Tsamaiso e e sireleditsweng ya thomelontle e sireletsa sephuthelwana mme e tshegetsa phetisetso e e kgonang go fetolwa ya makwalo a a tshegediwang kwa akhaontong ya Windows e e yang teng.
Dilo tse di romelwang kwa dinageng di sele ka tlwaelo ga di a kwalwa ka tsela ya khomputara. Difaele tsa metshameko le direkoto tse di mo teng ga yone di ka senola diphiri. Go kopisa Windows-bound encrypted values ga go dire gore di kgone go dirisiwa mo akhaontong e nngwe.
DITLHAKISO 1. Dira gore go nne le khopi ya bosheng ya Synix ya kwa o yang teng pele. 2. Bula ditsamaiso tsa thomeloteng/tlhahlobo mme o tlhophe sephuthelwana se o se batlang. 3. Fa o kopiwa go dira jalo, neela leina la sephiri le go netefatsa sephuthelwana. 4. Sekaseka lefelo le o yang kwa go lone, ditlhokego tsa disiki, le ditlhagiso tsa go kwala mo godimo ga tsone. 5. Letla gore go rulaganngwe, go tlhomamisiwe le go busediwa dilo mo boemong jwa tsone. 6. Tlhatlhoba tsela ya seva, maemakepe, dithulaganyo, mafelo a poloko, le ditlankana tsa go ikwadisa pele o simolola sepe fela.
Golaganya Satisfactory gape fa e le gore leina la lefelo kgotsa kgokagano e e sireleditsweng ga e sa tlhole e tsamaelana. Boloka sephuthelwana sa ntlhantlha le tshedimosetso ya bogologolo go fitlha go tlhatlhobiwa di-server tse di tsentsweng.
Diphetogo tsa data tse di tshegediwang di boloka khopi ya database pele ga go fetolwa. Fa go tsenya kgotsa go fudusa go sa atlege, boloka khopi eo le molaetsa wa go busetsa mo boemong jwa go emisetsa database e e dirang fa Synix e tsweletse.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Install & Launch e na le foldara ya seva e e tlhophilweng le dikgetho tsa yone tse di tshegediwang. Boloka taelo e e akantshiwang fa e le gore ga o tlhaloganye thutapuo ya motshameko.
DITLHOGO TSA KGATISO Dirisa mokgwa wa Advanced fa go tlhokega dikganetsano tse di sa dirwang. Tlhatlhoba go tsopola, ditsela tse di ka diragadiwang, le maina a dikgetho a a tlhokegang mo motshamekong. Synix e setse e tlamela ka mabaka a a tshegediwang a a laolwang; go tsenya khopi e nngwe gape go ka dira gore go nne le dilo tse di thulanang.
O se ka wa ranola di-switch kgotsa wa emisetsa boleng jwa setegeniki jo bo solofetsweng ka leina la sone le le ranotsweng. Le ka motlha o se ka wa tsenya dintlha mo taolong e le fela gore go nne motlhofo go e kopolola.
Difaele tse di romelwang kwa ntle Fa e le ka diporofaele tse di tshegediwang, Server Options → Create Batch File e kwala taelo ya go simolola mo sekwalweng.
Faele eo e ka nna ya bo e na le diphasewete tse di kgonang go balwa kgotsa matshwao a tirelo gore e kgone go dira ka tsela e e ikemetseng. E boloke e le sephiri mme o e tlhatlhobe pele ga o e abelana le ba bangwe kgotsa o e fudusa.
Go tsamaisa script kwa ntle ga Synix ga go neele Synix dikgonagalo tsotlhe tsa tiragatso, thulaganyo ya tlhokomelo, di-backup, kgotsa tlhokomelo e e rulagantsweng. O se ka wa e tsamaisa fa Synix e setse e na le seva e e dirang.
DITIRELO TSA KWA NTLE Diporofaele tse dingwe tsa metshameko di simolola didiriswa tsa tsone tsa go romela mo boemong jwa thulaganyo e le nngwe e e tlwaelegileng ya seva. Didirisiwa tseo di ka nna tsa tlhoka gore o kope tetla e e farologaneng mme di ka nna tsa se tshegetse go romelwa ga faele ya go simolola. Latela kaelo ya motshameko wa porofaele go na le go e emisetsa ka nngwe e e farologaneng e o ka kgonang go e dira kgotsa e o ka kgonang go e phuthela.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Dirisa sephuthelwana sa semmuso sa go golola. E akaretsa .NET runtime e e tlhokwang ke Synix; di-server tsa metshameko di sa ntse di ka tlhoka maemo a tsone.
TSAYA TSELA E E TLA DIRISANG • MSI: Tsenya SynixSetup.msi, e dirise, mme o bule Synix Control Panel go tswa mo Start menu. Lefelo la tlwaelo la tiriso ya modirisi ke %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGetDirisa sephuthelwana se se tshwanang.Synix. Setlhogo sa WinGet Installation and Updates se na le ditaolo. • Standalone executable: Tsenya official standalone download mo foldareng e o kgonang go kwala mo go yone mme o e dirise gone. Go fudusa faele eo e e ka dirisiwang ga go reye gore o fudusitse di-server tsa gago tsotlhe.
Go itseelwa semmuso: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
TLHOKOMISA THUTSO 1. Feleletsa dilo tse di tsentsweng mo sedirisiweng sa gago, di-backup le go di tlhokomela. 2. Thibela di-server tsa gago tsa metshameko ka Synix mme o tswale Synix jaaka tlwaelo. 3. Dirisa sedirisiwa sa go tlhabolola kgotsa sa go tsenya sa mokgwa wa go tsenya o o o tlhophileng. 4. Bula Synix gape mme o tlhatlhobe gore diteng tsa seva le ditsela di siame.
Fa o tsenya MSI mo boemong jwa thulaganyo e kgologolo ya EXE, tlosa thulaganyo e kgologolo pele. Boloka tshedimosetso ya yone ya seva le difoldara tse di itiretsweng tsa seva. O se ka wa phimola C:\Synix go tlhabolola porokeramo.
Ntšhwafatso ya porokeramo ga e ntshwafatse metshameko e o e tshotseng. Dirisa tiro ya Update ya seva e o e tlhophileng go dira jalo.
Fa Windows e bega gore go thibetswe go tsena fa o emisetsa executable, tlhatlhoba gore khopi e e emisediwang ga e sa tlhole e dira. O se ka wa kwala mo godimo ga porokeramo e e ntseng e dira kgotsa wa tlosa data ya seva go leka go rarabolola phoso.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix e tlhatlhoba kgatelelo ya motswedi pele ga go simololwa dingwe go fokotsa kgonagalo ya go imetsa motlamedi. Fa tshimologo e diegisiwa kgotsa e thibetswe, bala kgwetlho e e tlhagisitsweng ya motswedi.
Boloka Phaposi Gore e Nne ya Baeng Letlelela segopotso sa Windows le ditiriso tsa kwa morago mmogo le motshameko. Boloka sebaka se se lekaneng mo disikeng tsa gago gore o kgone go tsenya tshedimosetso e ntšha, difaele tsa nakwana, tse di bolokilweng le tse dingwe.
Molelwane wa segopotso sa Minecraft o ama motshameko/nako ya yone ya go dira. Ga se tekanyetso e e gagametseng ya sengwe le sengwe se se dirwang mo motshamekong mongwe le mongwe.
Ditlhatlhobo tsa metswedi ga di tsenye seva mo setshelong sa CPU/RAM kgotsa go netefatsa gore Windows e ka se ke ya felelwa ke metswedi. Dirisa sesireletsi sa metswedi ya tshedimosetso le tshobokanyo ya dashboard ya PC yotlhe go tlhaloganya morwalo wa mmatota.
TSHIRELETSO Karolo ya tekeletso ya tlhagiso ya marangrang e lebile maemo a a sa tlwaelegang a bandwidth/resource mme e tsaya tsia ditiro tse di itsegeng tsa SteamCMD go fokotsa ditlhagiso tse e seng tsone.
Ga se firewall, kgotsa tirelo e e sireletsang kgatlhanong le go tlhaselwa ke DDoS. Tlhagiso ga e supe gore ke mang yo o tlhasetseng kgotsa ga e bontshe gore tota go kile ga tlhaselwa.
Fa o tlhagisiwa, bapisa se o se dirang le dilo tse di itseweng tse o di tsentseng mo sedirisiweng sa gago, tse o di bolokileng le ditiriso tse dingwe. Tlhatlhoba direkoto tse di maleba pele ga o fetola pabalesego kgotsa dithulaganyo tsa marangrang.

data.name: Content.F797B7FAAA8293240799
data.value:

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Tlhopha profaele ya Rust mme o sekaseke lefatshe la yone, boitshupo, motshameko, dipotso le di-setting tsa ditsala pele ga tshimologo ya ntlha.
IDENTITY YA SERVER Synix e tlamela ka boleng jo bo tshegetswang jwa +server.identity go tswa mo boitsebong jwa seva. Tlhokomela gore go nne le ditikwatikwe tse di farologaneng le matshwao a a farologaneng mo mabakeng a a farologaneng gore ba se ka ba nna le lefatshe le le tshwanang kgotsa sebopego se se tshwanang.
RUST+ Rulaganya App Port e e tshegediwang e e kgethegileng ya tirelo ya molekane, mme o latele ditlhokego tsa Rust tsa go nyalanya le tsa netweke. Bofelo jwa yone bo kgaogane le motshameko wa motshameki le tsamaiso ya RCON.
Tlhatlhoba dikgoro tse di rulagantsweng tota go na le go kopisa molao go tswa go seva e nngwe ya Rust. Sireletsa ditlankana tsa RCON mme o se ke wa di phasalatsa go thusa batho go ikwadisa.
VANILLA LE OXIDE Vanilla o dirisa difaele tsa semmuso tsa seva. Go tlhopha Oxide go tsenya letlhomeso la semmuso le le tshegediwang morago ga difaele tsa Steam. Go tsenngwa ga letlhomeso ga go tlhophe kana go tlhatlhoba di-plugins tse di rileng.
Dirisa Mod & Plugin Manager's supported local workflow for a detected Oxide/uMod installation. Di-plugin di sa ntse di tlhoka mefuta e e tsamaisanang le yone le metswedi e e ikanyegang.
Synix e dirisa gape nako ya tiragatso ya Oxide e e tshegediwang morago ga gore Rust e tlhabololwe kgotsa go netefadiwe fa letlhomeso leo le tlhophilwe. Go boela kwa difaeleng tsa semmuso tsa Vanilla, fetola tlhopho ya letlhomeso mme o tsamaise thulaganyo ya tiro e e tshegediwang ya Update kgotsa Validate.
Pele o fetola thulaganyo kgotsa motshameko, boloka lefatshe, thulaganyo, le data ya plugin. Tlhatlhoba dipampiri tsa log ya motshameko le ya Oxide morago ga go simolola gape; phitlhelelo e e atlegileng ya go jarololwa ga letlhomeso ga e supe gore porojeke nngwe le nngwe e tsentswe sentle.

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: ATLAS ke seva e e tshwaraganeng mme e ka se kgone go dira difaele tseno ka go simolola seva. Dirisa Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor ya semmuso go tlhama le go romela gridi. Kopa ServerGrid.json le ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json mo foldareng ya server ya ShooterGame. Pele o simolola ATLAS, tsamaisa AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat mme o tlogele Redis e tsamaya. Boloka Redis e golagane le 127.0.0.1; O se ka wa baya boemakepe jwa 6379 mo LAN, router kgotsa Internet. Morulaganyi wa semmuso: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor
